Enhances Shield Throw Damage as more damage is blocked, up to 1787% increased damage after blocking ? damage.
Extends Super Duration by up to ?% by continuously blocking damage.
Guardian Damage is completely nullified and do not proc on-hit related effects on the Impenetrable Barrier. 
Ability Damage removes Super Energy but partially extends it at the same time.

Allies standing within 5m behind the barrier are granted 25% Increased Damage, a 45 HP Void Overshield, +50 Handling, and +50 Reload Speed. 
Additionally, all of their weapons are refilled every 2.5 seconds.
Allied Guardian's Void Overshield begins regenerating at a rate of 9HP/s after not receiving damage for 3 seconds.

Passive Super Energy Drain while Blocking can be decreased by having allies behind the shield.
x1 = 20% | x2 = 35% | x3 = ?% | x4 = ?% | x5 = 50%

Grenade Ability | Does not drain Super Energy. Incurs a 3 second cooldown between Shield Throws.
Performs a Shield Throw, tossing the Sentinel Shield towards enemies.
Sentinel Shield deals 723 [?] damage, and can ricochet on impact, up to ? times. Ricochets are aimed towards enemies within ? meters.

entries.title: Twilight Arsenal
entries.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance while in Cast Animation: ?% [%]

Summons 3 Void Axes and throws them towards the reticle.
Axes deal up to 1250 [?] damage over ? meters on impact, pulling enemies inwards, and explode after 0.6 seconds, dealing up to 1750 [?] damage and weakening over ? meters.
After exploding, axes become carriable weapons, lingering up to 20 seconds on the ground.

Carriable Axes:
Melee Weapons with 10 Ammo that can be held for up to 15 seconds.
Light Attack swings deal 581 [175] damage and weaken, consuming 1 Ammo.
Heavy Attacks throws the axe as an explosive projectile, consuming all ammo, dealing 1337 [?] damage on impact, and up to 830 [250] damage over ? meters with its explosion, weakening damaged enemies.
Axe damage can only be increased through the Void Surge modifier and debuffs.

entries.title: Ward of Dawn
entries.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance while in Cast Animation: ?% [26.5%]
Grants 1 Grenade Ability Charge and creates 3 Orbs of Power that each grant 2.3% Super Energy on Super Cast.

Ward of Dawn:
Projects a 8,000 Construct HP Protective Dome with 75??% NEEDS TESTING Damage Resistance against Combatants alongside an internal core with 200 HP.
Guardians deal 50% increased damage to the Protective Dome itself. Ability Damage scales uniquely.
Protective Dome covers an 8 meter radius centered around its internal core for 30 seconds. Destroying the core destroys the Ward of Dawn.
The Ward of Dawn prevents all projectiles from entering or leaving the dome unless an enemy is within it.
While a Combatant is inside the dome: The caster and their allies are able to shoot through the dome.
Deploying or redeploying the Ward of Dawn pulls Combatants within 15 meters inwards.
Super Stat scales its duration by up to +10 seconds at 200 Super Stat.

While inside the Ward of Dawn Dome:
Ward of Dawn Caster receives +50% Increased Melee Damage. Scoring a Melee Kill as the Caster generates an Orb of Power up to 5 times per Super cast.
Enemies are constantly weakened. Combatants up to ? meters away are taunted towards Guardians inside the dome.
Armor of Light | Constantly generates 15 Void Overshield/s and grants 40% [?%] Damage Resist, +50 Handling, and +50 Reload Speed.

Redeployement:
The Ward of Dawn Core can be picked up by the caster after 3 seconds of being deployed, up to twice per cast. Swirling orbs represent the amount of pickups left.
While picked up: Remaining Ward of Dawn duration is decreased by 1 second every (77 / Armor of Light seconds left on pickup).
The Core can be thrown to redeploy by the caster up to 2 times per cast.

entries.title: Bastion
entries.description:
On Super Cast:
Grants allies within 15 metres a 45 HP Void Overshield.

On Enhanced Barricade Cast:
Grants a 45 HP Overshield for the user and allies within 15? metres 
Enhanced Barricade takes 20% increased damage from Guardians.

While behind the Enhanced Barricade:
Generates 11 Void Overshield HP per second.

Crucible-Only:
Overrides Towering Barricade Cooldown to 100 seconds at base.
Overrides Rally Barricade Cooldown to 80 seconds at base.

entries.title: Controlled Demolition
entries.description:
Void Ability Damage inflicts Volatile.
Volatile Explosions also count as Void Ability Damage.

Volatile Explosions restore 90 HP to the user and allies within 40 meters of the user.

entries.title: Offensive Bulwark
entries.description:
Grants an additional Shield Throw to Sentinel Shield Super.

While Void Overshield is active or while within a Ward of Dawn:
Kills grant 9% Grenade and 9% Melee Ability Energy.
160% [20%] increased Melee Damage, and increases Melee Lunge Range to 5.5 metres.
Melee Kills generate 10 HP Void Overshield.
Basic Melee Hits count as Void Powered Melee Hits, except for Doomfang Pauldrons and Severance Enclosure.

entries.title: Unbreakable
entries.description:
Hold [Grenade] to summon a Void Shield.
Overrides Grenade Ability Cooldown to 152 seconds at base while equipped.

Void Shield:
Grants 95?% [64%] Damage Resist against blocked damage, and taunts Combatants in front of the user. Combatants that come into contact with the shield become disoriented.
Generates 10 Void Overshield HP/s that lasts 5+2.5 seconds while draining 7.5% Grenade Energy/s.
Blocking damage decreases Forward Movement Speed by 50?% for 0.5? seconds.
Blocking damage grants Grenade Energy. Energy gains are progressively reduced (over time) OR (as Unbreakable gains damage)?, down to ?% Energy after ? seconds.
Void Shield has no Movement Speed Penalties, only restricting mantling. Sprinting cancels Void Shield.

While Sentinel Shield Super Ability is equipped:
Guarding against any damage spawns an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy to allies.
Incurs a 4.5 second cooldown between Orb of Power spawns.

Releasing [Grenade] or running out of Grenade Energy releases a frontal blast, consuming 50% Grenade Energy and dealing damage up to 11 meters away.
Deals a minimum of 430 [64?] Grenade Damage for not blocking any damage, scaling to 1584 [178?] damage after receiving a lot [?] blocked damage.

Unbreakable Kills grant Devour for 10+5 seconds.

entries.title: Pocket Singularity
entries.description:
Innately has 2 Melee Ability Charges.

Launches an unstable ball of Void Energy that lasts for 2 seconds.
Using Auto-Melee will consume a charge to perform a Melee Lunge. 
Used this way, it will still inflict knockback and Volatile, but its damage will be reduced by 65% to 50%, with closer distances dealing less damage.

Singularity homes in towards the closest enemy within 2? meters, exploding on contact.

Explosion knocks enemies within 3.75 meters away from the blast, dealing 527 [60] damage and inflicting Volatile.

Guardians hit by Pocket Singularity cannot perform Melee Lunges for 0.5 second, and interrupts active slides.

entries.title: Nova Bomb: Cataclysm
entries.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [49%]

Releases a slowly moving, tracking Nova Bomb that detonates on impact, or upon being detonated, dealing up to 3241 [?] damage in a 12 meter radius.
Nova Bomb has 400 Construct HP. Caster deals 300% increased damage towards their own Nova Bomb.

Releases 6 seekers on detonation, which slowly track enemies, each dealing up to 649 [?] damage in a ~4 meter radius.
Seekers have 100 Construct HP.

Nova Bomb and its Seekers can be detonated mid-air by dealing damage towards it. Caster deals significantly more damage against it.

entries.title:
Nova Bomb:
Vortex
entries.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [49%]

Releases a fast moving, arcing Nova Bomb that detonates on impact, dealing up to 3021 [?] damage in a ? meter radius.
Creates a singularity after 0.43 seconds of detonating, instantly pulling enemies inwards.

Singularity deals 52 [?] damage every 0.13 seconds for 10 seconds to enemies within ? metres, and repeatedly pulls enemies within ? meters every ? seconds towards it.

entries.title: Nova Warp
entries.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [58%]
Base Duration: 24.5 seconds, or 4.1% Super Drain per second.

Light Attack
Drains 5% Super Energy.
Deals up to 964 [200] damage, and inflicting Volatile in a 6 metre radius. Maximum Damage Falloff reduces damage by up to 50%.
Can be charged by holding [Fire] for 0.6 seconds, pulling enemies within ~14 meters towards the user and linearly increasing its damage and radius by 120%.
Decreases Movement Speed by ?% while charging.

Heavy Attack / Sprint
Performs a Dark Blink, draining 3.5% Super Energy to rapidly accelerate towards the currently input direction and release 4 Weakening Seekers, one in each cardinal direction.
Weakening Seekers target enemies within 8 meters, dealing 193 [?] Damage and inflicting Weaken on impact.

entries.title: Chaos Accelerant
entries.description:
[Grenade Ability] to overcharge a Grenade, enhancing it.

Grants an extra Grenade Ability Charge.

Overcharged Grenade Effects:

Axion Bolt: Adds 2 additional seekers [2 -> 4], seekers travel faster, deal 25% increased damage, and retriggers after a second of landing.

Scatter: Adds 4 additional submunitions, totalling 12. Submunitions now strongly track enemies within 5 meters, and deal 25% increased damage towards Combatants.

Vortex: 7.5% Increased Duration, 70% Increased Radius, begins dealing damage 0.275s sooner, and pulls enemies 0.2s earlier.

Magnetic, Spike, Suppressor, and Voidwall: Releases a short-range Void Blast that inflicts Volatile. Passively grants 1.15x Grenade Regeneration Speed.

entries.title: Child of the Old Gods
entries.description:
On Rift Cast:
Grants Void Soul Ready for 25 seconds. Can stack up to 2 Void Souls.

Scoring a Weapon Hit on an enemy launches the Void Buddy to fly towards them, projecting a Draining Field upon arriving.
The Draining Field deals 41 [10] Void Grenade Ability Damage and inflicts weaken for 4 [2.5] seconds every 0.7 seconds for up to 9.25 seconds to enemies within 10 meters. 
Combatants within the Draining Field are additionally suppressed.

The Void Friend has 150 HP and can be, unfortunately, destroyed. Has ?% Damage Resist until it is actively draining.

Grants different bonuses while the Void Soul is dealing damage, depending on the selected Class Ability:
Healing Rift: Grants 4% Grenade and Melee Energy every 1.4 seconds.
Empowering Rift: Restores 25 HP every 1.4 seconds.

Enemies killed within its Draining Field grant Class Ability Energy based on their Enemy Rank:
Tier 1 Combatant = 10% | T2 = 15% | T3 = 20% | T4+ = 50% | Guardian = 33.4%

entries.title: Feed the Void
entries.description:
Void Ability Kills grant Devour. 
Devour becomes Enhanced Devour.

Enhanced Devour:
Restores 140 HP on activation and grants Enhanced Devour for 10+5 seconds. Reactivating Enhanced Devour restores 140 HP and refreshes 5+3 seconds.
Scoring a kill while Enhanced Devour is active restores 140 HP, grants doubled Grenade Ability Energy, and refreshes 5+3 seconds of its duration.

Grenade Ability Energy on Kill:
Tier 1 Combatant = 15% | T2 = 23.2% | T3 = 27.5% | T4 = 40% | Guardians = 40%

entries.title: Soul Siphon
entries.description:
On Powered Melee Hit:
Replaces Melee Ability with Soul Siphon for 20 seconds.

On Soul Siphon Usage:
Tethers up to 4 enemies within 20 meters, dealing increasingly higher Melee Damage Ticks every 0.2 seconds and pulling enemies towards the user over 3.2 seconds.
The final pull (after 0.6 seconds from the first tick) is guaranteed to stagger enemies.

Grants +15 Void Overshield for 15+7.5 seconds and ?% Class Ability Energy per enemy per tick.
With Echo of Persistence equipped, the Overshield Duration cannot be refreshed to 22.5s unless it is ≤15 seconds.

Soul Siphon Damage is slightly randomized but averages ~1320 Melee Damage per cast per enemy.
2 | 11 | 26 | 62 | 100 | 137 Ticks + 879 Finish
? | ?? | ?? | ?? | ?? | ?? Ticks + ? Finish

entries.title: Stasis Shard
entries.description:
Stasis Subclass Intrinsic:
Shattering a Stasis Crystal or Frozen Enemy, or killing an enemy affected by a Stasis Debuff (Slow, Freeze) spawns a Stasis Shard. 
Small Stasis Shard = Rank-And-File
Large Stasis Shard = Elites, Minibosses, Bosses, and Guardians.

Stasis Elemental Pickup:
Stasis Shards grant Melee Ability Energy on pickup. 
Shards last for 20 seconds. Allies receive a copy of all Shards created by the user.
Small Stasis Shards grant 10% Melee Energy, and Large Stasis Shards grant 50% Melee Energy.

While Glacial, Grim or Tectonic Harvest is equipped:
Small Stasis Shards restore 10 HP and grant x1 Frost Armor.
Large Stasis Shards restore 20 HP and x3 Frost Armor.

entries.title: Stasis Crystal
entries.description:
Solid Pillars that can be spawned on surfaces, possessing a varying amounts of health depending on their size, lasting up to 15 seconds.

Crystals, upon being created, inflict freeze [x15 Slow Stacks for 1.5+0.5 seconds] to enemies within 2.6 metres. 

Stasis Crystals can be destroyed by depleting their health, dealing up to generally 158 [25] damage over a 8 metre radius.

Small Crystals: ? HP | Medium Crystal: ? HP | Large Crystal: ? HP
User deals double damage to their own Crystals.

entries.title: Frost Armor
entries.description:
Grants 7% [2%] Damage Resist per stack, up to 31.25% [10%] Damage Resist at x5 stacks
Frost Armor decays 1 stack at a time every 5 seconds.
Damage Resist per stack is decreased to ?% [?%] while in Super.

Whisper of Rime:
Increases the maximum stack amount to x7, increasing the maximum Damage Resist to 50% [16%]
Increases the Frost Armor stack duration to 6 seconds.

entries.title: Slow
entries.description:
Slowed Enemies receive multiple penalties related to movement or weapon performance.
Freeze occurs upon reaching x100 Slow.

Slowed Combatants have 50% Decreased Movement Speed and are less accurate.

Slowed Guardians have 50% Reduced Movement Speed, 50% Decreased Jump Height, are unable to use Movement Abilities, receive ?% increased Flinch, and have a penalty to their Weapon Stats.

Slowed Weapon Stat Penalties:
Stability, Handling, Reload Speed and Recoil Direction are decreased by 75%.
Stat Reduction takes place after Weapon Perks. Weapon Stats are considered uncapped before slow's reduction is applied.
Eg: 160 Reload Speed will be reduced be 40 Reload Speed. 80 Handling would be reduced to 20 Handling.

Overload Champions become Stunned upon receiving any amount of Slow Stacks.

entries.title: Freeze
entries.description:
Frozen Enemies are completely immobilized, rendering them unable to shoot, use abilities, or move.
Frozen Enemies receive 10% increased damage from Special and Power Weapons, 5% increased damage from Arc, Solar, and Void Abilities, and 5% [60%] decreased damage from Primary Weapons. 
Frozen Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants and Guardians receive 120% increased Basic Melee and Glaive Melee Attack Damage, on top of the aforementioned effects.

Frozen Enemies shatter after receiving varying [200] damage.

Frozen Enemies are immobilized for 6 [1.35 to 4.75] seconds. 
Boss Combatants are unhindered by freeze and automatically shatter after 3 seconds.
Grounded Guardians can cast their Super Ability to instantly break out.

Brief Freeze:
Guardians frozen by other Guardians are frozen for 1.35 seconds

Prolonged Freeze:
Guardians that become frozen by Combatants, or by Stasis Super Abilities, are frozen for 4.75 seconds.
Frozen Guardians have their Class Ability replaced with Breakout, which allows breaking out of the long-lasting freeze, in exchange for ? Health.
Guardians that are frozen during a Roaming Super automatically break out after a second, while One-off Supers get deactivated if frozen during the cast animation.

entries.title: Shatter
entries.description:
Frozen Enemies can be shattered through damage or directly through specific Stasis Aspects, dealing up to 361 [?] damage to enemies within ? metres.

Unstoppable Champions become Stunned upon receiving shatter damage.

entries.title: Whisper of Bonds
entries.description:
Killing 0 Frozen enemies spawns an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy.

10 second cooldown between activations.

entries.title: Whisper of Chains
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Kills with 0 Frost Armor active spawns a 1 Stasis Shard.

Activation progress on Kills by Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 34%
• Elites: 67%
• Minibosses and Bosses: 100%
• Players: ?%

entries.title: Whisper of Chill
entries.description:
Scoring multiple 0 Stasis Weapon Kills spawns a Small Stasis Shard.

Activation progress on Kills by Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 34?%
• Elites and Enemy Players: 67%
• Minibosses and higher: 100%

Further Kills do not provide activation progress for 5? seconds after activation.

entries.title: Whisper of Conduction
entries.description: 0 Stasis Shards within 15 meters are pulled toward you after a 1 second delay.

entries.title: Whisper of Durance
entries.description:
0 Slow you apply to targets and certain lingering abilities last longer.

Specific increases provided by 1 Whisper of Durance can be found in the descriptions of the affected abilities and/or perks.

entries.title: Whisper of Fractures
entries.description: 0 Shattering a 1 Frozen Enemy with a melee attack grants you a Stack of 2 Frost Armor.

entries.title: Whisper of Hedrons
entries.description:
0 Freezing targets grants the following benefits for 11 seconds:

entries.description:

entries.title: Whisper of Impetus

Powered Melee Hits grant 40 Handling for 5 seconds and refill all weapons from reserves.

Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.title: Whisper of Refraction
entries.description:

entries.title: Whisper of Rending
entries.description:
0 Primary Ammo Weapons deal 100% Increased Damage against 1 Stasis Crystals and 50% Increased Damage against 2 Frozen Enemies.

3 Frozen enemies normally receive 5% [PVP: 50%] decreased damage from 4 Primary Weapons. Using the fragment results in a 42.5% overall Damage Increase in PVE and a 25% overall Decrease in PVP.

entries.title: Whisper of Reversal
entries.description:
Dealing or receiving Physical (non-projectile) Melee Damage while you have 0 Frost Armor active applies 10? 1 Slow Stacks to your enemy for ? seconds.

Glaive Melees also benefit from this.

entries.title: Whisper of Rime
entries.description: Increases the maximum number of 0 Frost Armor Stacks to 8 and its maximum duration to 13 seconds.

entries.title: Whisper of Shards
entries.description: Shattering a 0 Stasis Crystal grants 500% [PVP: 150%] Additional Base Grenade Regeneration Rate for 6 seconds, up to a maximum of 11 seconds.

entries.title: Whisper of Torment
entries.description:
Receiving damage from an enemy grants 7% Grenade Energy. This is increased to 12% while 0 Frost Armor is active.

1 second cooldown between activations.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Coldsnap Grenade
entries.description:
Medium Trajectory | Seeker

Directly hitting an enemy inflicts x50 [x?] Slow Stacks for 4+2 seconds.

If the seeker freezes an enemy, another seeker is spawned, targeting a different enemy, chaining up to 2 times.

Aspect — Touch of Winter: Seekers duplicate upon freezing an enemy. 
Seekers now spawn a Small, Medium, and Large Stasis Crystal on detonation upon chaining 1, 2, and 3 times respectively.

entries.title: Duskfield Grenade
entries.description:
Medium Trajectory | DoT Field

Detonates on impact, dealing up to 20 [20] damage and inflicting x20 [x10] Slow Stacks for 2+2 seconds in a ? meter radius, as well as creating a Slowing Field.

Slowing Field:
Deals 1 damage and applies x10 [x5] Slow Stacks for 2+2 seconds every 0.35 [0.3] seconds for 7+2 seconds in a 4 meter radius.

Aspect — Touch of Winter: Duskfield Radius is increased by 50% to ↑6 meters.
Duskfield now creates a Small Stasis Crystal on impact.

entries.title: Glacier Grenade
entries.description:
Medium Trajectory

Creates 5 Stasis Crystals in a straight line on impact, perpendicularly from where it was thrown.
Glacier Grenades' Stasis Crystals deal up to 158 [?] Stasis Grenade Damage upon being shattered, down to 66% damage over 8 meters.

entries.title: Shatter Grenade
entries.description:
Medium Trajectory | Sticky

Attaches to enemies, inflicting Freeze [x? Slow] on direct hits.
Explodes after ? seconds, dealing up to 325? [?] damage over ? meters and releasing 9 Tracking Stasis Shrapnel in 3 groups of 3, forming a Y shape.
Stasis Shrapnel deals 216 [?] damage and bounces up to ? times.
Sticking a Frozen Enemy causes an instantaneous explosion and increases the explosion damage by 100%.

Aspect — Touch of Winter: Creates 9 additional Shrapnel.
Hitting Frozen Enemies grants FPS-based Grenade Ability Energy.
42% at 30 FPS | 30% at 60FPS | 28% at 120+FPS

entries.title: Withering Blade
entries.description:
Innately has 2 Melee Ability Charges.

Quickly tosses a Stasis Shuriken towards enemies.
Shurikens are able to ricochet up to 3 times off of surfaces or towards up to 4 enemies, tracking towards enemies within 12 [8] meters.

Withering Blades deal 296 [72] damage and inflict x60 [x40] Slow for 3.5+3.5 [1.5+0.5] seconds on hit.

entries.title: Silence & Squall
entries.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [53%]

Silence
Deals 338 [847] impact damage and freezes enemies within 8.5 metres.

Squall
Deals 338 [847] impact damage, and creates a Stasis Storm on detonation.

Stasis Storm
Lasts 14+2 seconds, dealing 28 [14] damage and inflicting x20 Slow Stacks for 1 second every 0.1 [0.17] seconds for 6 seconds in a 5.5 meter radius.
Deals 300% increased damage against Non-Boss Frozen Enemies.

entries.title: Grim Harvest
entries.description:
Picking up Small Stasis Shards restores 10 HP and grants x1 Frost Armor.
Picking up Large Stasis Shards restore ? HP and grant x3 Frost Armor.

While Frost Armor is active:
Kinetic and Stasis Weapon Kills progress a counter that, upon reaching 100%, cause the kill to trigger a Stasis Shatter.

entries.title: Shatterdive
entries.description:
[Air Move] activates Shatterdive.

Shatterdive performs a dive, dealing up to 50 damage, and shattering frozen enemies and Stasis Crystals within 8.5 metres radius.

Shattering Stasis Crystals and Frozen Enemies grants maximum Frost Armor stacks.

Grants ?% Stasis Shatter Damage Resist and Fall Damage Immunity while diving.

entries.title: Touch of Winter
entries.description:
Enhances Stasis Grenades.

Coldsnap Grenade Seekers duplicate upon freezing an enemy. 
Seekers now spawn a Small, Medium, and Large Stasis Crystal on detonation upon chaining 1, 2, and 3 times respectively.

Duskfield Grenade create a Small Stasis Crystal on impact, and their Slowing Field has 50% Increased Radius.

Glacier Grenades form a heptagon hexagon, and creates an additional 2 Large Stasis Crystal.

Shatter Grenades release 9 additional Shrapnel and refund ~30% Grenade Ability Energy upon directly hitting a Frozen Enemy.

entries.title: Winter's Shroud
entries.description:
Upon inflicting Slow to an enemy:
Grants 300% [150%] Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate for 3 seconds.

On Class Ability Usage:
Inflicts x60 [x40] Slow for 8+4? [1.5+0.5] seconds to enemies within 9 [8] metres.
Grants 50% Damage Resist against Combatants for 4? seconds.

entries.title: Shiver Strike

Leaps through the air, performing an extended lunge distance melee upon releasing [Melee Attack].
Shiver Strike shatters Stasis Crystals on contact. 
Failing to score a hit will refund 80% [40%] Melee Ability Energy.

Deals 511 [105] impact damage on hit, heavily [moderately] knocking enemies back and inflicting x50 [x40] Slow.
Hits attach a delayed Stasis Explosive that deals up to 219 [?] explosive damage and inflicting x100 [x40] Slow after 1 second to enemies, down to 20% damage over 8 meters.
Both the Impact and Explosion benefit from Melee Damage Increases. Impact damage is non-lethal.
Guardians directly hit by Shiver Strike have their Melee Lunge disabled for 0.5 seconds.

entries.title: Glacial Quake
entries.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [47%]
Base Duration: 25 seconds, or 4% Super Drain per Second
Grants increased Jump Height and Cryoclasm has no cooldown while in Super.
On Super Cast: Freezes enemies within 8 [6] meters.
On Super End: Grants 3 Melee Ability Charges.
Scoring a kill through any means while Glacial Quake is active spawn an Orbs of Power, each granting 7.15% Ability Energy up to 7 times per Super Cast.

Leaps through the air forward, dealing 1,838 [210] impact damage and heavily knocking enemies back.
Hits attach a delayed Stasis Explosive that deals up to 897 [?] explosive damage, and inflicts x100? [x?] Slow after 1 second to enemies, down to 20% damage over 8 meters.
 Impact Damage is non-lethal.

Slams the ground, dealing 73 [50] damage and freezes over 9 meters, as well as creating 3 waves of Stasis Crystals, each composed of a Small, Medium and a Large Crystal.

entries.title: Cryoclasm
entries.description:
Sliding into Stasis Crystals and Frozen Enemies shatters them and other Frozen Enemies within ? meters instantly.

entries.title: Diamond Lance
entries.description:
Creates a Stasis Lance upon scoring 1 [3] Stasis Weapon Kills, a Stasis Ability Kill, or a Shatter Kill.

Stasis Lance is a single-use weapon that can be picked up while it is within 3 meters and can held for up to 10 seconds.

[Fire] throws the Stasis Lance, freezing enemies within 5 metres of the impact, shattering crystals on direct impact, and dealing 136 [45] damage. 
[Melee] slams the Stasis Lance, freezing enemies within 8 [6.75?] metres, dealing up to 180 [90] damage, and bestowing the user and their allies within ? meters x2 Frost Armor.

entries.title: Howl of the Storm

entries.title: Iceflare Bolts
entries.description:
Shattering a Frozen Enemy creates a seeker, targeting the closest enemy up to 12 metres away.
Seeker detonates upon reaching an enemy or expiring, freezing enemies within 3 [1.75] meters.

Incurs an 8 second cooldown after creating 7 [1] seekers.

entries.title: Tangle
entries.description:
While a Strand Ability is equipped:
 Killing an enemy affected by a Strand Debuff (Sever, Suspend, Unravel) spawns a Tangle, adhering to the standard cooldown. 

Strand Elemental Pickup:
Construct with ? HP that can exist for up to 20 seconds before dissipating.
Can be picked up while within 5 meters, and can be held for up to 20 seconds.
 Incurs a 12 second cooldown upon creating a Tangle before additional ones can be created, barring exceptions.

Detonating a Tangle through damaging it or throwing it creates an explosion, dealing 346 [100] damage over a 8 metre radius.
Either method counts as an Elemental Interaction for the purposes of perks and effects.

Grappling a Tangle fully refunds Grenade Energy and pulls the user towards it.

entries.title: Grapple Tangle
entries.description:
Tangle Equivalent that exclusively interacts with Grapple, behaving identically to a Tangle for Grappling.

Lasts for up to 20 seconds. Duration is refreshed by 5 seconds upon using Grapple on it. Cannot be destroyed, nor picked up.
Targeting a Grapple Tangle within 27 meters (32m with Grapple Grenade equipped) for 0.3 seconds overrides Grenade Ability to a Non-Offensive Grapple.
Strand and Prismatic Subclasses allow using Grapple Melee. Prismatic Warlocks need to equip Arcane Needle to receive Grapple Melee.

Grappling a Grapple Tangle 5 consecutive times reduces the duration refresh to 1 second.

entries.title: Threadling
entries.description:
Strand minions that chase enemies within 20? metres, leaping towards the targeted enemy upon being within ? metres.

Threadlings explode on contact or after leaping, dealing up to 366 [35] damage in a small radius.
Threadlings that lose their target before impact will land and look for another combatant instead of exploding.
Threadlings count as damage from the source they were spawned, but will lose that inheritance if they perch.

Warlock Interaction:
Threadlings return after travelling 14 metres if they do not start chasing an enemy, remaining perched on the Warlock, up to a maximum of 5 Threadlings. 
Threadlings are individually released upon dealing weapon damage or scoring a Melee Hit, with a 0.5 second cooldown between releases. 
Threadlings released this way will track at any range.

entries.title: Woven Mail
entries.description:
Grants 45% [25%] Damage Resist for 10 seconds. 
Precision Hits and Melee Attacks from Guardians bypass the Damage Resist.

Woven Mail is removed upon casting any Super Ability.

entries.title: Sever
entries.description: Decreases the enemy's outgoing damage dealt by 40% [15%] for 10+5 [5+2.5] seconds.

entries.title: Suspend
entries.description:
Suspended Combatants are unable to move, shoot, or use abilities.
Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants are suspended for up to 6+2 seconds. Minibosses are only suspended for up to 3+1 seconds.
Boss Combatants are unimpeded by suspension's effects, snapping out of them after 1 second, receiving instead 300 Strand Damage.
Boss Combatants still count as being afflicted by the Suspend debuff during its brief duration despite not receiving its effects.

Suspended Guardians are lifted midair, being able to slowly hover horizontally and hipfire their weapons for 2+1 seconds in a third-person perspective.

Unstoppable Champions are stunned upon being Suspended.

entries.title: Unravel
entries.description:
Unraveled Enemies release 3 seeking threads towards enemies within ? metres 0.25 seconds after receiving 40 damage.
Each Thread deals 26 [4] damage and applies Unravel on hit.
Unravel has a 1.2 second cooldown between thread releases. 

 Thread hits refresh the duration of Unravel, up to its original duration. 
(If the Unravel source applied a 9 second debuff, thread hits will reapply it to 9 seconds)

entries.title: Unraveling Rounds
entries.description: Strand Weapons apply Unravel upon dealing damage, and Barrier Champion Shields are able to be damaged while Unraveling Rounds are active, stunning the Champion when destroyed.

entries.title: Thread of Ascent
entries.description:
Using your Grenade Ability refills your readied weapon from reserves and grants the following stat bonuses for 15 seconds:
• 40? Handling
• 40 Reload Speed
• 0.925x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 30 Airborne Effectiveness

4 second cooldown between Magazine Refills.

0 Strand Debuffs generally last 50% longer.

entries.title: Thread of Generation
entries.description:
Dealing damage grants Grenade Ability Energy for each damage instance.

Grenade Ability Energy Gains vary depending on the source and the amount of damage dealt. Generally, more damage means more energy.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Thread of Isolation
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each applies 0 Sever to enemies within ? meters of the target.

Further hits are not counted for 4 seconds after an activation.

Activation Progress per Precision Hit:

• Bows, Sniper Rifles: 34%
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 25%
• Sidearms: 20%
• Auto Rifles: 15%
• Machine Guns, Pulse Rifles: 12%
• Submachine Guns, Trace Rifles: 10%

entries.title: Thread of Mind
entries.description:
Killing 0 Suspensded enemies grants Class Ability Energy based on Enemy Rank:

1? second cooldown between activations.

entries.description: Powered Melee Kills Grant 0 Unraveling Rounds to your 1 Strand Weapons for 8 [PVP: 5] seconds.

entries.title: Thread of Transmutation
entries.description:
Weapon Kills while you have 0 Woven Mail spawn a 1 Tangle at the target's location.

Shares the 12 second global 2 Tangle creation cooldown.

entries.title: Thread of Wisdom

Killing 0 Suspended enemies spawns an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy.

10 second cooldown between activations.

entries.title: Grapple
entries.description:
Hooks up to 22 metres away, dealing 38 [?] damage and staggering enemies on impact, as well as attaching to enemies or objects.
Cancelling a Grapple within 1 second of activation refunds 50% Grenade Energy.

Upon Grappling a Tangle or Grapple Tangle:
Fully refunds a Grapple Ability Charge and grants Grapple Returned for 4 seconds, allowing immediate reactivation if Grappling ends while the buff is active.
Grenade Kickstart does not activate when grappling a Tangle or Grapple Tangle.

Grapple Melee:
Performed by pressing [Melee Attack] while grappling, or for up to ? seconds after, while at a sufficiently fast speed.
Deals 432 [61] impact damage, and up to 432 [61] radial damage over a 4? metre radius, unraveling and pushing enemies back.

Grapple Melee counts as both a Grenade and Melee Ability.
Ashes to Assets grants 50% less Super Energy when a Grapple Melee is used with a Grapple Tangle.

Grapple Passive Ability Regeneration is disabled until no longer airborne. Also applies to Silkstrike.

Aspect — Mindspun Invocation: Grapple Melee creates 3 Threadlings on hit.

entries.title: Shackle Grenade
entries.description:
Bola Trajectory

Throws a bola, releasing an explosion on impact that deals 190 [?] damage and inflict Suspension in a ? metre radius to enemies hit, then releases smaller bolas.
2 Small Bolas are released on direct hit. 3 Smaller Bolas are released if they instead impact a surface.

Smaller Bolas are released towards nearby enemies, each dealing 81 [?] damage and inflicting Suspension on hit.

Aspect — Mindspun Invocation: Grants Weaver's Trance for 25 seconds.
Kills while Weaver's Trance is active cause the enemy to trigger a Suspending explosion on death.
Suspending Explosion deals 108 [?] Strand Grenade Ability Damage to enemies within 6 meters.

entries.title: Slicewire
entries.description:

Throws a bouncing grenade that explodes soon after impact, dealing splash damage over 4 hits and inflicting Sever for 10+5 seconds over 6 meters.

1st = 178 [?] | 2nd = 178 [?] | 3rd = 222 [?] | 4th = 267 [?] damage.

Ignores Tangle Creation Cooldown.

entries.title: Threadling Grenade
entries.description:

Splits into 3 projectiles while midair, each creating a Threadling on impact.

Aspect — Mindspun Invocation: Hold [Grenade] to prepare a Nest Grenade.
Nest Grenade creates a Teeming Nest on impact.

[Melee Attack] while the projectile is nearby to catch it.

1 | 10% | 30%
2 | 20% | 50%

5+ | 40% | 100%

Does not drain Super Energy.

 Allows the repeated usage of Ensnaring Slam while the Aspect is equipped at the cost of 4.5% Super Energy.

[Air Move] expends Class Ability Energy to dive downwards, dealing 61 [11] damage and inflicting Suspension to enemies within 8 [6.5] metres.

entries.title: Threaded Specter
entries.description:
On Class Ability Usage:
Spawns a Strand Decoy. 

Decoy has 175 Construct HP and lasts for up to 12 seconds. Combatants are lured to attack it, and has 70% Damage Resist against Combatants. 
Allies and Caster deal 150% increased Ability and Weapon Damage towards it.
Decoy always counts as hostile and can be damaged by allies, enemies, and the caster. Does not activate any On-Kill effect.

Upon losing all HP or when an enemy is within ? metres:
 Deals up to 600 [60 Guardians | 121 Objects] damage in a ? metre radius.

entries.title: Whirling Maelstrom

entries.title: Frenzied Blade
entries.description:
Innately has 3 Melee Ability Charges.
0 Charges = 1.15x Regeneration Speed | 1 Charge = 1.55x Regeneration Speed | 2 Charges = 1.95x Regeneration Speed.

entries.title: Bladefury
entries.description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [50%]
Base Duration: 24 seconds, or 4.167% Super Drain per Second
Grants 3 Melee Ability Charges on Super End.

Light Attack
Drains 3% Super Energy.
Performs a strengthened Frenzied Blade Melee that deals 851 [210] damage and can be infinitely chained.
Deals 25% increased damage against Suspended enemies. 
Attacks 3 times per second. Increases Attack Speed by 100% after chaining 3 sustained light attacks. 
Performing a Heavy Attack, or failing to maintain a Light Attack chain will remove the Attack Speed Increase.

Heavy Attack
Drains 10.5% Super Energy. Incurs a 3 second cooldown after usage.
Hurls a pair of Suspending projectiles forward that home in towards enemies, dealing 143 x 2 [61] impact damage, and up to 608 x 2 [36] splash damage over ? meters.
Light Attack Hits reduce the cooldown by 1 second. Receiving any damage reduces the cooldown by 1 second.

entries.title: Banner of War
entries.description:
Upon scoring a Sword Kill, Melee Kill, Glaive Melee Kill, Super Light Attack Kill, or Finisher:
Raises a Banner of War for 15 seconds, buffing the user and nearby allies within 10 metres. 
Kills scored by the user or nearby allies empower and extend the duration of Banner of War, up to a maximum of x4 Banner of War and 30 seconds.

Banner of War:
Lasts for 15 seconds, up to a maximum of 24 seconds.

Kills increase the duration by +5 seconds. Each stack after the second decreases the duration extension by -1, down to +3 seconds per kill at x4 stacks.
Periodically restores 20 HP every 2.5 seconds. Each stack after the first decreases the delay between pulses by 0.5 second, down to 1 second at x4 stacks.
Grants 100% [Varies] Increased Melee Damage, 40% Increased Bladefury Damage, and 20% Increased Sword Damage.
[x1 = ?% Inc. Melee DMG | x2 = ?% | x3 = ?% | x4 = ?%]

x1 | +6 seconds | 7 [2] Kills | 2.5 seconds
x2 | +5 seconds | 7 [2] Kills | 2 seconds
x3 | +4 seconds | 7 [2] Kills | 1.5 seconds
x4 | +3 seconds | - | 1 second

entries.title: Drengr's Lash
entries.description:
Killing Elementally-Debuffed Enemies grants ?% Class Ability Energy.

Unleashes a Strand Lash forward that travels up to 30 metres away.

entries.title: Flechette Storm

[Melee Ability] while airborne to chain additional throws.

300% [200%] Additional Base Melee Regeneration Rate.

entries.title: Weaver's Call

entries.title: Weavewalk

entries.title: Transcendence
entries.description:
Unique ability obtained upon utilizing enough Light and Darkness damage types.
Kinetic Damage fills both Light and Darkness bars at 50% decreased rate. Overkill Damage isn't counted for Transcendence gains.
Having one full Alignment bar makes Kinetic Damage fill the remaining bar with at 40% decreased rate.

Dealing Melee Ability Damage while Transcendent increases the Prismatic Grenade Regeneration Speed to 35% Prismatic Grenade Ability Energy per second for 2 seconds.

Kills while Transcendent extend its duration, with the amount extended decreasing as more kills are scored.
Tier 1 and T2 Combatants = 5% | T3 and T4 = 10% | T3 Elites, Minibosses and Bosses = 15% | Guardians = ?%
Each kill after the first gets a cumulative 0.9?x penalty to the duration extension.

entries.title: Elemental Effects
entries.description:
Elemental Effects include all of the verbs that subclasses apply that can either positively (Buff) or negatively (Debuff) affect a target.

Equipping any Arc Ability or Aspect allows Amplified to be activated by scoring multiple Arc Kills. Thruster does not count as an Arc Ability.
Equipping any Strand Ability or Aspect allows the creation of Tangles, and Warlocks are able to possess Perched Threadlings.

Void = ↑Devour ↑Invisibility ↑Void Overshield ↓Suppression ↓Volatile ↓Weaken | Void Breach

 Strand = ↑Woven Mail ↓Sever ↓Suspend ↓Unravel | Tangle

entries.title: Facet of Awakening
entries.description:
Scoring a Super Kill or Killing 3 enemies with Elemental Damage within 6 seconds of each spawns an Elemental Pickup.

Points gained per Kill by Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 10 points
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 15 points
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 20 points
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites: 34 points
• T4 Elites, Minibosses: 40 points
• Bosses: 50 points
• Players: ? points

entries.title: Facet of Grace
entries.description:
Kinetic Weapon Kills grant an additional 2% [PVP: ?%] Light and Darkness Transcendence energy.

Super Kills grant an additional 2% [PVP: ?%] Light and Darkness Transcendence Energy to you and allies within ? metres.

entries.title: Facet of Honor
entries.description:
Collecting Elemental Pickups or destroying a 0 Tangle grants additional Transcendence Energy of the matching alignment:
• 1 Ionic Traces, 2 Firesprites, 3 Void Breaches: 7.5% Light Transcendence Energy
• 4 Stasis Shards: 5% Darkness Transcendence Energy
• 5 Tangles: 10% Darkness Transcendence Energy

entries.title: Facet of Hope
entries.description:
Having an active elemental buff grants an additional 40% Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate.

Having 2+ active elemental buffs grants an additional 60% instead.

entries.title: Facet of Justice
entries.description: Ability Kills while Transcendent trigger an explosion that deals up to 130 [PVP: ?] Ability-Matching Elemental damage in a ? meter radius.

entries.title: Facet of Mending
entries.description:
Grenade Ability Kills grant you 0 Cure x1.

Prismatic Grenade Kills grant you 1 Cure x2.

entries.title: Facet of Protection
entries.description:
Grants 15% [PVP: ?%] Damage Resistance while within 15 meters of 3 enemies.

The Damage Resistance is NOT increased while Transcendent, it simply stacks with Transcendence's 20% Damage Resistance for a total of 32%.

entries.title: Facet of Purpose
entries.description:
Collecting Orbs of Power grants Elemental buffs based on your equipped Super's element:
• 0 Arc: 1 1 Bolt Charge Stack
• 2 Solar: 3 Restoration x1 for 5 seconds
• 4 Void: 22.5 HP 5 Overshield for 5 seconds
• 6 Stasis: 2 7 Frost Armor Stacks for 9 seconds
• 8 Strand: 9 Woven Mail for 5 seconds

entries.title: Facet of Ruin
entries.description:
0 Ignitions have a 25% increased blast radius.

1 Shattering enemies or destroying 2 Crystals creates an additional damage instance, dealing up to 25 [PVP: 9] damage in a 10 [PVP: 8] meter radius.

Damage falls off to 17 [PVP: 4] damage at the edge of the radius.

entries.title: Facet of Sacrifice
entries.description: Ability Kills with an active 0 Arc, 1 Solar, or 2 Void Elemental buff grant an additional 1% [PVP: ?%] Darkness Transcendence Energy.

entries.title: Facet of Solitude
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each causes your next damage instance within 3 seconds (from any source) to trigger a 0 Severing Burst.

1 Severing Burst applies 2 Sever to enemies in a 3 meter radius. Radius is increased to 6 meters while Transcendent.

Further Precision Hits within 4 seconds of an activation provide no activation progress.

Precision Hits required to prepare the Severing Burst:
• 20% of magazine size rounded down + 1
• Bows require 2 hits

entries.title: Facet of Hailfire Spike
entries.description:
Prismatic Grenade

Attaches to surfaces or enemies, releasing a torrent of Stasis and Solar energy in a cone up to ? meters away.

Erupts into a slowing storm, dealing up to 78 [?] damage upon erupting.
Slowing storm deals 15.6 [?] Stasis Damage and inflicts x13? Slow every 0.25 seconds for 3.45 seconds.

After 3.45 seconds of attaching, it releases a scorching cyclone that deals 39 [?] Solar Damage and inflicts x10 Scorch every 0.25 seconds for 4 seconds.

entries.title: Facet of Arcbolt Grenade
entries.description: Swarm Grenade

entries.title: Facet of Combination Blow
entries.description: Knife Trick

entries.title: Electrified Snare
entries.description:
Prismatic Grenade

Explosive charged with Arc and Strand energy.
Explodes in a supercharged suspending burst, dealing up to 105 [?] damage, and inflicting Suspension to enemies within ? meters.
Suspended Enemies are dealt ? damage every ? seconds for ? seconds, and are inflicted Jolt.

entries.title: Freezing Singularity
entries.description:
Prismatic Grenade

Deals up to 70 [26] Void Damage on impact, pulling enemies within 12 meters towards it, and creating a miniature black hole orbited by a halo of slowing ice.

The slowing field deals 18 [4] Stasis Damage and inflicts x13? Slow every 0.25 seconds for 3.65 seconds to enemies within 6 meters.

After 5 seconds of impacting, the black hole implodes, infliction suppression and dealing up to 570 [150] Void Damage to enemies within 7 meters.

entries.title: Heavy Ammo Finder
entries.description: Grants a 1.33x|1.66x|2x multiplier to all Heavy Ammo Meter progress with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Weft Cutter
entries.description: 20 Direct Hits on a target within 1 second of each other applies 0 Sever for 10 seconds (15 seconds with 1 Thread of Continuity) and grants you 2 Woven Mail for 10 seconds.

entries.title: Chaotic Exchanger
entries.description:
Grants 20% Damage Resistance while overcharging a 0 Void Grenade with 1 Chaos Accelerant.

Overcharged Grenade Hits apply 2 Weaken for 6 seconds and grant additional base grenade Regeneration Rate depending on the equipped grenade for 1.75 seconds.

• Axion: 5000% [PVP: 4000%]
• Scatter: 3700% [PVP: 2700%]
• Vortex: 3400% [PVP: 2400%]
• Handheld Supernova: 2500% [PVP: 2000%]

4 second cooldown between activations, which is removed on grenade usage. Grants between 50-60% Grenade energy per activation.

3 Vortex Grenades can proc twice if enemies get hit by the initial explosion and the last few ticks.

entries.title: Powerful Attraction
entries.description:
Class Ability usage collects certain pickups within 12.5|18.5 meters with 1|2+ Mods equipped.

Applicable pickups:
• Orbs of Power
• Motes of Light in Gambit
• Crests in Supremacy
• Data Motes in Episode: Echoes activities

entries.title: Iron Grip
entries.description: Passively increases Stability by 20 but decreases Reload Speed by 20.

entries.title: Adrenaline Junkie
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Adrenaline Junkie for 4.5 seconds. Grenade Kills grant all 5 Stacks instantly even if the weapon is stowed.

Adrenaline Junkie benefits:
• 20 Handling
• 6.7%|13.3%|20%|26.6%|33.3% increased damage at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks

entries.title: Kinetic Weapon Surge
entries.description:
Increases Kinetic Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage

The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.

Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.title: Nano-Munitions
entries.description:
While within 15 meters of an ally:
Grants a stack of Nano-Munitions every 3 seconds. Maximum of 7 stacks.

Emptying this weapon's magazine consumes a stack to refill 25% of your magazine (rounded up). Consuming a stack restarts the timer for gaining new stacks.

Emptying the magazine of any other weapon consumes all stacks, with each stack refilling 25% of your Magazine (rounded up). Holding a weapon with an empty magazine also consumes these stacks.

Heat weapons confuse the perk in unexpected and inconsistent ways, and all stacks may be consumed at random while using one.

entries.title: Box Breathing
entries.description:
Aiming Down Sights for 🡅1.4 seconds without firing grants the following for a single shot:
• 10% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• 40% increased precision damage (35% for 0 Scout Rifles, 30% for 1 Heavy Ammo Sniper Rifles)

Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.

For glaives (Greasy Luck), the projectile must strike the target's critical hitbox in order to recieve the 40% [PVP: 35%] damage bonus.

🡅 Activation time is decreased by 0.1 seconds.

entries.title: Gift of the Traveler
entries.description: Gain 15 Handling, 15 Reload Speed, and 2 Aim Assist for each stack of Gathering Light.

entries.title: Quicksilver Storm Catalyst
entries.description:
Converts this weapon's element into 0 Strand damage.

Kills with Grenade Chaser grenades spawn a 1 Tangle.

entries.title: Empowering Rift
entries.description:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.

Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.

Grants the following benefits to you and allies within the rift:
• 20% [PVP: 15%] Increased Damage (Empowering Buff)
• 260% [PVP: 104%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate
• 230% [PVP: 92%] Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate
• Kills generate 15% Increased Ammo Meter Progress

entries.title: Healing Rift
entries.description:
Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.

Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.

Heals you and allies in the Rift for 40 [PVP: 35] HP per second.

If at full health, the Rift grants 3 HP of Overshield per second, up to a 15 HP Overshield.

Standing in a friendly Healing Rift makes the game count you as having an active Overshield at all times.

entries.title: Dual Loader
entries.description: Reloading loads 1 additional round into the magazine at a time.

entries.title: The Scientific Method
entries.description: Dealing damage grants 'Scientific Method' for 5 seconds, granting 35 Handling and maximized Movement Speed. Buff cannot be refreshed.

entries.title: Sword Logic
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant Stacks of Sword Logic.

The number of Stacks and the buff duration are tied to the highest Enemy Rank killed since activation:
• Minors: 1 Stack for 5.5 seconds
• Elites, Players: 2 Stacks for 7.5 seconds
• Players in their Super and Minibosses: 3 Stacks for 10.5 seconds
• Bosses: 4 Stacks for 15.5 seconds

Damage increase at 1|2|3|4 Stacks:
15% | 25% [PVP: 15%] | 35% | 50%

Additional Kills refresh the buff duration to the duration tied to the highest Enemy Rank killed.

entries.title: The Right Choice
entries.description:
Counts as a "Dealer's Choice" origin trait weapon, but does not benefit from the trait itself.

Every 7th shot in the magazine deals 252.52% [PVP: 5%] increased damage, has 50% increased Auto Aim cone size, and ricochets to the nearest target within an 8 [PVP: 5] meter radius.

entries.title: Reaper
entries.description:
The next Weapon Kill within 10 seconds of using your Class Ability spawns an Orb of Power that grants 0.8%|1.1%|1.25%|1.5% Super Energy with 1|2|3|4 Mods equipped. (4 Mods is only achievable through Exotic Armor)

10|5|1|1? second cooldown between activations with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Opening Shot
entries.description:
Grants the following benefits for your first shot (of the burst):
• 20 Aim Assist and 25 Range
• 5% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 10% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth

0 Special weapons only receive 50% of the benefits. Stats are rounded up.

Firing the weapon prevents the perk from activating for 3 seconds.

entries.title: Shield Break Charge
entries.description: Breaking a Combatant Shield with the matching Elemental Damage Type grants 1 Stack of Armor Charge.

entries.title: CQC Optics: High
entries.description:
Passively increases Zoom by 1.

Increasing Zoom has the following effects in ADS:
• Increased Magnification
• Increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• Decreased Absolute Recoil
• Narrowed Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones (size stays the same on-screen)

entries.title: Solar Scavenger
entries.description:
Only works in PvE game modes.

Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to 0 Solar Weapons matching the Ammo Type.

Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.

Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.

Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.title: Gravity Well
entries.description:
Finishing a reload picks up all Ammo Bricks within 15 meters.

Also works on Motes and Crests.

entries.title: Permeability
entries.description:
Class Ability usage refills ?% of your Magazine (rounded up) from reserves and changes the weapon's element to match your Super Ability until stowed.

Magazine Refill cannot be triggered again without stowing the weapon first.

Kinetic weapons lose their Passive Damage Bonus against non-Boss PVE Combatants (10% on 0 Primary, 15% on 1 Special).

🡅 Passively grants 5 Handling.

entries.title: Explosive Payload
entries.description:
Splits off 50% of the weapon's bodyshot damage into an Explosive Payload that detonates on impact.

The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more. On Hand Cannons, the Payload deals 7% decreased damage in PvP.

The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.

[PvE] Total damage is increased by 15% of the weapon's bodyshot damage. For crits, the overall increase is roughly equal to 15% divided by the Crit Multiplier.

[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.

🡅 Passively grants 5 Reload Speed.

entries.title: Supercharged Magazine
entries.description:
Refills 5% of the magazine (rounded up) every 1.5 seconds while 0 Amplified.

Activating 1 Speed Booster increases this rate to once every 0.25 seconds, and allows the perk to overfill the magazine up to double its base capacity.

🡅 Passively grants 15 Magazine stat. (Equivalent of 50% of Backup Mag's Magazine stat benefit)

entries.title: Fleet Footed
entries.description:
Dealing damage grants 15 Airborne Effectiveness and ?% increased Movement Speed for 5 seconds.

Scoring a Weapon Kill increases this to 30 Airborne Effectiveness and ?% increased Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Weapon damage refreshes buff duration.

entries.title: Weighted Edge
entries.description:
When the magazine has at least 1 round loaded, Glaive Melee Attacks deal 50% increased damage and apply 0 40 Slow for 4 [PVP: 1.5] seconds (8 [PVP: 1.5] with 1 Whisper of Durance).

Bosses only receive 20% increased damage.

entries.title: Final Warning Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 10% increased damage to marked targets. Minibosses and Bosses only receive 5% more damage.

Hits against marked Minors and Elites|Minibosses and Bosses have an 85%|25% chance to refund one ammo into the magazine.

entries.title: Psychohack
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Hits on targets Exhausts them. Triggering it on Players makes them deal 10% less damage.

Exhaust duration cannot be refreshed.

Hit Requirements by Weapon Type:
• 3 Hits: Bows, Glaives (both Projectile and Melee), Grenade/Rocket Launchers (Impact and Detonation damage count separately), Sniper Rifles
• 7 Hits: Scout Rifles
• 12 Hits: Sidearms
• 13 Hits: Submachine Guns
• 14 Hits: Fusion Rifles
• 16 Hits: Auto Rifles

entries.title: One Thousand Voices Catalyst
entries.description:
I gain 30 Stability and 20 Ammo Generation.

Each of my detonations release a Taken Seeker which aggressively tracks and burrows into nearby targets, dealing 22 ticks of damage, one tick every 0.25 seconds, for 5.65 seconds.

My Taken Seekers can stun 0 Overload Champions.

My foes can be afflicted by up to 5 seekers at once, and Blighted Enemies (directly impacted by Witherhoard) take 100% increased tick damage.

I do not interact with Malfeasance or Wish-Ender.

▛ Most of those who bargain with me do not win... ▟

entries.title: Empowered Finish
entries.description: Finishers with no active Armor Charge Stacks grant 1 Stack of Armor Charge.

entries.title: Ranged Weapon
entries.description:
Deals 50% increased damage to PvE Combatant Shields and 200% increased damage to 0 Barrier Champion shields.

Melee Hits can discharge 1 Bolt Charge stacks.

Tapping [Heavy Attack] throws your blade up to 50 meters away, seeking up to 3 enemies before returning. Blade deals 945 [PVP: 174] damage to each target and 80% reduced damage while returning. Pressing [Light Attack] recalls the blade early.

Holding [Heavy Attack] throws your blade 20 meters forward in a straight unguided path and increases its damage by 100%.

With Gyro Core Equipped: Thrown Blade Hits apply elemental effects matching your subclass:
• 2 Grants x1 Bolt Charge
• 3 35? Scorch (50? with 4 Ember of Ashes). Stacks vary? between the two heavy attacks
• 5 Weakens for 6 seconds
• 6 50 Slow for 4 seconds (8 with 7 Whisper of Durance). Stacks vary? between the two heavy attacks
• 8 Severs for 10 seconds (15 with 9 Thread of Continuity)

entries.title: Hungering Quarrel
entries.description: Fires two 0 Void Bolts that heal on hit for 11 HP each.

entries.title: Onslaught
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of 'Onslaught' for 4.5 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

Benefits at 1|2|3 Stacks of Onslaught:
• 16.7% | 28.6% | 37.5% decreased Firing Delay
• 15 | 25 | 35 Reload Speed

entries.title: Strand Loader
entries.description:
Grants the following to 0 Strand Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Arc Targeting
entries.description:
Grants the following to 0 Arc Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Hatchling
entries.description:
Scoring a Precision Kill or 3 kills within 3 seconds of each other spawns a 0 Threadling at the target's location.

🡅 Spawns an additional hatchling every ? activations.

entries.title: Void/Strand Dual Siphon
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a 0 Void or 1 Strand Weapon.

Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Reaper's Tithe
entries.description:
Grants stacks of 'Reaper's Tithe' based on the number of simultaneously killed enemies. Maximum of 4 stacks. (e.g. triple kill ⇒ 3 stacks)

'Reaper's Tithe' grants 20%|30%|40% increased damage for 15 seconds at 2|3|4 stacks (1st stack does not exist). Timer only starts after firing.

Additional Weapon Kills extend the buff duration by 6 seconds, but not beyond the initial 15-second duration.

Scoring a higher number of simultaneous Kills than the currently active stack count will not "upgrade" the buff.

entries.title: The Dance
entries.description:
Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness to 0 Primary Weapons.

Grants the following benefits while a 1 Primary Weapon is readied and not Aiming Down Sights:
• 30 Mobility
• 5 Range and 30? Stability
• 70% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 2 degrees increased Precision Aim Cone Angle
• 20% increased Aim Assist and Damage Falloff Distance

DMT, Last Word, and Tommy's Matchbook are uniquely tuned and do not receive as significant of a benefit.

2 Primary Weapon Kills grant Class Ability Energy based on Enemy Rank:
Minors: 34% | Elites and higher: 100% | Players: 20%

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

At full Class Ability energy, scoring multiple 3 Primary Weapon Kills within 6 seconds of each grants an additional Class Ability Charge. Maximum of 2 extra charges.

Activation progress granted by Enemy Rank:
Minors: 34% | Elites and higher: 100% | Players: 100%

entries.title: Adept Accuracy
entries.description: Passively grants 10 Accuracy.

entries.title: Runneth Over
entries.description:
While within 15 meters of allies:
• Finishing a reload overfills the Magazine from reserves by 10% of the Base Magazine Capacity (rounded up) for each ally
• Bows receive 7.5%|15%|17.5%|20%|25% decreased Draw Time for 1|2|3|4|5+? allies
• Swords receive increased Charge Rate

entries.title: Adhesive Ordnance
entries.description:
Picking up an Ammo Brick causes the next shot fired to attach a Sticky Bomb on impact.

Sticky Bomb detonates after 0.8 seconds, dealing up to 🡅410 [PVP: ?] Kinetic Damage and Exhausting targets in 6 meter radius. Damage falls off to 50% at the edge of the radius.

Sticky Bombs inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling.

🡅 Increases Sticky Bomb damage.

entries.title: Hierarchy of Needs Catalyst
entries.description:
Deploying a Guidance Ring or Guidance Seeker Hits grants the following benefits for 5 seconds:
• 40% reduced Hip-Fire Accuracy Cone
• 50% decreased Draw Time
• 100 Reload Speed
• ?% decreased Reload Animation Duration

entries.title: Headstone
entries.description:
Precision Kills create a Large 0 Stasis Crystal at the target's location.

Tier 1-2 Minor and Tier 1 Elite Combatants only spawn a Medium 1 Stasis Crystal.

Creating 5 2 Crystals within ? seconds prevents the perk from activating for 5 seconds.

entries.title: Dynamic Charge
entries.description:
Precision Hits and Kills grant one stack of 'Dynamic Charge'. Maximum of 15 stacks.

Holding [Reload] refills the magazine based on the number of stacks and converts them into 'Revolution' stacks. Switching modes again removes all stacks.

Revolution stacks remain ready until fired, after which point they last 10 seconds. Arc Seekers gain 30% [PVP: Varying] increased damage per stack of Revolution, up to 450% increased damage.

Arc Seekers also gain a non-linear increase to their splash radius, granting 33%|233% increased splash radius at x10|x20 Stacks (up to 4|7 meters in radius).

While Revolution's timer is active, Arc Seekers generate x2 0 Bolt Charge for each hit and gain the ability to discharge 1 Bolt Charge stacks. At or above 10 stacks of Revolution, hits generate x3 2 Bolt Charge.

3 Bolt Charge generation is unaffected by 4 Spark of Frequency.

Review this exotic's intrinsic perk to learn a special note about the 5 Bolt Charge behavior from this gun.

entries.title: Reversal of Fortune
entries.description: Missing twice within 6 seconds refills 1 round into the Magazine from thin air.

entries.title: Sleeper Simulant Catalyst
entries.description: Increases Reserves by 2 (14🠚16) and decreases Charge Time by 33% (1024🠚774) without reducing damage.

entries.title: Whirlwind Blade
entries.description:
Powered Sword Hits grant 3% increased damage for 🡅4 seconds. Stacks 10 times for a 30% Buff.

Stowing the weapon or Blocking removes all stacks. Wolfpack Round Hits also count as Powered Sword Hits.

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.title: Mulligan
entries.description:
Missing has a chance to refund 1 ammo into the magazine based on the ammo type:
• 0 Primary Weapons: 🡅40%
• 1 Special and 2 Power Weapons: 🡅25%

🡅 Ammo Refund chance is increased by an additive 5%.

entries.title: Nanotech Tracer Missiles
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Hits within 6 seconds of each fires a Tracking Rocket that matches the weapon's element.

Rockets deal 22.4 [PVP: 14] Impact and 24 [PVP: 15] Explosive damage on Hit and inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling. On non-primary weapons, the Rockets receive an additional damage increase.

% of magazine capacity as Hits required and the additional damage increase by weapon archetype:
• Hand Cannons, Pulse Rifles, Submachine Guns: 45% Magazine Capacity \\ 0% increased damage (Baseline)
• Sniper Rifles: 50%? \\ 100%
• Grenade Launchers: 30% \\ 25%
• Machine Guns: 25% \\ 50%
• Fusion Rifles, Shotguns: ?% \\ 150%

1 second cooldown after activation before further Hits provide activation progress again.

entries.title: Dragonfly
entries.description:
Precision Kills cause targets to explode, dealing up to 123.89 [PVP: 95.3] weapon-matching elemental damage in a 4.5-meter radius.

🡅 Increases detonation damage by 10%.

entries.title: For the Empire
entries.description: Deals 11% increased damage against Cabal enemies and pierces through Phalanx Shields and Cabal Shield Domes.

entries.title: Under-Over
entries.description:
Increases damage against shielded targets:
• 🡅140% increase against PVE Combatant Overshields
• 🡅55% increase against PVE Combatant Elemental Shields and 0 Barrier Champion Shields
• 🡅22% increase against Player Overshields and for bodyshots against Players with 1 Woven Mail

Notable Combatant Overshields include Shadow Legion Tech Pack and Lucent Moth Overshields. They are indicated with a glowing outline around the targets as well as a small blue health bar under the normal one.

Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

🡅 Damage Buff is increased: 125%⁠🠚⁠140%, 50%⁠🠚⁠55%, 20%⁠🠚⁠22?⁠%.

entries.title: Volatile Battery
entries.description:
Sets the Magazine Size to 33, greatly exceeding that of any other fusion rifle.

▛ ...an energy cell pulling from multiple timelines, resulting in a charge surplus that can only be explained if the firing cycle began in... ▟

entries.title: Glacial Guard
entries.description:
Requires a 0 Stasis Super Ability to be equipped. Overwrites Barricade Cooldown to Pre-EoF values, resulting in ~1.45x faster Base Class Ability Regeneration.

Scoring 2 1 Stasis Kills within 3 seconds of each grants a Stack of 2 Frost Armor.

Restores 10 HP for each Stack of 3 Frost Armor you gain from any source.

Replaces Barricade with Glacial Guard which has a cooldown matching Towering Barricade's. Does not work with 4 Thruster.

On Glacial Guard Cast:
• Grants you maximum 5 Frost Armor Stacks (restoring HP for each Stack gained)
• Applies 100 [PVP: 40] 6 Slow to enemies within ? meters

entries.title: Halberdier's Reach
entries.description:
Glaive Melee Kills load 1 Ammo into the Magazine from reserves. Can overfill the Magazine up to double the normal capacity.

While within 15 meters of 3 enemies:
Grants 50 Reload Speed and 200% increased Glaive Melee Damage.

Glaive Projectile Kills cause enemies to explode, dealing up to 350 [PVP: 101] weapon-matching elemental damage in a 4? meter radius.

entries.title: Slideshot
entries.description:
Sliding refills 15% of the Magazine (rounded up) and grants 🡅22 Range and Stability for your next shot (of the burst) within 2.5 seconds.

0.3 second cooldown after activation but can activate multiple times during a slide. Buff is removed on stow.

🡅 Stat bonuses are increased by 2?.

entries.title: Ambush
entries.description:
Grants the following benefits if you have not dealt or received damage in the last 5 seconds:
• 20 Range and 20 Handling
• 15% decreased Draw Time on Bows
• 10.78% increased damage against PvE Combatants. Linear Fusion Rifles only receive an 8.88% damage increase.

Deactivates 2 seconds after exchanging damage.

entries.title: Stasis Dexterity
entries.description:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to 0 Stasis Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.title: Butterfly
entries.description:
Aiming Down Sights for 1.5 seconds without firing causes your next kill to trigger an explosion matching the weapon's element within an 8 meter radius, experiencing a maximum of 30% damage falloff.

Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.

entries.title: Lightning Rod
entries.description:
Precision Kills grant 'Lightning Rod'.

Lightning Rod arrows explode on impact and chain lightning in an 8 meter radius around their point of impact for 194 [PVP: 50.3] damage each.

entries.title: Archer's Tempo
entries.description:
Precision Hits decrease Draw Time by 25% for 3 seconds.

Buff is removed on stow.

entries.title: Pulse Monitor
entries.description:
Refills Magazine from reserves upon dropping to 30% Shield Health. Can activate while stowed.

Grants 50 Handling and a 0.95x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier while at or below 30% Shield Health.

Buff lingers for 1 second once the condition is no longer met.

entries.title: Paracausal Shot
entries.description:
On kill or Precision Hit, gain one stack of Paracausal Charge. Maximum of 7 stacks. Stacks are removed on reload or any full magazine refill.

Paracausal Charge grants increased damage against Combatants at 1|2|3|....|7| Stacks:
21%|36.5%|48%|55%|60%|63%|66%

Paracausal Charge turns into Paracausal Shot on the final round of the magazine. Buff is removed if stowed.

Paracausal Shot's damage bonus at 1|2|3|...|7| stacks:
PvE: 292%|300%|340%|425%|667%|1071%|1736%
PvP: 30%|33%|46%|80.5%|154%|288%|509%

entries.title: Snareweaver
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant one charge of Snareweaver. Kills grant charges based on Combatant Rank. Maximum of 6 charges. Charges can be earned simultaneously.

Charge progress from kills:
• Minors: 1
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 2
• Players: 3

At full charge, hip-fired shots spawn a 'Snareweaver Trap' on impact. Direct Hits 0 Suspend the target and deploy the trap under them.

Snareweaver traps form into 6 linked wires that last for 15 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with any wire take 341 [PVP: 5] damage and are 1 Suspended. Each wire can Suspend up to 2 targets. A maximum of 6 enemies can be Suspended at once within a trap.

5 second cooldown between 2 Suspends on the same enemy.

3 Suspension lasts 6 seconds (8 with 4 Thread of Continuity). Suspend duration is halved against Minibosses.

entries.title: Precision Frame
entries.description: This weapon fires a small auto-tracking missile. Missiles lock onto targets when aimed.

entries.title: The Master
entries.description:
Rounds must be chambered after every shot. Animation can be sprint-cancelled as soon as the bolt is drawn in (at the 'clink'), allowing for an increased rate of fire.

Scoring a Precision Hit grants one stack of 'The Master' up to an infinite amount, with effective benefits ending after 20 stacks. Shots visually explode after 20 stacks with no added benefit.

Grants diminishing increases to Precision Damage across 1|2|3|....|20 stacks:
• Stacks 1-5: 16%|22%|27%|31%|35%
• Stacks 6-10: 38%|41%|44%|47%|49.5%
• Stacks 11-15: 52%|54%|56.5%|59%
• Stacks 16-20: 63%|64.5%|66%|68%|70%

Buff persists until death.

entries.title: Sundering
entries.description:
Grants the following for 7 seconds upon breaking an enemy's shield or destroying a Vehicle or Construct:
• 40 Reload Speed
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 0.9x Draw Time Multiplier

entries.title: Detonator Beam
entries.description:
Scoring 🡅20 Hits within ? seconds of each triggers an explosion around the target, dealing up to 250 [PVP: ?] weapon element-matching damage in an 8 meter radius.

🡅 Number of Hits required is decreased by 5.

entries.title: Overclocked Heatsink
entries.description:
Passively grants 2% increased damage and 10 decreased Cooling Efficiency stat.

🡅 Passively grants 2 Handling.

entries.title: Soaring Fang
entries.description:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

While grounded, hits grant 1.5% charge to your Anti-Grav Repulsors. Kills grant 10% charge.

Once you are above 3% charge, hits after being airborne for 0.5 seconds activate 'Hover Mode'. Hover Mode is disengaged by Holding [Reload], reaching 0% charge, or stowing the weapon.

Hover Mode removes all airborne accuracy penalties, reduces combatant accuracy (similar to 0 Amplified's effects), and grants complete aerial movement at a speed of 5.5 meters per second.

Hover Mode starts at 3 seconds. Each hit restores 0.3 seconds to the timer. Timer cannot exceed 3 seconds.

entries.title: Adept Blast Radius
entries.description: Passively grants 10 Blast Radius.

entries.title: Osteo Striga Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 30 Reload and 20 Stability.

Poison Kills instantly refill the magazine and can overfill it up to 300% total capacity.

0.5 second cooldown between activations.

entries.title: Apollonic Tangent
entries.description:
While at 3 stacks, hip-firing a fully-drawn arrow spawns a Guidance Ring.

Guidance Ring lasts 20 seconds and will rotate in place to face you. Only one Guidance Ring per-guardian can exist at a time, but up to 3 Guidance Rings can exist across a fireteam. Each Guidance Ring can stack.

Firing any fully-drawn arrow through the Guidance Ring triggers several additional seeking projectiles, each dealing 192 [PVP: 15] damage. Seekers gain 50% [PVP: 15-20%] increased damage past 40 meters and have a maximum range of 80 meters. Precision hits with the fired arrow guide the seekers towards that enemy.

Each seeker applies 15 0 Scorch (20 with 1 Ember of Ashes) and deals Weapon-Element Matching Explosive Damage in a 4 meter radius.

Guidance Rings grant their benefits to any Combat Bow, including Legendaries, Exotics, Heavy Crossbows, 2 Shadowshot, and also Buried Bloodline.

Arrows fired by Hierarchy of Needs release three seekers, while most other bows release two. Casting 3 Shadowshot: Deadfall releases six.

entries.title: Service of Luzaku Catalyst
entries.description:
Teeming Nests can be harvested into a collectible 0 Tangle after spawning 6 1 Threadlings. This destroys the nest.

These tangles ignore the global 2 Tangle cooldown.

entries.title: Peregrine Strike
entries.description:
Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness.

Grants Peregrine Strike after sprinting for 2 seconds and being airborne for 0.5 seconds. Buff is removed upon touching the ground.

Peregrine Strike increases the impact damage of Shoulder Charge Melee Abilities by 250%.

Against Minibosses, the buff is increased to 550% and refunds your Melee Ability charge on hit.

Shoulder Charge abilities: 0 Seismic Strike, 1 Hammer Strike, and 2 Shield Bash

Provides no benefits when hitting 3 Frozen enemies.

entries.title: Vanishing Execution
entries.description:
Powered Melee Kills and Finishers grant 0 Invisibility and restore 67 HP.

Invisibility Duration is based on Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 7 seconds
• Elites, Enemy Players: 10 seconds
• Minibosses and Bosses: 13 seconds

The duration of 1 Invisibility granted by Finishers is 3 seconds longer. 2 Echo of Persistence increases 3 Invisibility duration by 41.5%.

entries.title: Reflective Vents
entries.description:
Upon sliding after sprinting for at least 1.5 seconds with your Class Ability fully charged:
Projects a 180° frontal shield that reflects all incoming projectiles for 0.45 seconds.

Reflected projectiles deal 50% increased damage.

After shield deactivation, 2% Class Ability energy is drained for every point of damage reflected.

Currently partially bugged and does not drain Class Ability Energy for projectiles reflected at the end of your slide.

entries.title: Attrition Orbs
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Hits against enemies within 5 seconds of each spawns an Orb of Power that grants 0.8% Super Energy.

Does not require Direct Hits. Hit counter persists through stow.

Hit requirements for activation:
• Rocket Launchers: 2 hits
• Heavy Grenade Launchers: 3 Hits
• Wave-Frame Grenade Launchers: 4 hits
• Bows: 4 Hits
• Swords: 5 Hits
• Area-Denial Grenade Launchers: 26 Hits
• Others: 55% of Magazine Size rounded down + 1

Support Frame Auto Rifle healing round Hits on damaged allies count as 2 Hits.

entries.title: Rapid Hit
entries.description:
"Buffed Hits" grant 1 Stack of Rapid Hit for 2 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.

"Buffed Hits" refer to any "Yellow Number" Hits such as Precision Hits or Hits against debuffed targets.

Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 2|12|14|18|25 Stability
• 5|30|35|42|60 Reload Speed
• 0.99x|0.96x|0.95x|0.945x|0.92x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Radiolaria Transposer
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Weapon Kills within 8 seconds of each causes your last-killed target to explode and create a Radiolaria Pool at their location. Stowing the weapon resets the Kill Counter.

Explosion deals up to 67.5 [PVP: ?] damage in a 3? meter radius.

Radiolaria Pool information:
• Deals 15 [PVP: ?] 0 Arc damage every 0.65 seconds
• Lasts for ? seconds (3? damage ticks)
• Inherits the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling and any weapon damage buffs

Activation Progress based on Enemy Rank:
Minors: 34% | Elites and higher: 100% | Players: ?%

entries.title: Reservoir Burst
entries.description:
Passively grants 30 Magazine Size stat. (Identical to a Backup Mag mod)

While Magazine is at or above maximum capacity:
Grants 🡅33% increased damage and causes enemies to explode on death, dealing 162.5 damage in a ? meter radius.

Explosions inherit the weapon's element and Combatant Damage Scaling. Explosions triggered with Linear Fusion Rifle kills deal an additional 30% increased damage.

🡅 Damage buff is increased by 10% (30%🠚33%).

entries.title: Firmly Planted
entries.description:
While Crouched:
• 30 Handling and 20 Stability
• -40% Accuracy Cone Size
• -17% Accuracy Cone Growth
• -80% horizontal Recoil

Effects are halved on Fusion Rifles (decimals are rounded up).

entries.title: White Nail
entries.description: Landing 3 Precision Hits within 2.5 seconds of each refills the magazine. Pulls 2 shots from reserves and generates 1 ammo from thin air.

entries.title: Temporal Alignment Refit
entries.description:
Grants 20% increased damage for 16 seconds upon activating both 0 Arc and 1 Stasis Overcharge one after another.

No time limit between the two activations.

entries.title: Transcendent Zen Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Transcendent Moment trait:
Weapon Kills grant stat benefits based on the weapon's elemental alignment for ? seconds.

Light Alignment grants ? Stability and ? Handling.

Dark Alignment grants ? Range and ? Aim Assist.

Kills while Transcendent activate both bonuses.

Light Alignment: 0 Arc, 1 Solar, 2 Void
Darkness Alignment: 3 Stasis, 4 Strand

entries.title: Subsistence Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Subsistence trait:
Weapon Kills refill 10% of the magazine (rounded up) from reserves.

Submachine Gun and Auto Rifle Kills refill 17% of the magazine.

entries.title: Rapid Hit Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Rapid Hit trait:
"Buffed Hits" grant 1 Stack of Rapid Hit for 2 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.

"Buffed Hits" refer to any "Yellow Number" Hits such as Precision Hits or Hits against debuffed targets.

Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 2|12|14|18|25 Stability
• 5|30|35|42|60 Reload Speed
• 0.99x|0.96x|0.95x|0.945x|0.92x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Rampage
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Rampage. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

Stacks expire one at a time every 🡅5 seconds.

Grants a 10%|21%|33.1% damage increase at 1|2|3 Stacks.

Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.title: Revved Consumption
entries.description: Landing hits grants 7HP per damage instance.

entries.title: Unflinching Harmonic Aim
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights with Weapons matching your Subclass Element:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.title: Adept Range
entries.description: Passively grants 10 Range.

entries.title: Release the Wolves
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights, fires in 5 round bursts.

While Hip-Firing, Lord of Wolves becomes fully-automatic and grants the following benefits:
• 60% increased Rate of Fire
• 200% increased Accuracy Cone Size
• ? reduced Range
• 39% increased bodyshot damage and 20% increased precision damage. Bosses take 10% increased bodyshot damage and receive no increase to precision damage.
