entries.title: Delicate Tuning
entries.description:
Grants linearly decreasing benefits as Weapon Heat increases from 0% to 50%:
• 20 to 10 Range
• ? to ? Handling
• ? to ? decreased Accuracy Cone Growth

entries.title: Unflinching Arc Aim
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights with 0 Arc Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.title: Cosmology
entries.description:
Kills throw enemies ? meters back before triggering a 0 Void Explosion. Void Explosions deal 470 [PVP: ?] damage in a 7 meter radius and spawn two seeking orbs, each dealing 51 [PVP: 20] damage. Explosion falls to 0% damage at the edge of its blast radius.

Void Explosion kills can trigger additional Void Explosions.

entries.title: Solar Targeting
entries.description:
Grants the following to 0 Solar Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Cascade Point
entries.description:
After scoring a kill or multiple Precision Hits within 5 seconds of each with a different weapon:

Readying this weapon reduces its Firing Delay for 🡅2.75 seconds.

Firing Delay is reduced by 30% on SMGs and Machine Guns and by 40% on other archetypes.

Precision Hits requried per weapon archetype:
• Bows, Linear Fusion/Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaive Projectiles: 2 hits
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 4 hits
• Auto/Trace/Pulse Rifles, SMGs, Machine Guns, Sidearms: 6 hits

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.25 seconds.

entries.title: Precision Instrument
entries.description:
Direct Weapon Hits grant a stack of Precision Instrument for 1.25 seconds (2.1 seconds on weapons with a Draw/Charge Time).

Maximum of 6 stacks. Reloading the weapon (except on Bows) or missing removes all stacks... usually.

Heavy Burst Frame weapons can only gain 1 stack per burst.

Adaptive Burst Linear Fusion Rifles require 1.5? Hits for each stack (and missing sometimes does not remove your stacks on them).

Precision damage increase at 1|2|... stacks:
🡅5% | 10% | 15% | 20% | 25% | 30%

🡅 Precision Damage Buff is increased by 20%.

entries.title: Close the Gap
entries.description:
Hits against 0 Suspended enemies inflicts 20 Scorch (30 with 1 Ember of Ashes).

Kills spawn a 2 Firesprite.

After picking up a 3 Firesprite, hold [Reload] to enable a Charged Laser. Charged Laser takes 0.5 seconds to charge, at which point it fires for 0.93 seconds at 1000 RPM and hits 15 times.

entries.title: Stasis Holster
entries.description:
After stowing 0 Stasis Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.title: Chill Clip
entries.description:
While at/above 🡅40% of the Base Magazine Capacity:
Direct Hits apply 60 0 Slow Stacks for 4 [PVP: 1.5] seconds (8 [PVP: 2] with 1 Whisper of Durance) to enemies within 4 meters of the target.

Micro-Missile Sidearms and Rapid-Fire Fusion Rifles only apply 40 2 Slow Stacks.

Only activates once per shot/burst.

🡅 Magazine capacity thershold is lowered by 10% (50%🠚40%).

entries.title: Assassin's Blade
entries.description:
Grants the following on Weapon Kills for 5 seconds:
• 15% increased damage
• Maximized Movement Speed

Remains active even if stowed.

entries.title: Temporal Manipulation
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to refill 3 ammo and switch between firing modes:
• 0 Arc Mode fires at 150 RPM
• 1 Stasis Mode fires at 95 RPM and deals explosive splash damage in a 3 meter radius.

Scoring 3 Kills or Precision Hits within 7 seconds of each grants 'Arc|Stasis Overcharge' when in Stasis|Arc firing mode. Overcharge drains at a rate of 4.5% per second once earned.

Buff is removed if you swap off the mode matching its element.

entries.title: Third Iteration Catalyst
entries.description:
Precision Kills with Amalgamation Rounds trigger an explosion dealing 145 [PVP: ?] damage in a 5 meter radius, while also applying 0 Weaken to all enemies within an 8 meter radius for 6 seconds.

Explosive damage deals 20% damage at the edge of its radius.

entries.title: Target Lock
entries.description:
Successive Hits within 0.2 seconds of each grant a ramping Damage Buff after scoring 12.5% of the Magazine Capacity as hits. Missing deactivates the buff.

Stacks displayed on-screen are only visual aides, the buff ramps up with each shot once active. Reaches maximum strength at 5 Stacks.

% of the Magazine Capacity as Hits required for each Visual Stack: 12.5%|35.5%|54.5%|74.5%|110.33%

Damage Buff ramps up from 16.73% [PVP: 10.46%] to 40% [PVP: 25%] upon reaching maximum strength.

Assuming no missed shots, it provides roughly a 25% [PVP: 15.85%] Damage Buff on average after firing 100% of the Magazine Capacity.

entries.title: Radar Tuner
entries.description: Radar immediately returns once no longer Aiming Down Sights. (Normally takes 1.5 seconds)

entries.title: Shock Blast
entries.description:
Fires 15 pellets in a wide blast with no damage falloff and unlimited overpenetration. Max range of 18 meters.

Hits against grounded enemies deal an additional instance of 135.2 [PVP: 150] damage.

Reloads faster than its fire rate, effectively granting a bottomless magazine if fired after each reload.

entries.title: Enduring Snare Refit
entries.description: Increases Snareweaver Trap duration by 10 seconds (15🠚25).

entries.title: Multi-Threaded Snare Refit
entries.description: Increases the maximum number of 0 Suspensions per linked trap wire up to 3.

entries.title: Vorpal Weapon Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Vorpal Weapon trait:
Deals increased damage against Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles, as well as Players in their Super Ability.

Damage increase by Ammo Type:
• 0 Primary Weapons: 20% [PVP: 60%]
• 1 Special Weapons: 15% [PVP: 20%]
• 2 Power Weapons: 10% [PVP: 20%]

entries.title: Hatchling Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Hatchling trait:
Scoring a Precision Kill or 3 kills within 3 seconds of each other spawns a 0 Threadling at the target's location.

entries.title: Impact Induction
entries.description:
Grants Grenade Ability Energy upon dealing Elemental Melee Damage. 7 second cooldown between activations.

Grenade Ability Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods:
12% [PVP: 6%] | 17% [PVP: 8.5%] | 20% [PVP: 10%]

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

entries.title: MIDA Multi-Tool
entries.description:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

Radar remains active while Aiming Down Sights with this weapon.

Grants 12.5% increased Movement Speed while held. This benefit is shared across all equipped MIDA-Synergy weapons.

entries.title: Adaptive Glaive
entries.description:
Hybrid melee/ranged polearm with a frontal shield.
Generates energy on dealing ranged damage.

[Aim Down Sights] : Raise shield, depleting energy over time
[Melee] : Kinetic melee combo

entries.title: Hawkmoon Catalyst
entries.description:
Increases Magazine Size by 1 (8🠚9).

Grants the following benefits at 1|2|3|...|7| stacks of Paracausal Charge:
• 8|14|22|26|28|29|30 Range
• 15|25|35|40|50|50|50 Reload Speed
• ? Handling

Clarity's Exotic Weapon Insights built by Hawkmoona Matata. Enjoy! ♥

entries.title: Bring the Heat
entries.description:
Fusion Grenades have Fastball intrinsically and detonate on impact, stunning 0 Unstoppable Champions on hit.

Fusion Grenade Kills refund Grenade Energy based on Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 25%
• Elites: 50%
• Players, Minibosses, and Bosses: 100%

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Burning Fists
entries.description:
Finisher and (Glaive) Melee Kills grant a Stack of Burning Fists. Maximum of 5 Stacks.

After not having scored further Finisher or (Glaive) Melee Kills for 2 seconds, your Stacks start decaying one at a time over 9.5|10|4|4|3 seconds for the 1st|...|5th Stacks.

Damage Buff at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• Additional Base Melee Damage: 80%|160%|240%|320%|400%
• Additional Base Glaive Melee Damage: 40%|80%|120%|160%|200%
• Weapon, PVE: 0%|20%|25%|30%|35%
• Weapon, PVP: 0%|0%|20%|25%|25%

Weapon damage increases are Empowering Buffs.

entries.title: Arc Traps
entries.description:
Grenades fired are Arc Traps that lay inactive for 30 seconds and connect to other bolts within 15 meters. Up to 6 Arc Traps can exist at a time.

Enemies within 2 meters of a trap activate all linked traps. Activated traps deal damage once every 0.5 seconds and detonate after 10 seconds.

Unlinked Arc Bolts deal damage in a 4 meter radius after detecting an enemy within 5 meters. Linked Arc Bolts only damage enemies touching the tripwire.

Traps that are linked together deal 100% bonus tick damage (compared to a single bolt).

entries.title: Scatter Charge
entries.description:
Grants an extra 0 Scatter Grenade Ability Charge. Stacks with 1 Chaos Accelerant's additional grenade charge.

Kills with 2 Scatter Grenade spawn 3 additional scatter submunitions. Submunition kills cannot chain.

Scatter Grenades are faster and receive 3 Chaos Accelerant's Tracking Bonus. This does not stack with 4 Chaos Accelerant.

entries.title: Firing Line
entries.description:
Being within 15 meters of 2 allies grants 20% increased Precision Damage.

🡅 Grants 10 Handling while the perk is active.

entries.title: Restoration Ritual
entries.description:
Reviving an ally or performing a Finisher grants 'Restoration Ritual' and refills the Magazine from reserves.

'Restoration Ritual' refills the Magazine from reserves the next time it is emptied.

entries.title: Grave Robber
entries.description:
Powered Melee Hits and (Glaive) Melee Kills refill the magazine from reserves.

3 second cooldown between activations.

🡅 Passively grants 5 Handling.

entries.title: Cold Steel
entries.description:
Powered Sword Hits apply 0 Slow stacks for 4.25 [PVP: 1.5] seconds.

Light Attacks apply 40 1 Slow stacks, Heavy Attacks apply 60.

Flash Counter's disorienting blast also applies 60 2 Slow stacks.

🡅 Passively grants 10 Ammo Capacity.

entries.title: Tracking Module
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights and targeting an Enemy:
Fired Rockets track the targeted enemy. Diminshed effectiveness in PVP.

Tracking persists for 1 second once no longer aiming at the enemy.

🡅 Passively grants 5 Blast Radius.

entries.title: Broadside
entries.description:
Each successive shot fired within 0.5 seconds of each other deals increasingly higher damage and has a wider pellet spread.

Broadside increases the damage of the 2|3|4|5th shot by 18%|39%|59%|81% damage in exchange for 25% increased pellet spread on the first shot and then 33% increased spread for all shots afterwards.

entries.title: Solar Ammo Generation
entries.description:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to 0 Solar Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).

entries.title: Dark Deliverance
entries.description:
Fire a large slow-traveling projectile. Release the trigger after firing to remotely detonate it into 7 submunitions.

Deals no self-damage.

entries.title: Emergency Reinforcement
entries.description:
Grants 10% Damage Resist upon reaching Critical Health while at 3 or more Stacks Armor Charge and consumes all Armor Charges.

Buff lasts 6|9|12|15 seconds with 3|4|5|6 Stack of Armor Charge consumed.

entries.title: Envious Assassin
entries.description:
Upon readying the weapon after scoring Kills with your other Weapons:
Refills and/or overfills the Magazine from reserves based on the amount of Weapon Kills scored.

Maximum total overfill amount is 200% of the Magazine Capacity. Each activation can only load up to 100% of the Magazine Capacity into the magazine.

Loaded ammo per Kill by ammo type (rounds up):
• 0 Primary Weapons: 🡅12.5% of Magazine Capacity
• 1 Special and 2 Power Weapons: 🡅22.5%

🡅 Loaded ammo per Kill is increased by 2.5% of the Magazine Capacity (e.g. 10%⁠🠚⁠12.5%).

entries.title: Delayed Gratification
entries.description:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

Fires bouncing grenades that can be remotely detonated after 0.3 seconds. Has a 4.5 meter blast radius, dealing 30% damage at the edge of the radius.

Deals 40% increased damage against Minor Combatants (Exotic 0 Primary bonus is typically 30%).

Passively grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

entries.title: Marksman's Dodge
entries.description:
Only usable while on the ground.

Performs an evasive maneuver in your movement input's direction that instantly reloads all equipped weapons and collects ammo bricks that are on the ground within a 15 meter radius of you.

Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.

Counts as a manual reload and will activate reload-triggered perks such as Kill Clip.

entries.title: Gambler's Dodge
entries.description:
Only usable while on the ground.

Performs a deft tumble in your movement input's direction.

Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.

Grants 1% [PVP: 0.35%] Fixed Melee Ability Energy per 1 point in the Melee Stat, up to 100% [PVP: 35%] at 100 Melee Stat.

Melee Energy is doubled if performed within 15 meters of an enemy, allowing for a maximum refund of 200% [PVP: 70%] energy.

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Lord of Wolves Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 20 Stability, 60 Reload Speed, and 15% decreased Reload Animation Duration.

Hipfired shots apply 10 0 Scorch stacks (15 with 1 Ember of Ashes) on hit with a 0.5 second cooldown.

Kills while ADS trigger a 2 Solar explosion that applies 30 3 Scorch stacks (40 with 4 Ember of Ashes) to enemies within an 8 meter radius.

entries.title: The Chaperone Catalyst
entries.description:
Scoring 3 Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each refills 1 Ammo into the Magazine from thin air.

Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity. Precision Hit counter persists through stow.

entries.title: Harmony
entries.description:
Upon readying the weapon within 3 seconds of getting a Kill with a different weapon:
Grants 20% increased damage and 15 Handling for 7 seconds.

entries.title: Arc Ammo Generation
entries.description:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to 0 Arc Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).

entries.title: Blunt Execution Rounds
entries.description:
Upon dealing Melee damage while an Enemy is within 15 meters:
Grants 500% [PVP: 100%] increased damage and 100 Handling for the next full burst within 10 seconds.

4 second cooldown after buff expires. Can be activated while stowed. Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

Any Powered Melee that requires sprinting, sliding, or performs a slam will not activate the perk.

entries.title: Acrius Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 40 Reload Speed, 50 Ammo Generation, and increases Magazine Size by 2 (4🠚6).

Grants the Trench Barrel trait:
Dealing Melee Damage grants the following for the next 3 shots within 5 seconds:
• 30 Reload Speed and 30 Handling
• 50% increased damage

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

entries.title: Tractor Cannon Catalyst
entries.description: Increases Magazine Size by 3 (4🠚7) and grants 50 Ammo Generation.

entries.title: Cormorant Reversal
entries.description:
Blocking grants 100% [PVP: ?] damage resistance against attacks that are within a ? degree cone in front of you.

Guarding while taking any damage fires a 255 [PVP: 50] 0 Kinetic damage Blaster Bolt towards your reticle.

With Refraction Core Equipped: Blaster Bolt Hits apply elemental effects matching your subclass:
• 1 Grants x1 Bolt Charge
• 2 10? Scorch (17? with 3 Ember of Ashes)
• 4 Weakens for 6 seconds
• 5 20 Slow for 1? second (2? with 6 Whisper of Durance)
• 7 Severs for 10 seconds (15 with 8 Thread of Continuity)

entries.title: Harmonic Laser
entries.description:
Holding down the trigger cycles between the three power levels: Low, Medium, and High.

Cycle resets upon trigger release, and follows the order:
Medium for 0.5 seconds 🠚 Low 1s 🠚 High 1s 🠚 Medium 1.5s 🠚 Low 1.5s 🠚 Medium 2s 🠚 High 1.25s 🠚 Low 1.25s 🠚 Repeats

Cycle determines damage output, with Low|Med|High granting the following damage increases:
• PvE: Base|32.2%|68.7%
• PvP: Base|3%|6.25%

entries.title: Headseeker
entries.description:
Dealing non-Precision Direct damage grants the following benefits for 0.55 seconds:
• 20% increased Precision Bonus (complicated, see specific damage increases below)
• 3% increased Aim Assist Cone size

Precision damage increases by weapon type/frame:
• Pulse Rifles: Adaptive: 7.1%, Aggressive Burst: 10%, Heavy Burst: 9.5%, High-Impact: 8.74%, Lightweight: 6.3%, Rapid-Fire: 10.3%
• Sidearms: Adaptive Burst: 8.46%, Heavy Burst: 7.36%
• Scout Rifles: Precision: 8.66%

[Bug] Heavy Burst Hand Cannons: 7% increased Weakspot damage.

The distinction between Weakspots and Critspots is complicated and we might write an explainer blog post about it eventually. For the purposes of PvP, the two are equivalent.

entries.title: Stormbringer
entries.description:
3 kills within 3? seconds of each spawns a Lightning Strike centered on the last target defeated, followed by a Lightning Storm.

Lightning Strike deals 382 [PVP: ?] damage in a 7 meter radius after 1.1 seconds, which falls to 0% damage at the edge of its radius.

Lighting Storm occurs 0.5 seconds after the Lightning Strike and releases 4 bolts spread in an X-Pattern over the target, dealing 426 [PVP: ?] damage in a 5 meter radius. Damage falls to 25% at the edge of the radius.

entries.title: Reconstruction
entries.description:
Every 🡅5.5 seconds while not firing the weapon:
Loads 25% of the Magazine Capacity (rounded up) into the Magazine from reserves.

Can overfill the Magazine up to double the normal capacity. Works even while stowed.

🡅 Loading delay is decreased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.title: Smoothbore
entries.description: Increases Shotgun Pellet Spread by 7.5%

entries.title: Le Monarque Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 20 Reload Speed and 30 Stability.

Grants the Unrelenting trait:
Starts Health Regeneration and restores 65 HP upon reaching 100% Activation Progress with Weapon Kills within 5 seconds of each.

Activation Progress by Enemy Rank:
• Minor Combatants: 34%
• Players: 67%
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 100%

entries.title: Void Dexterity
entries.description:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to 0 Void Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.title: Recombination
entries.description:
Elemental Kills grant 1 Stack of Recombination even while the weapon is stowed. Maximum of 10 stacks.

Each Stack additively increases the damage of the next shot by 10% [PVP: 5%], up to 100% [PVP: 50%] at 10 stacks.

entries.title: Harvester Spike
entries.description:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

Deals 40% increased damage against Minor Combatants (Exotic 0 Primary bonus is typically 30%).

Fires a micro-missile-like projectile that explodes in a 5 meter radius. Kills create a Vestige that travels up to 40 meters towards you.

Shots fired into Champions, Minibosses, or Bosses impale them, damaging them once every 0.8 seconds for 4 seconds and creating a Vestige on each tick (6 Vestiges total).

Impaled Spikes can be stacked.

entries.title: Shrapnel Launcher
entries.description:
Reloads its entire magazine at once.

Fires bursts of solar pellets depending on aiming mode.

0 Scorch and 1 Ignitions that originate from this weapon deal 53% increased damage. This is reduced to 24% against Bosses.

entries.title: Wish-Dragon Teeth
entries.description:
Intrinsically grants Fastball to all grenades.

Enhances 0 Tripmine Grenades:
• 14% increased Explosion damage
• Explosion Length and Width are increased to 14 meters
• Explosions don't have any damage falloff
• Explosion no longer deals self-damage
• Last 20 seconds longer (10s🠚30s)
• Grants Tripmine Grenades 70 HP

1 Solar Ability Hits grant 33% [PVP: 8%] Tripmine Grenade Energy. 0.3 second cooldown between energy gains.

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Spring-Loaded Mounting
entries.description:
Passively grants 50 Airborne Effectiveness, 100 Handling and 100 Reload Speed to Sidearms.

Upon readying a Sidearm while at Critical Health:
• Refills the Magazine of the Sidearm from reserves
• Grants 100% [PVP: 10%] increased damage until your shield are fully recharged, after which it has a 5 second duration

Sidearm Kills extend the buff duration by 3 seconds (capped at 5 seconds) and refill your Magazine from reserves.

entries.title: Riskrunner Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 30 Range.

Weapon Kills trigger an elemental explosion, dealing up to 114 [PVP: ?] damage in a 3 meter radius.

This explosion can deal self-damage and trigger Arc Conductor.

entries.title: Towering Barricade
entries.description:
Only usable while on the ground.

Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation.

Creates a tall, slightly curved, see-through Barricade in front of you that blocks all projectiles fired at it.

Lasts 20 seconds, has 500 HP, has 90% Damage Resistance against non-Boss PVE Combatants, and ?% Damage Resistance against Bosses.

Grants 60% Splash Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants while standing behind the Barricade.

Enemies that pass through the Barricade continuously receive ? non-lethal damage every ? seconds. PVE Combatants that pass through the Barricade are temporarily disoriented.

Barricade taunts PVE Combatants that are in front of it and within ? meters.

Standing extremely close to the barricade consistently prevents enemy melee attacks from hitting you through it.

entries.title: Rally Barricade
entries.description:
Only usable while on the ground.

Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation and keeps you crouched after.

Creates a short, curved, see-through Barricade that blocks all projectiles fired at it.

Lasts 20 seconds, has 500 HP, has 90% Damage Resistance against non-Boss PVE Combatants, and ?% Damage Resistance against Bosses.

Enemies that pass through the Barricade continuously receive ? non-lethal damage every ? seconds. PVE Combatants that pass through the Barricade are temporarily disoriented.

Barricade taunts PVE Combatants that are in front of it and within ? meters.

Grants the following benefits to you and allies while standing behind it:
• 10% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• 50% Flinch Resistance
• 30 Stability
• 100 Reload Speed with a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 80% Splash Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants

entries.title: Thruster
entries.description:
Only usable while on the ground.

Performs a quick, first-person, 8 meter dash in your current input direction. Removes tracking from PVE Combatant projectiles (needs confirmation) and disables Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.

Not inputting a movement direction results in a 4 meter backwards dash.

entries.title: Threat Detector
entries.description:
Grants 1|2 Stacks while within 15 meters of 1|2+ enemies.

Bonuses at 1|2 Stacks:
• 🡅19|🡅44 Stability
• 🡅19|🡅63 Reload Speed
• 🡅28|100 Handling
• 0.9x|0.81x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier

🡅 Grants 4? more stability when active as well as 1|3 more Reload Speed at 1|2 Stacks.

entries.title: Elemental Honing
entries.description:
Dealing Elemental Damage grants a stack of Elemental Honing for 🡅23 seconds for each unique Element used. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Gaining a stack refreshes the buff duration. Duration cannot be refreshed once at 5 stacks.

Buff can be activated while stowed. Kinetic Damage does not trigger the buff.

Weapon damage increase at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks by weapon damage type:
• Kinetic: 10%|20%|30%|35%|40%
• Elemental (PVE): 2.5%|10%|20%|30%|35%
• Elemental (PVP): 1.25%|5%|20%|30%|35%

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 3 seconds.

entries.title: Dark-Forged Trigger
entries.description:
While not Aiming Down Sights:
• Increases RPM to 130
• 50% Reduced Accuracy Cone Size
• 50% Reduced Accuracy Cone Growth
• 27% [PVP: 15%] increased damage at x5 Cranial Spike

Aim Assist Cone will favor precision hits in the case of overlapping regions.

entries.title: Ionic Return
entries.description:
Breaking an elemental shield matching the currently selected element refills the magazine from reserves and grants 5 shots of 'Ionic Return'.

Ionic Return grants each shot the following benefits:
• 15% increased bodyshot damage
• 37% increases critical damage

entries.title: Modified Heatsink
entries.description:
Passively refills 1 round every 5 seconds. Firing resets this timer.

Reloading greatly increases this rate and scales with your reload speed, similar to venting Heat Weapons.

entries.title: Accomplice
entries.description: Kills refill the magazine of Energy-Slot weapons.

entries.title: Steady Hands
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 100 Handling and a 0.825x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier to all weapons for 8.5 seconds.

Additional kills while the perk is active refresh the duration to 6.5 seconds.

entries.title: Rangefinder
entries.description:
Aiming Down Sights grants the following benefits:
• 10 Range
• 10% increased Effective Zoom
• 5% increased Projectile Speed

The Effective Zoom increase pushes out Aim Assist Falloff by 10%, reduces (Absolute) Recoil by 10% and narrows the Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones by the same amount. (This is the normal behavior of Zoom and isn't unique to Rangefinder)

🡅 Passively grants 5 Handling.

entries.title: Trickle Charge
entries.description:
Receiving 0 Bolt Charge refills 10% of the magazine. Does not currently dissipate Heat for Heat Weapons.

Discharging 1 Bolt Charge refills 20% of the magazine. Dissipates 100% Heat on Heat Weapons.

Works while stowed.

🡅 Increases the magazine refill amount.

entries.title: Photoinhibition
entries.description:
Passively increases damage against shielded enemies:
• 34.3% increase against PVE Combatant Elemental Shields and 0 Barrier Champion Shields
• 21.6% increase against PVE Combatant Overshields
• 15.6% increase against Player Overshields

Breaking a PVE Combatant's Shield Disorients them for ? seconds. Other enemies within ? meters are also Disoriented if the weapon matches the Shield's element.

entries.title: Gun and Run
entries.description:
Kills grant one stack of 'Gun And Run' for 10 (🡅 11) seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks. If the buff expires, the next kill will grant however many stacks were previously held.

After sprinting for 0.75 seconds without a full magazine, consume one stack and refill 25% magazine capacity every 0.85 seconds.

For bows, this trait instead grants a 15% Faster Draw Time for ? seconds.

Provides no benefit to Swords.

entries.title: Sprint Grip
entries.description:
Sprinting for 1.5 seconds while holding the weapon grants 35 ADS and Ready Handling.

Buff is removed when you stop sprinting.

entries.title: Thermodynamic Siphon
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a 0 Solar or 1 Stasis Weapon.

Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Desperation
entries.description:
Kills with a Cursed Thrall Explosion, or finishing a reload within 5.2? seconds of a Precision Kill, grants the following benefits for 7 seconds:
• 20% increased Rate of Fire
• 6 Stability
• 10-15 Aim Assist

entries.title: Izanagi's Burden Catalyst
entries.description:
Increases the damage bonus of Honed Edge x4 by 20%, granting the following values:
• 155% [PVP: 218%] increased bodyshot damage
• 370% [PVP: 487%] increased critical damage

entries.title: Lucent Blades
entries.description:
Swords are granted 30|50|60 Charge Rate with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Glaive Projectile Hits grant 20%|30%|35% Increased Weapon Energy. (Stacks additively with Immovable Object)

entries.title: Solar Dexterity
entries.description:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to 0 Solar Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.title: Arc Scavenger
entries.description:
Only works in PvE game modes.

Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to 0 Arc Weapons matching the Ammo Type.

Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.

Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.

Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.title: Pugilist
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 🡅11% Melee Ability Energy.

Kills with Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaives, and Fusion Rifles grant 🡅22%.

Dealing Melee Damage grants 35 Handling for 3 seconds.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

🡅 Melee Ability Energy gains are increased by 10%. (e.g. 10%🠚11%)

entries.title: Compression Chamber
entries.description:
Reloads its entire magazine at once.

Passive 5% increased damage falloff distance compared to similar shotguns.

While Hip-Firing, this gun fires a spread of 12 pellets in the pattern of a Precision Frame shotgun, each pellet dealing 104 [PVP: ?] damage.

While Aiming Down Sights, this gun fires a single slug round, dealing 1891 [PVP: ?] precision damage.

entries.title: Alloy Magazine
entries.description:
Linearly grants a Reload Duration Multiplier as your magazine drops from 50% capacity to empty.

Reload Duration Multiplier scales from 0.9x at 50% capacity to 0.8x with an empty magazine.

entries.title: Beyond The Veil
entries.description:
Grants an extra 0 Smoke Bomb Melee Ability Charge.

1 Invisibility now grants 50% [PVP: 10%] Damage Resistance (Resist x4).

2 Cloaking allies starts their health regeneration, grants them the same Damage Resist benefits, and refunds 50% Melee Ability Energy per ally made invisible.

Damage Resistance does not apply while in Super.

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Killing Tally
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Killing Tally. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

Stowing or reloading the weapon removes all Stacks.

Damage increase at 1|2|3 Stacks:
• PVE: 10% | 20% | 30%
• PVP: 5% | 10% | 15%

entries.title: Loose Change
entries.description:
Applying an Elemental Debuff grants the following benefits for 🡅10 seconds:
• 50 Reload Speed and 20 Aim Assist
• 20% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty

Buff can be activated while stowed.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.title: Reverberation
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 100 Blast Radius for 5.5 seconds.

Blast Radius does not affect the lingering pools created by Area Denial Frame Grenade Launchers.

entries.title: Rasputin's Arsenal
entries.description: Refills 50% of the Magazine (rounded up) from reserves upon breaking Elemental, Barrier Champion, or Player Shields.

entries.title: Force Multiplier
entries.description:
Passively grants ? Reload Speed and 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Shotguns.

Scoring Shotgun or Melee Kills begins Health Regeneration after reaching 100% Progress. Minor Combatants grant 34% progress, while Elites and Guardians grant 50%.

While 0 Void Overshield, 1 Amplified, 2 Restoration, 3 Frost Armor, or 4 Woven Mail is active:
• Shotguns deal 35% [PVP: 10%] increased damage (Empowering Buff)
• Melees are granted 30% [PVP: ?%] increased damage
• Shotgun or Melee kills extend the duration of any the above effects by 5 seconds, up to their respective maximum.
• If a 5 Void Overshield is active, it also recieves 15 HP.

"Melee attacks" performed by Super Abilities are also granted the damage bonus, which stacks additively with the Shieldcrush Artifact Mod.

entries.title: Prismatic Inferno
entries.description:
0 Scorch and 1 Ignitions that originate from this weapon deal 15% increased damage.

Holding down the trigger for 0.45 seconds creates a focused 'Solar Field' that continuously expands from the point of impact.

The radius grows up to 4? meters wide over the course of 4 seconds, dealing 19 [PVP: 6] damage every 0.1 seconds to all enemies within it.

Scoring 20 hits within 1.5 seconds of each with this weapon's beam or Solar Field applies 20 2 Scorch stacks (30 with 3 Ember of Ashes).

entries.title: Violent Reanimation
entries.description:
While 0 Devour is not active, scoring multiple kills grants 1 Devour.

Activation Progress by Combatant Classification:
• Minors: 25%
• Elites and Above: 100%
• Players: 25%

Activation has no timer and persists through stow.

entries.title: Triple Tap
entries.description:
Scoring 3 Precision Hits within 🡅3 seconds of each refills 1 Ammo into the Magazine from thin air.

Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity. Precision Hit counter persists through stow.

🡅 Allowed time between Precision Hits is increased by 1 second.

entries.title: Edge
entries.description: Passively grants 6 Charge Rate and 6 Guard Resistance.

entries.title: Praxic Lift
entries.description:
Scoring Weapon and 0 Arc-Powered Melee Kills build up 'Jetpack Fuel'. Weapon kills grant 20% energy, and 1 Arc-Melee kills grant 50% energy. Jetpack Fuel additionally builds at a passive rate of 3.5% per second.

Once Jetpack Fuel is fully charged, pressing [Air Move] input while airborne thrusts you forward in a jet-propelled flight for 30 meters for 1.5 seconds. Holding down the input results in a 100% longer flight duration, traveling 50 meters over 3 seconds.

Jetpack Activation deals 168 [PVP: 69] 2 Arc Damage in a 6 meter radius and applies Exhaust.

Colliding with an enemy while flying triggers a 3 Melee Strike for 1509 [PVP: ?] 4 Arc Damage, 5 Blinds targets in a ? meter radius for 10 seconds, and grants 40 Melee stat for 7 seconds.

entries.title: Kinetic Scavenger
entries.description:
Only works in PvE game modes.

Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Kinetic Weapons matching the Ammo Type.

Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.

Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.

Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.title: Winterbite Catalyst
entries.description: Killing 0 Frozen Enemies or 1 Shattering a 2 Stasis Crystal with the weapon grants a Stack of 3 Frost Armor.

entries.title: Moving Target
entries.description:
Grants the following while Aiming Down Sights (ADS):
• 10 Aim Assist
• 10% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty

entries.title: Iron Reach
entries.description: Passively increases Range by 20 but decreases Stability by 20.

entries.title: Wraithmetal Mail
entries.description:
Passively grants 10 Stability and ?% decreased Ready Animation Duration.

Casting your Class Ability grants 'Wraithmetal Mail' for 15 seconds and reloads your currently equipped weapon.

Counts as a manual reload and will activate reload-triggered perks such as Kill Clip.

Wraithmetal Mail grants the following benefits:
• ? Stability
• ? Handling
• 12.5% increased Sprint Speed
• 33% increased Slide Distance
• ? Decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty

Currently grants no benefit to the Class stat, unlike what the game says.

entries.title: Synapse Junctions
entries.description:
Hits with 0 Arc Staff grant a Stack of 'Synapse Junctions' for 5 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

1 Arc Staff hits now apply 2 Jolt.

Damage increases | Passive Super Drain decreases:
• Synapse Junctions x1: 27% | 20%
• Synapse Junctions x2: 61% | 40%
• Synapse Junctions x3: 105% | 60%

3 Arc Staff's Heavy Palm Blast (Light->Light->Heavy) recieves 150% of the above damage bonuses.

entries.title: Probability Matrix
entries.description:
0 Arcbolt Grenades 1 Jolt and Disrupt targets on hit and can chain an additional time (4🠚5).

Applying 2 Jolt or triggering a 3 Jolt chain grant 15% and 7.5% 4 Arcbolt Grenade energy, respectively. (Due to the nature of 5 Jolt, these events can often happen simultaneously)

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Compulsive Reloader
entries.description:
While above 50% Magazine Capacity:
🡅55 Reload Speed with a 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier.

🡅 Reload Speed bonus is increased by 5.

entries.title: Cross Counter
entries.description:
While you have an 0 Arc Melee Ability equipped:
Receiving Melee damage or scoring an 1 Arc Elemental Melee Hit grants the 'Cross Counter' buff for your next Melee Attack within 3 seconds.

Cross Counter grants 400% additional base Melee damage and restores 40 HP on Melee Hits. Cross Counter's Melee deals 2 Arc Damage.

entries.title: Chain Reaction
entries.description:
Weapon Kills trigger an elemental explosion matching the weapon's element.

Damage and radius of the explosions varies based on the weapon's ammo type:
• 0 Special Weapons: Up to 🡅73.92 [PVP: 49.28] damage in a 2.4 meter radius
• 1 Power Weapons: Up to 🡅120.12 [PVP: 80.08] damage in a 3 meter radius

🡅 Explosion damage is increased by 10%.
Swords receive 20 Guard Endurance.

entries.title: Graviton Lance Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 20 Range.

Grants the Turnabout trait:
Upon breaking a Combatant's Elemental Shield or the Shield of a Guardian in their Super:
Grants a 30 HP Overshield for 10 seconds.

Also grants the Vorpal Weapon trait:
Deals increased damage against Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles, as well as Players in their Super Ability.

Damage increase by Ammo Type:
• 0 Primary Weapons: 20% [PVP: 60%]
• 1 Special Weapons: 15% [PVP: 20%]
• 2 Power Weapons: 10% [PVP: 20%]

entries.title: Vigilance Wing Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants the Ensemble trait:
Grants 30 Handling and 40 Reload Speed while within 15 meters of an ally.

Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once you're no longer near allies.

entries.title: Successful Warm-Up
entries.description:
Weapon Kills decrease Charge/Draw Time by 37.5% for 6 seconds.

Kills while the perk is active add 🡅5 seconds to the duration up to a maximum of 20 seconds.

Buff is removed on stow.

🡅 Additional kills add 1 more second to the duration.

entries.title: Fanatical Lance
entries.description:
Scoring kills in either mode triggers a 7.5 meter radius 0 Void explosion, dealing 239 [PVP: ?] damage and spawning a Radiolaria Pool at the target's location. Pool deals 123 [PVP: ?] 1 Arc damage in a 3 meter radius once per second for 5 seconds.

Kills needed to spawn a Radiolaria Pool based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 3
• Elites and Higher: 1
• Players: ?

While not Aiming Down Sights:
Firing this gun consumes 5 ammo and launches a slow-traveling projectile, splitting into a plus (+) shaped volley of five projectiles after 7.5 meters. Projectiles deal splash damage in a ? meter radius, despawn after 100 meters, and cannot deal precision damage.

Hitting an enemy with the projectile before it splits deals 947 [PVP: 233] damage in a 3 meter radius.

Split projectiles individually deal 187 [PVP: 49] damage each, totalling for 985 [PVP: 245] damage in a 3 meter radius.

entries.title: Warlord's End
entries.description:
Does not work with 0 Grapple melee or 1 Song of Flame melees.

Powered Melee damage 2 Weakens targets for 6 seconds (15% debuff).

Powered Melee and Finisher Kills disorient and apply a stronger (30%) 3 Weaken debuff to enemies in a given radius around the target.

The debuff Duration and application radius are dependent on Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 15 meter radius, 10 second duration
• Elites, Players: 20m radius, 15s duration
• Minibosses, Bosses: 25m radius, 20s duration

Finishers increase the debuff duration by 5 seconds and the application radius by 5 meters. Both duration and radius are capped at the values provided by killing (Mini)Bosses.

Additional PvP effects of on-kill debuffs: screen is blackened for 7.5 seconds before gradually fading away over the following 7.5 seconds. (HUD remains unobstructed)

Applying 4 Weaken to the target extends the debuff's duration.

entries.title: Desperado
entries.description:
Finishing a reload 5.2 seconds after a Precision Kill or 3 kills within ? seconds of each reduces Firing Delay by 30% for 🡅7 seconds.

Buff is removed on stow.

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.title: Ruinscribe's Forge
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to switch to Ruinscribe Turret Mode and make your next shot launch an autonomous floating turret. Costs 3 ammo.

Deploying a turret refills the magazine.

Turret lasts for 25 seconds and targets enemies in a 70 meter radius, firing a 359 [PVP: 131] damage missile at the closest target every 2 seconds.

entries.title: Ride the Bull
entries.description:
Holding down the trigger grants a stack of 'Ride The Bull' every 0.833 seconds. Maximum of 2 stacks. Stacks are removed on trigger release.

Ride The Bull grants 10%|20% increased rate of fire and ?%|?% increased recoil at 1|2 stacks.

Kills instantly refill the magazine.

entries.title: Melee Font
entries.description:
Grants 20|40|50 Melee stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.

Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.title: Solar Loader
entries.description:
Grants the following to 0 Solar Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Adept Reload
entries.description: Passively grants 10 Reload Speed.

entries.title: Stasis Resistance
entries.description:
Reduces Incoming 0 Stasis Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.title: Quantum Nova
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to consume up to 0 9 Ammo from reserves and refill the magazine, activating 'Quantum Nova'.

The duration of Quantum Nova depends on the amount of ammo consumed. Buff lasts for 4|8|14|20 seconds upon consuming 1|3|6|9 reserve ammo.

While active, this gun applies a 1 Strong Weaken (30%) that lasts for 5 seconds on hit.

Timer is paused while stowed.

entries.title: Cormorant Combo
entries.description:
Press [Heavy Attack] immediately after landing 3 Light Attacks to perform an overhead strike, dealing 689 [PVP: ?] damage followed by 3 additional ticks of 417 [PVP: ?] damage each.

With Impact Core Equipped: Blade Melee Hits apply elemental effects matching your subclass:
• 0 Grants x1 Bolt Charge
• 1 25? Scorch (35? with 2 Ember of Ashes)
• 3 Weakens for 6 seconds
• 4 40 Slow for 1? second (2? with 5 Whisper of Durance)
• 6 Severs for 10 seconds (15 with 7 Thread of Continuity)

entries.title: Memento Mori
entries.description:
Counts as a "Dealer's Choice" origin trait weapon, but does not benefit from the trait itself.

Grants Radar while Aiming Down Sights.

Finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of a kill grants 6 'Memento Mori' shots, each dealing 68% [PVP: 29%] increased damage.

Ace of Spades has 15% Decreased Damage Falloff Distance while Memento Mori is active.

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

entries.title: Power Surge
entries.description:
Scoring 2 hits within 3 seconds of each causes the next shot fired within 3 seconds to have an Explosive Payload. Explosive Payload deals 122 [PVP: ?] additional damage over 4 meters, which deals 50% reduced damage at the edge of its radius.

Hits with this Payload grant 8%? additional progress to Latent Power.

entries.title: Gear Shift
entries.description:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Weapon Kill, or becoming 0 Amplified, grants 1 stack of 'Gear Shift' for 15 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Grants 15%|20%|25%|30%|35% increased damage at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks.

Buff can be triggered while stowed and refreshed with each new application of 1 Amplified.

entries.title: Conserve Momentum
entries.description:
Kills grant 34% decreased Reload Animation Duration for 6 seconds.

Each projectile hit grants one stack of 'Conserve Momentum'. Maximum of 15 stacks.

Conserve Momentum non-linearly decreases Charge Time and damage for each stack earned:
• 7% decreased Charge Time and 0.84% decreased damage at the first stack
• 80% decreased Charge Time and 11.93% decreased damage at maximum stacks

entries.title: Meganeura
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant one stack of Meganeura for 3.5 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Precision Kills cause targets to explode, dealing 123.89 [PVP: 95.3] | 173.6 [PVP: ?] | 207.57 [PVP: ?] weapon-matching elemental damage in a 7.5-meter radius at 1|2|3| stacks.

Explosion has up to 50% damage falloff at the furthest point.

entries.title: Sniper Damage Resistance
entries.description:
Reduces Incoming Damage from PVE Combatants more than 29 meters away by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.title: Skyburner Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 20 Reload Speed.

Weapon Kills trigger a 0 Solar explosion that applies 30 1 Scorch Stacks (40 with 2 Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.

Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more 3 Scorch Stacks.

4 Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.

Direct Hits against 5 Scorched Enemies apply 10 [PVP: 4] additional 6 Scorch per Direct Hit (15 [PVP: 9?] with 7 Ember of Ashes) on a 0.5 second cooldown.

Scoring 11 Direct Hits within 3? seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to 8 Scorch the target. Hit counter persists through stow.

9 Scorch applied by Burning Ambition to Unscorched targets counts as Weapon Damage.

entries.title: Forerunner Catalyst
entries.description:
Holding [Reload] within 4 seconds of a kill consumes 4 ammo, refills the magazine, and grants 'The Rock'.

The Rock replaces your grenade ability with a tossed 0 Kinetic grenade that explodes for 2072 [PVP: 181] damage in a 9 meter radius, dealing 20% damage at the edge of its radius. Detonates 0.6 seconds after it slows down enough.

The Rock counts as a grenade ability and is buffed by, and triggers, grenade-associated effects.

entries.title: Circle of Life
entries.description:
Triggering 'Support Frame Boost' by healing allies with the weapon grants 25% [PVP: 12.5%] increased damage for 🡅11 seconds.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.title: Transcendent Moment
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant stat benefits based on the weapon's elemental alignment for ? seconds.

Light Alignment grants ? Stability and ? Handling.

Dark Alignment grants ? Range and ? Aim Assist.

Kills while Transcendent activate both bonuses.

Light Alignment: 0 Arc, 1 Solar, 2 Void
Darkness Alignment: 3 Stasis, 4 Strand

🡅 Buff duration is increased.

entries.title: Eddy Current
entries.description:
Grants the following after sprinting for 1.5 seconds with the weapon readied:
• 20 Reload Speed
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
• ? Handling
• 0.95x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier

Sprinting refreshes the buff duration.

Being 0 Amplified removes the sprinting requirement and increases the Reload Speed stat bonus to 60.

entries.title: Health Font
entries.description:
Grants 20|40|50 Health stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.

Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.title: Accelerated Coils
entries.description: Decreases charge time by 40ms and damage by 2%.

entries.title: Light Shift
entries.description:
Replaces Dodge with Shift if you have a 0 Stasis or 1 Arc Super equipped (does not work with 2 Acrobat's Dodge), and overrides base cooldown to that of Marksman's Dodge.

Shift effectively acts as a fast horizontal teleport with a travel distance of 10 meters. Shift renders you completely invisible (except for a trail) and invulnerable for the duration of the animation.

Casting Shift grants one stack of 'Light Shift' for 11 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Light Shift grants 10%|21%|33% increased 3 Arc, 4 Stasis, and Lord of Wolves Weapon Damage at 1|2|3 Stacks.

Light Shift additionally grants 10% increased Weapon Damage against 5 Stasis-debuffed enemies.

Light Shift's buff stacks with all other buff sources.

Passive Class Ability regeneration is disabled for the duration of Light Shift. Instead, Weapon Kills grant 60% Class Ability Energy while Light Shift is active.

entries.title: Reciprocity
entries.description: Hitting allies with healing projectiles from the weapon restores 3 HP to you for each projectile.

entries.title: Offensive Grip
entries.description:
Scoring 3 damage instances grants 1 ammo.

Passively grants:
• 5 Impact (~3% increased damage)
• 20 Charge Rate
• 10 Guard Resistance
• 10 Guard Endurance

entries.title: Eye of the Storm
entries.description:
Grants a scaling buff to Handling and Accuracy as your Shield Health drops below 40 and reaches maximum strength at 0 Shield HP.

Buff at maximum strength grants:
• 30 Handling
• 40% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 17% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth

The buff linearly scales from 0% at 80 Shield HP to 100% at 0 Shield HP (Critical Health).

It initially triggers as you drop to 40 Shield HP — giving you 50% of the maximum buff. However, as you regenerate your Shield Health, the buff will still remain until you reach 80 Shield HP where the benefits scale down to zero.

entries.title: Vengeance
entries.description:
Receiving damage highlights the enemy that dealt it for 8 seconds. Highlighting cannot be transfered to a different target before it expires.

Killing the highlighted enemy grants the Vengeance buff for 6 seconds, providing a 95 HP Overshield.

Highlighting is disabled while Vengeance is active.

entries.title: Stasis Loader
entries.description:
Grants the following to 0 Stasis Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Quickdraw
entries.description:
Switching to the Weapon grants 100 Ready/Stow Handling and a 0.95x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier for 1 second.

Buff is removed as soon as ADS input is pressed.

entries.title: Elemental Capacitor
entries.description:
Grants Passive Bonuses based on the element of your selected Super's element:
• 0 Solar: 🡅55 Reload Speed
• 1 Arc: 🡅55 Handling
• 2 Void: 🡅25 Stability
• 3 Strand: 🡅25 Airborne Effectiveness
• 4 Stasis: 🡅25 Recoil Direction & 20% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty

🡅 Stat Bonuses are increased by 5.

entries.title: Perfect Float
entries.description:
After being in Combat for 6 seconds:
Grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness and 35% Flinch Resistance for 🡅12 seconds.

Can activate while stowed. Dealing and receiving damage refreshes the buff duration.

For Pefect Float, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last 🡅3.5 seconds.

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 2 seconds. Allowed time between damage exchanges is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.title: Jolting Feedback
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Direct Hits with the weapon within 3 seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to apply 0 Jolt.

Being 1 Amplified decreases the number of Hits required.

Hits needed to activate normally | while 2 Amplified:
• Submachine Guns, Trace Rifles: 🡅17 | 3 13
• Machine Guns: 🡅14 | 4 11
• Auto Rifles: 🡅14 | 5 11
• Pulse Rifles: 🡅13 | 6 9
• Sidearms: 🡅9 | 7 7
• Rocket Pulse Rifle: 🡅7 | 8 5
• Scout Rifles, Hand Cannons: 🡅5 | 9 🡅3
• Swords: 🡅5 | 10 🡅4
• Glaives, Linear Fusion Rifles: 🡅3 | 11 3
• Rocket Sidearm, Sniper Rifle?: 🡅3 | 12 2
• Bows, Grenade Launchers: 🡅2 | 13 2
• Aggressive Frame Fusion Rifle?: 🡅2|114

🡅 Number of Hits required while not 15 Amplified is decreased by 1.

entries.title: Stasis Targeting
entries.description:
Grants the following to 0 Stasis Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Dearly Departed
entries.description:
Grants 25% [PVP: 5%] Damage Resistance (Resist x2) to you and allies inside Rifts you create. (0 Well of Radiance does not count but you can cast a Rift inside it for the benefits)

Reaching Critical Health grants the Dearly Departed buff, granting 50% [PVP: 25%] Class Ability Energy.

Buff lasts until you are no longer at Critical Health, essentially serving as a cooldown.

Dying spawns a Healing Rift at your location.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Truth Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants stacks of 'Reaper's Tithe' based on the number of simultaneously killed enemies. Maximum of 4 stacks. (e.g. triple kill ⇒ 3 stacks)

'Reaper's Tithe' grants 20%|30%|40% increased damage for 15 seconds at 2|3|4 stacks (1st stack does not exist). Timer only starts after firing.

Additional Weapon Kills extend the buff duration by 6 seconds, but not beyond the initial 15-second duration.

Scoring a higher number of simultaneous Kills than the currently active stack count will not "upgrade" the buff.

entries.title: Freehand Grip
entries.description: Passively decreases Hip-Fire Accuracy Cone Size by 30% and grants a 0.95x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier.

entries.title: Blessing of the Sky
entries.description:
Hip-Firing consumes one stack of 'Noble Rounds' and fires a healing orb that seeks the closest ally within a ? meter radius.

Healing orbs restore 90HP to all allies within a ? meter radius of impact, and grant both you and them 'Blessing Of The Sky'.

Blessing of The Sky is an Empowering Buff that grants 35% [PVP: 15%] increased Weapon Damage and 100 Class Stat for 11 seconds.

entries.title: Vanguard's Vindication
entries.description: Weapon Kills restore 10 HP.

entries.title: Well-Rounded
entries.description:
Grenade Ability usage and Elemental Melee hits grant 1 Stack of Well-Rounded for 15 seconds. Super Ability usage grants 2 Stacks. Maximum of 2 Stacks.

Each Stack grants 10 Range, 10 Stability, and 10 Handling.

Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

entries.title: No Backpack
entries.description:
This gun has no reserve ammo and fires at 49 RPM. Deals ~47% increased damage against PvE Combatants compared to an Aggressive-Frame Sniper Rifle.

Shots fired deal 2761 [PVP: 497] precision damage.

Kills or assists with abilities and other guns generate ammo based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 1 Ammo (per 2 kills)
• Elites: 2 Ammo
• Miniboss and Bosses: 3 Ammo
• Guardians: 1? Ammo

entries.title: Adept Charge Time
entries.description: Passively decreases Charge Time by 40ms without affecting damage.

entries.title: Disorienting Grenades
entries.description:
Passively grants -200 Blast Radius, 25% decreased damage, and 15% decreased detonation radius.

Enemies within 6 meters of the explosion are disoriented for 4.5 seconds. Disorient radius cannot be increased using other perks.

Champions and Bosses are unaffected by Disorient.

(Disorient is effectively the equivalent of 0 Arc Blind without any of the elemental synergies and anti-champion benefits)

Players near the explosion briefly lose their HUD and have their screen distorted for up to ? seconds. Duration varies depending on the distance from the blast.

entries.title: Break the Bank
entries.description:
Direct Hits apply 'Blighted' to the target, dealing twice as much tick damage as Blighted Pools at half the rate for 9.5 seconds. Killing Blighted enemies causes them to drop a Blighted Pool.

Targets can only take damage from a single instance of Blighted at a time.

Enemies that are Blighted can take simultaneous damage from a Blighted Pool, and also take 25% increased damage from Malfeasance and Wish-Ender.

Blighted targets are STILL NOT CONSIDERED "TAKEN COMBATANTS".

entries.title: Heavy Burst
entries.description: Hard-hitting two-burst fire.

entries.title: Aggressive Frame
entries.description: Hard-hitting, high recoil. Increases rate of fire after kill.

entries.title: Bray Inheritance
entries.description:
Weapon Hits grant Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy. Does not require Direct Hits.

Ability Energy gains on Hits by weapon:
• Trustee: 0.35%
• Posterity: 0.45%
• Commemoration: 0.4%
• Heritage: 0.85%
• Succession: 1.5%
• Bequest: 2% (Grenade and Class Ability only)

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Colony Catalyst
entries.description: Increases Magazine Size by 1 (7🠚8) and grants 30 Ammo Generation.

entries.title: Repulsor Brace
entries.description: Kills against 0 Void Debuffed enemies grant a 45 HP 1 Void Overshield for 8 seconds (12 with 2 Echo of Persistence).

entries.title: No Distractions
entries.description:
Grants 35% Flinch Resistance after 1 second of Aiming Down Sights (ADS) without firing. Remains active until you're no longer ADS.

Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed.

entries.title: Enlightened Action
entries.description:
Weapon Hits grant Stacks of Enlightened Action for 2 seconds. Maximum of 12 Stacks.

Stat bonuses at 1|2|…|12 Stacks:
2|7|12|15|20|25|30|35|38|40|45|50 Handling and Reload Speed

Stacks granted per hit by Weapon Type:
• Hand Cannons: 3 Stacks
• Bows: ? Stacks
• Automatic Weapons: 1 Stack

entries.title: Field Prep
entries.description:
Grants the following while Crouched:
• 50 Reload Speed
• 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 0.8x Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier

Passively grants 20 Ammo Generation stat. (50% more than 1 Ammo Generation armor mod)

entries.title: Play with Your Prey
entries.description:
0 Void Rocket applies 1 Suppression for 10 seconds.

2 Solar Rocket applies 60 3 Scorch (90 with 4 Ember of Ashes).

entries.title: Osmosis
entries.description:
Grenade Ability usage refills 50% of your Magazine (rounded up) from reserves and changes the weapon's element to match your equipped Grenade Ability until stowed.

Magazine Refill cannot be triggered again without stowing the weapon first.

Kinetic weapons lose their Passive Damage Bonus against non-Boss PVE Combatants (10% on 0 Primary, 15% on 1 Special).

Perks that replace your Grenade Ability (such as 2 Gunpowder Gamble or Transcendence Grenades) will also trigger Osmosis.

🡅 Passively grants 5 Handling.

entries.title: Surrounded
entries.description:
Being within 15 meters of 3 Enemies grants 🡅47% increased damage. Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once the condition is no longer met.

Exceptions:
• Swords only receive a 🡅41.75% damage increase.
• Grenade and Rocket Launchers receive a 🡅41.75% Explosive Damage increase and a 🡅47% Impact Damage increase.
• Wolfpack Rounds receive a 🡅41.75% Explosive Damage increase.

🡅 Damage is increased by a further 5%. (40%🠚47%, 35%🠚41.75%)

entries.title: One-Two Punch
entries.description:
Hitting a target with 🡅10 of the 12 Pellets in the spread increases the damage of your next Melee attack within 3 seconds.

Melee Damage increase by weapon type:
• Shotgun: 150% additional base melee damage
• Hand Cannon: 75% [PVP: 100?%] additional base melee damage

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

The buff does not stack with the passive Melee Damage increase against 0 Frozen non-Boss targets. The higher buff of the two takes precedence.

🡅 Requires 2 fewer Pellets to activate.

entries.title: Evolution
entries.description:
Transmutation Spheres act like Relics and grant three actions. Spheres last 30 seconds once on the ground, start with 30 ammo on pickup, and drain at a rate of 1 ammo per second. Dropping a Sphere despawns it.

• Light Attacks deal 270 [PVP: 150] damage, disorient combatants, and cost 1 ammo. You can attack twice per second. Airborne attacks deal 25% reduced damage.

• Heavy Attacks consume the sphere, slamming it on the ground for 1350 [PVP: 300] damage with no falloff, and 0 Suppress enemies in a 5 meter radius.

• Guarding projects a draining field in a 5 meter radius around you. The field disorients enemies, deals 28 [PVP: 12] damage every 0.3 seconds to lifesteal 5 HP, and grants 80% [PVP: 50%] damage resistance along with knockback immunity.

Guarding drains 1 ammo every 0.25 seconds, slowing at 3 ammo and halting on the final round. Guarding at 1 ammo deals increasingly lethal self-damage every 0.7 seconds until you stop or die.

entries.title: Void Scavenger
entries.description:
Only works in PvE game modes.

Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to 0 Void Weapons matching the Ammo Type.

Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.

Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.

Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.title: Temporal Unlimiter
entries.description:
Kills in Auto Rifle mode grant 'Overcharge' stacks. Maximum of 6 Stacks.

Tier 1 and 2 Minors, as well as Tier 1 Elites grant 1 stack. All other enemy tiers and players grant 2 stacks.

At 6 stacks, hold [Reload] to change this Fusion Rifle into a Linear Fusion Rifle. Grants three Hobgoblin-like shots that deal 1475 [PVP: 537] precision damage and 200% increased damage against Champions. Stowing after activation removes all charged shots.

Precision Kills while in this mode trigger a 0 Solar Ignition that deals 5% more damage than base.

Exiting Linear Mode refills the magazine.

entries.title: Rapid-Fire Frame
entries.description: Full Auto. Deeper ammo reserves. Slightly faster reload when magazine is empty.

entries.title: Finality's Auger Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants the Bait and Switch trait:
Dealing damage with a weapon starts a 7 second timer. Dealing additional weapon damage resets the timer to 7 seconds.

Dealing damage with all 3 of your weapons without letting the timer run out grants you 'Bait and Switch' for 10 seconds, granting 30% increased damage.

Timer is disabled while Bait and Switch is active, requiring a full activation sequence once the buff expires.

entries.title: Shattering Blade
entries.description: Grants 67% increased damage for Grounded Heavy Attacks that consume all remaining ammo.

entries.title: Red Death Reformed Catalyst
entries.description:
Scoring 2 [PVP: 1] kills grants 'Red Death Charged'.

Your next kill with Red Death Reformed consumes this buff and triggers a burst of healing, granting 120 HP (0 Cure x2) to allies within a 7.5 meter radius of you.

This kill also spawns a 1 Restoration Orb at your feet, granting you and allies 2 Restoration x2 for 4 seconds (6 with 3 Ember of Solace) on pickup.

entries.title: Proximity Power
entries.description:
Weapon Kills while within 15 meters of an enemy grant a stack of Proximity Power 10 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Each stack grants 🡅18 Melee stat.

🡅 Grants 3 more Melee stat per stack.

entries.title: Seriously, Watch Out
entries.description:
Grants one stack of 0 Bolt Charge every 1.5 seconds while 1 Juggernaut's Shield is active.

While 2 Speed Booster is active, allies in a ""certain"" area behind you receive 3 Speed Booster.

...We have no idea what they were cooking with this rework, but it's here to stay I guess.

entries.title: Backup Plan
entries.description:
Grants the following for 🡅2.5 seconds upon readying:
• 30% decreased Charge Time
• 20% decreased damage
• 100 Handling

Weapon must be stowed for 3 seconds before readying for the perk to activate.

Linear Fusion Rifles only: firing the weapon refreshes the buff duration (but only at higher framerates).

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.title: Phase Magazine
entries.description:
Sets the Submachine Gun's damage and magazine profile to that of a Precision Frame.

Does not grant Precision Frame intrinsic benefits.

entries.title: Kickstart
entries.description:
Upon sliding after sprinting for 1.5 seconds with the weapon held:
Grants 15% increased damage and 20% decreased Charge Time for ? seconds.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased.

entries.title: Stasis Siphon
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a 0 Stasis Weapon.

Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Vex Mythoclast Catalyst
entries.description:
Landing 15 hits within 3 seconds of each, or scoring a kill, grants 20% increased damage, 20 Stability, and 20% reduced Accuracy Cone Size for 5 seconds.

Buff applies to Auto Rifle mode only.

entries.title: Encore
entries.description:
On Weapon Kill, for 🡅7.5 seconds:
Grants 1 Stack on Bodyshot Kills and 2 Stacks on Precision Kills. Maximum of 4 Stacks.

Each stack grants 5 Range, 8 Stability, and -1.25% Accuracy Cone Size.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.title: Lightning Seeker
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] at full Charged Edge stacks to fire a seeking 0 Arc Wave.

Lightning Seeker Properties:
• Aggresively tracks the closest enemy within a 32 meter radius, dealing 1634 [PVP: Death] damage and applying 1 Jolt
• Additionally chains to 4 additional targets within a 10 meter radius on hit, dealing 65 damage

entries.title: Fourth Time's the Charm
entries.description:
Scoring 4 Precision Hits within 🡅3 seconds of each refills 2 Ammo into the Magazine from thin air.

Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity. Precision Hit counter persists through stow.

🡅 Allowed time between Precision Hits is increased by 1 second.

entries.title: Unrelenting
entries.description:
Starts Health Regeneration and restores 🡅70 HP upon reaching 100% Activation Progress with Weapon Kills within 5 seconds of each.

Activation Progress by Enemy Rank:
• Minor Combatants: 34%
• Players: 67%
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 100%

🡅 Restores an additional 5 HP.

entries.title: Ashes to Assets
entries.description:
Increases Super Energy Gains from Grenade Kills based on Enemy Rank with 1|2|3 Mods equipped:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 1%|?|?
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: ?|?|?
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: ?|?|?
• T4 Minors, T3-T4 Elites, and higher: 5%|?|?
• Players: ?|?|?

Bonus Super Energy gains from Grapple Melee Kills are reduced by 50%. Kill can only trigger either Ashes to Assets or Hands On but not both.

entries.title: Tight Fit
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Direct Weapon Hits within 3? seconds of each grants ~20% Class Ability Energy. There is no cooldown on hits or activation procs (Hint: Use DoT Weapons).

Activation progress granted by weapon type:
• Submachine Guns, Trace Rifles: 7.14%
• Auto Rifles, Machine Guns: 8.33%
• Pulse Rifles: 9.1%
• Sidearms: 12.5%
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 16.7%
• Swords, Shotguns: 20%
• Fusion Rifles, Bows, Glaives, Grenade Launchers, Sniper Rifles: 34%

Casting Dodge reloads all equipped weapons, collects all nearby ammo bricks within 15 meters, and grants you 1 Stack of 'Tight Fit' for 15 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks. Counts as a manual reload and will activate reload-triggered perks such as Kill Clip.

Allies within 15 meters receive the same number of stacks as you have after the Dodge.

Stat Bonuses at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 40|40|45|50|55 Reload Speed
• 0%|7.5%|8.5%|9%|11% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• 40?|40?|45?|50?|55? Handling

entries.title: One for All
entries.description:
Scoring Weapon Hits against 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each grants 35% increased damage for 🡅11 seconds. Does not require Direct Hits.

Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.title: Vermin
entries.description: Finishing a reload within 3 seconds of a kill grants 0 Void Invisibility for 5.8 seconds.

entries.title: Jötunn Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants the Cornered trait:
Grants 15% decreased Charge/Draw Time while within 15 meters of 2 enemies.

Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once no longer surrounded.

Also grants the Incandescent trait:
Weapon Kills trigger a 0 Solar explosion that applies 30 1 Scorch Stacks (40 with 2 Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.

Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more 3 Scorch Stacks.

4 Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.

entries.title: Shot in the Dark
entries.description:
Entering 0 Void Invisibility grants 'Shot in The Dark' until you leave Invisibility. Lasts for 2.5 seconds upon exit.

While Shot In The Dark is active:
• 25% increased damage
• Hits apply 1 Weaken for 6 [PVP: 3] seconds
• Kills grant 2 Invisiblity again

entries.title: Paracausal Imbuement
entries.description:
Kills grant bonus Super Energy based on Combatant Rank.

Refills the magazine on Super cast.

Grants 20% increased damage for 20 seconds once Super energy reaches 0%.

entries.title: Harmonic Scavenger
entries.description:
Only works in PvE game modes.

Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to Weapons matching your Super Element and the Ammo Type.

Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.

Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.

Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.title: Willing Vessel
entries.description:
Dealing damage or scoring kills increments continuously scales up stat bonuses. Stacks displayed on-screen are only visual aides, the buff ramps up continuously.

Maximum effect is displayed as x5 Willing Vessel. Stat bonuses constantly decrease by 2.2?% of the maximum bonus per second?.

Stat bonuses when the visual stack display reaches 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• ?|?|?|?|20? Stability
• ?|?|?|?|30? Handling
• 2?|5|10|25|30 Reload Speed
• ?|?|?|?|15% decreased Draw/Charge Time
• 20|40|50|70|80 Charge Rate (Swords)

entries.title: Strategist
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 10% Class Ability Energy.

Kills with Fusion Rifles, Glaives, Shotguns, and Sniper Rifles grant 20%.

Class Ability usage grants ? Stability for ? seconds.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: And Another Thing
entries.description:
Grants an extra Grenade Ability Charge and a passive copy of Firepower.

Weapon Kills grant 10% Grenade Ability Energy, and using a Grenade Ability refills your weapon's magazine.

entries.title: Bolt Scavenger
entries.description:
Picking up a Crossbow Bolt grants ? Handling and ? Reload Speed for 4 seconds.

Picking up additional Bolts adds 3? seconds to the buff duration up to the maximum of 15 seconds.

🡅 Buff duration is increased.

entries.title: Hunter's Trace IV
entries.description:
Deals 100% increased damage against Champions at all times.

Scoring 12 Precision Hits grants a charge of 'Targeting Data'. Maximum of 4 charges.

Hold [Reload] to convert each fully charged stack of Targeting Data into a precision sniper round. Sniper rounds fire at 72RPM, have perfect accuracy (even from the hip), and deal 1833 [PVP: 474] precision damage.

Hits with sniper rounds trigger a 322 [PVP: 20] damage Kinetic Shockwave that applies Exhaust for 5 seconds in a 6 meter radius.

entries.title: Hunter's Trace II
entries.description:
Deals 100% increased damage against Champions at all times.

Scoring 12 Precision Hits grants a charge of 'Targeting Data'. Maximum of 4 charges.

Hold [Reload] to convert each fully charged stack of Targeting Data into a precision sniper round. Sniper rounds fire at 72RPM, have perfect accuracy (even from the hip), and deal 1833 [PVP: 474] precision damage.

Hits with sniper rounds trigger a 322 [PVP: 20] damage Kinetic Shockwave that applies Exhaust for 5 seconds in a 6 meter radius.

entries.title: Hunter's Trace III
entries.description:

Scoring 12 Precision Hits grants a charge of 'Targeting Data'. Maximum of 4 charges.

Hold [Reload] to convert each fully charged stack of Targeting Data into a precision sniper round. Sniper rounds fire at 72RPM, have perfect accuracy (even from the hip), and deal 1833 [PVP: 474] precision damage.

Hits with sniper rounds trigger a 322 [PVP: 20] damage Kinetic Shockwave that applies Exhaust for 5 seconds in a 6 meter radius.

entries.title: Rapid Cooldown
entries.description:
Class Ability usage grants 6.25% increased Sprint Speed for 10 seconds. Duration is not refreshable.

Sprinting grants the following benefits:
• 1 stack of 0 Frost Armor every 3 [PVP: 6] seconds
• 100% [PVP: 200%] Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate
• Doubled [PVP: 100% Additional] Grenade and Melee Ability Regeneration Rate

For as long as 1 Frost Armor is active, you are granted x3 [PVP: x1] Stasis Weapon Surge.

Multiplicative Ability Regeneration Rate increase in PVE is applied after all additive Ability Regeneration Rate modifiers.

entries.title: Kinetic Siphon
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a Kinetic Weapon.

Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Blessing of Order
entries.description:
Passively grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Lumina and Noble Seekers grant Noble Rounds to it.

Standing in a Rift or 0 Well of Radiance creates Noble Seekers that seek out allies within 40 meters and apply buffs to them:
• Healing Rift Seeker: restores 70 Health, 60 Shields, and starts Health Regeneration
• Empowering Rift Seeker: grants 100 Class Stat and 35% [PVP: 15%] increased damage for 5 seconds (Empowering Buff)

Noble seekers spawn at a constant rate based on your Fireteam size.

Buffing allies with Noble Seekers grants ?|25%|?|?|? Class Ability energy based when your fireteam has 2|3|4|5|6 members.

Seekers prioritize allies who have not been healed in the last 8 seconds followed by nearby allies. Seekers will not target an ally more than once every 4 seconds.

entries.title: Discord
entries.description:
Grants the following for 🡅8 seconds upon readying the weapon within 5? seconds of scoring a Kill with a different weapon:
• 25% decreased ADS Animation Duration
• 25% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 30 Airborne Effectiveness

Weapon Kills while Discord is active fully refill the Magazine of 0 Primary Weapons, and refund 1 Ammo for 1 Special and 2 Power Weapons. (Scoring multiple kills with a single shot/burst still only refunds 1 ammo.)

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1? second.

entries.title: Sneak Bow
entries.description:
Crouching grants the following benefits:
• Prevents Radar Ping when shooting
• ? Reload Speed
• 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 25% increased Hold Time

entries.title: Puppeteer's Control
entries.description:
Improves 0 Drengr's Lash and grants 1 Woven Mail for 10 seconds upon 2 Suspending enemies.

When used with a Barricade:
3 Drengr's Lash creates 2 additional Lashes. Lashes gain stronger seeking capabilities, travel 16.7% (5 meters) farther, and 4 Suspend for 3 seconds longer (2 seconds for Minibosses).

When used with 5 Thruster:
Created 6 Strand Knot is launched towards nearby enemies with some tracking. Detonates and 7 Suspends nearby targets on contact.

entries.title: Telesto Catalyst
entries.description:
Increases the Magazine Size by 3 (4🠚7) and grants 40 Ammo Generation.

Triggering Harbinger's Pulse three times will cause Telesto to start smoking and short circuiting, granting access to 'Harbinger's Seethe'.

Hold [Reload] to slap your malfunctioning Telesto. On its next direct hit, it will spawn a Wormhole from the Telesto Dimmension, wildly spraying 22 Telesto Bolts over 2.25 seconds.

entries.title: Fervid Coldsnap
entries.description:
Grants 0 Coldsnap Grenades an extra Ability Charge, better tracking, and travel 17.5% farther and faster.

Damaging an enemy with 1 Coldsnap Grenades grants Grenade Ability Energy.

Grenade Energy gains based on Enemy Rank:
• Enemy Players: 7%
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 10%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 22%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 34%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 50%

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Slice
entries.description:
Using your Class Ability (even while the weapon is stowed) grants you 'Slice' for 8 seconds.

While 'Slice' is active, damaging non-0 Severed targets 1 Severs them, grants a stack of Slice, and refreshes the buff duration. (Hitting immune targets also triggers this.)

Reaching 5 stacks immediately removes the buff.

If the 2 Severing hit kills the target, the perk will not trigger and you will not gain a stack.

entries.title: Fighting Lion Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 30 Reload Speed.

Firing this gun grants equipped 0 Kinetic and 1 Heavy ammo weapons the following benefits for 3 seconds:
• 100 Handling
• 30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size

entries.title: Prospector Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 40 Blast Radius and 50 Reload Speed.

Increases Blast Radius by ?% and decreases Self-Damage by 40% while within 15 meters of 3 enemies.

Effect lingers for 3.5 seconds once no longer surrounded.

entries.title: Tome of Dawn
entries.description:
While a 0 Solar Super Ability is equipped:
