• Aiming Down Sights while airborne grants 'Tome of Dawn'

Tome of Dawn lasts 2.8 seconds and holds you in place midair. Weapon Hits add ? seconds to its duration.

Tome of Dawn grants the following benefits:
• 15% Damage Resistance
• 25% Flinch Resistance
• Enemies are less accurate when targeting you
• Weapon Kills grant 1 Restoration x1 and refill the magazines of stowed weapons from reserves

entries.title: Fusion Harness
entries.description:
Grants the following with 0 Fusion Grenades equipped:

• 100% Class Ability Energy on Fusion Grenade Kills
• Passive 20% Additional Base Grenade Ability Recharge Rate

While 1 Radiant, in an Empowering Rift, or in a 2 Well of Radiance:
• Weapon Kills grant 15% 3 Fusion Grenade energy
• Weapon Hits grant 5% 4 Fusion Grenade energy (0.4 second cooldown between activations)

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Resolute
entries.description:
Scoring 2 to 3 0 Arc Kills within 10 seconds of each grants 1 Stack of 1 Arc Weapon Surge for 11 [PVP: 6] seconds. Maximum of 4 Stacks. 2 Arc Kills while at 4 Stacks refresh the buff's duration.

Grants a 75 HP Overshield upon casting the 3 Fists of Havoc Super that negates Precision Damage. As long as it does not get fully destroyed, the overshield regenerates over 7 seconds after not receiving damage for 5 seconds.

Scoring Kills with 4 Fists of Havoc refunds ?% Super Energy.

Once 5 Fists of Havoc ends, it grants 4 Stacks of 6 Arc Weapon Surge for 30 [PVP: 6] seconds.

entries.title: Cayde's Retribution
entries.description:
Counts as a "Dealer's Choice" origin trait weapon, but does not benefit from the trait itself.

Precision Hits and collecting Orbs of Power charge up a Golden Gun. Precision Hits grant 16.67% progress, and Orbs of Power grant 8.34% progress. Progress persists through death, and Rally Flags fully charge this perk.

Hold [Reload] at full charge to cast 'Cayde's Retribution' for 3 shots. Cayde's Retribution lasts 16 seconds and deals 100% increased precision damage to Bosses.

Each Precision Hit with Cayde's Retribution grants 45%|90% increased damage for the 2nd|3rd shot.

Wearing Celestial Nighthawk transforms Cayde's Retribution into a single high-powered shot that deals ~43% more damage than 3 successive precision shots and causes enemies to explode if defeated.

Does not count as a super for related effects or buffs.

entries.title: Advanced Reflexes
entries.description:
Upon Aiming Down Sights or Guarding within 1 second of receiving damage:
• 5% Increased Damage
• 30 Mobility
• 40 Handling
• 35 Charge Rate (Swords) for 7.5 seconds.

Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.title: Concussive Dampener
entries.description:
Reduces Incoming AoE Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.title: Contending Cascade
entries.description:
Scoring kills within 4 seconds of another kill each grant a stack of Contending Cascade. Maximum of ? stacks. Kills from any source count.

Each stack of Contending Cascade grants increased Handling and Reload Speed.

Starting at 15 stacks, kills trigger an explosion matching this weapon's element.

entries.title: Horizon Ironsights
entries.description: Iron Sights. Allows for peripheral vision while scoped in.

entries.title: Personal Assistant
entries.description:
Hits apply 0 Jolt.

Aiming at a target for 0.5 seconds highlights them and reports their Health and Shield percentages, Distance, and Power Level into the scope.

Maximum Highlight Range of 150 Meters.

entries.title: Target Acquired
entries.description:
Grants the following benefits while Personal Assistant is active:
• 18.35% increased damage
• 31.34% increased precision damage
• ? Aim Assist
• 50% decreased Flinch, Recoil, and Accuracy Cone Size

Buff lasts for 1 second after being off-target.

entries.title: Icarus Grip
entries.description: Passively grants 15 Airborne Effectiveness.

entries.title: SUROS Legacy
entries.description:
Kills have a 25% chance to grant 20 HP and begin Health Regeneration.

Linearly grants 5% to 10% increased damage as the magazine decreases from 50% capacity.

entries.title: Impulse Amplifier
entries.description:
Passively grants 20 Reload Speed and 15% decreased Reload Animation Duration (20% for Rocket Launchers).

Passively increases Projectile Velocity based on Weapon Archetype:
• Rocket Launchers: 10%
• Support-Frame Auto Rifles: 15%
• Micro-Missile Frame Weapons: 25%

entries.title: Arc Resistance
entries.description:
Reduces Incoming 0 Arc Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.title: Snapshot Sights
entries.description:
Passively decreases the ADS Animation Duration:
• 50% decrease on 0 Primary Weapons
• 20% decrease on 1 Special Weapons

entries.title: Danger Zone
entries.description:
Increases Blast Radius by ?% and decreased Self-Damage while within 15 meters of 3 enemies.

Effect lingers for 3.5 seconds once no longer surrounded.

Grenade Launchers: 40% decreased Self-Damage

Rocket Launchers: 99.99% decreased Self-Damage and allows for rocket jumping

entries.title: Tear
entries.description:
Precision Kills 0 Sever enemies within ? meters of the target for ? seconds.

? second cooldown between activations.

entries.title: Ignition Trigger
entries.description:
Accuracy Cone Size and Accuracy Cone Growth are massively decreased while hip-firing. Hip-Firing grants 50% reduced recoil, which is carried into ADS if the trigger stays held down after initially hip-firing.

Firing 20 rounds within 0.125 seconds of each begins 'Ignition Trigger'. Ignition Trigger grants 100% [PVP: 50%] increased damage and 3% reduced Accuracy Cone Growth size while active. In exchange, it drains 15 HP every 0.4 seconds until you reach Critical Health.

While Ignition Trigger is active, firing builds its meter at a rate of 20% per second. Meter drains at a rate of 25% per second when not firing.

This meter serves as a timed period in which Ignition Trigger can be resumed without warmup and provides no other benefits. Meter progress persists through reload.

entries.title: Wicked Implement Catalyst
entries.description:
0 Stasis Shards grant 7 ammo on pickup that can overfill the magazine, up to 100% capacity.

Due Tithing Harvest refilling the entire magazine on 1 Stasis Shard pickup, the overfill effect only activates if your current magazine is above 13 shots remaining.

Grants the Headstone trait:
Precision Kills create a Large 2 Stasis Crystal at the target's location.

Tier 1-2 Minor and Tier 1 Elite Combatants only spawn a Medium 3 Stasis Crystal.

Creating 5 4 Crystals within ? seconds prevents the perk from activating for 5 seconds.

entries.title: Firepower
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power on Grenade Kills that grants 0.8%|1.1%|1.25%|1.5% Super Energy with 1|2|3|4 Mods equipped. (4 Mods is only achievable through Exotic Armor)

10|5|1|1? second cooldown between activations.

entries.title: Ager's Scepter Catalyst
entries.description:
While at full Super Energy, Hold [Reload] to activate Will Given Form.

Will Given Form immediately takes away 20% Super Energy, then drains at a rate of 4% Super Energy per second to grant the following benefits:
• Overfills the magazine from reserves to 192
• 80% increased damage
• 20 [PVP: 0] slow stacks per hit

Effect lasts until deactivated by holding [Reload] again, or until the magazine is emptied, super energy is drained, or the weapon is stowed.

Does not count as a super for related effects or buffs.

entries.title: Gathering Light
entries.description:
Kills grant one stack of Gathering Light. Maximum of 10 stacks.

Hold [Reload] to consume all stacks, granting 10% Melee, Grenade, and Class Ability energy per stack.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Binary Orbit
entries.description:
Scoring opposing Elemental Alignment Kills grants 25% increased damage for 🡅10.5 seconds.

Buff can be activated while stowed.

Elemental Alignment details:
• 0 Arc, 1 Solar, 2 Void Kills buff Kinetic, 3 Stasis, and 4 Strand Weapons
• Kinetic, 5 Stasis, and 6 Strand Kills buff 7 Arc, 8 Solar, and 9 Void Weapons

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 2 seconds.

entries.title: LN2 Burst
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] any time after scoring a kill to load a Freezing Shot. Animation is tied to reload speed.

Freezing Shot must charge for 533ms before firing.

Buff is removed on stow once the freezing shot is loaded.

entries.title: Tunnel Vision
entries.description:
Grants the following for 5 seconds upon finishing a Reload within 3.6 seconds of a Weapon Kill:
• 20 Aim Assist
• ? ADS Handling

🡅 Buff Duration is increased.

entries.title: The Perfect Fifth
entries.description:
Precision Hits refill 1 ammo.

Scoring 4 Precision Hits loads a delayed Solar Explosive. Solar Explosive is removed after 6 seconds.

Solar Explosive detonates after a 0.5? second delay, dealing 215 [PVP: 78] damage and applying 0 40 Scorch stacks (60 with 1 Ember of Ashes) in a 4 meter radius. Damage falls to 0% at the edge of the radius.

entries.title: Disaster Plan

entries.title: Cornered

• ? Increased Target Acquisition

🡅 Benefits activate at a higher remaining health percentage.

entries.title: Sharpshooter

Possesses inherently increased weapon stats, which are boosted further during Cayde's Retribution.

Increased benefits while Cayde's Retribution is active:
• 18% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• 60% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• ? Aim Assist, ?% decreased ADS Animation Duration, ?% Flinch Resistance

entries.title: Kill Clip
entries.description:
Finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of a kill grants 25% increased damage for 5 seconds.

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

entries.title: Blast Distributor
entries.description:
Dealing Explosive Weapon damage grants a stack of 'Blast Distributor' for 5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

'Blast Distributor' grants 10 Grenade Stat per stack.

entries.title: Latent Power
entries.description:
Direct Hits, Precision Hits, and Kills with this weapon charge 'Latent Power'. The amount of charge granted varies by source:

• Precision Hits: 8%
• Kills: 25%

Upon reaching 100% Progress towards Latent Power, hold [Reload] to enter 'Unleashed Power' and gain the following benefits for 13 seconds:

Every shot fired in this mode also 0 Weakens targets for 6 seconds on hit and gain Explosive Payloads that deal an additional 87 [PVP: ?] damage on hit.

After 3 seconds, Unleashed Power changes into Overwhelming Power, which drains 13 HP every second for the remaining 10 seconds of the buff.

Special Note: While Empowerment is active and this weapon is readied, Rocket Launchers and Micro-Missile damage is increased by 30%. Hazardous Propulsion Rockets deal 200% increased damage.

entries.title: High-Impact Frame

entries.title: Unflinching Solar Aim
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights with 0 Solar Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.title: Cryosthesia 77K Catalyst
entries.description: 0 Shattering a 1 Frozen enemy instantly refills the magazine.

entries.title: Banned Weapon
entries.description:
Fires a 3-round burs-...

[This tooltip has been redacted in accordance with Official Vanguard Policy]

entries.title: Cold Fusion
entries.description:
Linearly grants up to 80% increased damage as the beam is charged to 100% power.

Beam Energy is generated in two ways:
• Dealing damage grants 40% energy over 1 second. Initially has a 0.267 second delay before this starts granting energy.
• Collecting an 0 Ionic Trace grants 50% energy over 0.5 seconds

Not generating energy for 1.05 seconds rapidly cools the weapon down to 0% over 0.2 seconds.

Reaching maximum energy grants 100 Stability and 100 Reload Speed.

entries.title: Hands-On
entries.description:
Melee Kills grant additional Super energy based on Enemy Rank with 1|2|3 mods:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: ?% | ?% | ?%

entries.title: Orbs of Restoration
entries.description:
Grants 10%|13%|15% Ability Energy to the least-charged Ability on Orb of Power pickups.

Abilities with multiple charges do not receive any energy if they already have a full charge.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Heirloom Catalyst
entries.description:
0 Scorch and 1 Ignitions that originate from this weapon deal 5% increased damage.

Direct Hits with Charged Shots apply 2 20|40|60 Scorch Stacks at Charge Level 1|2|3. Scorch application is unaffected by 3 Ember of Ashes.

Grants 10% increased damage to 4 Scorched enemies.

Weapon Kills trigger a 5 Solar explosion that applies 30 6 Scorch Stacks (40 with 7 Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.

Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more 8 Scorch Stacks.

9 Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.

entries.title: Utility Kickstart
entries.description:
When a Class Ability Charge is fully consumed and you have active Armor Charges:
Consumes active Armor Charges and grants Class Ability Energy.

Each Mod and Stack of Armor Charge counts as one 'charge' for Class Ability Energy refunds.

Class Ability Energy gains with 2|3|etc. 'charges':
[PVE] 16.2% | 21.7% | 28.4% | 34.4% | 38.4% | 41.3% | 43.4% | 45%
[PVP] 12.5% | 14.2% | 16.2% | 18.7% | 21.7% | 25% | 28.4% | 31.6%

entries.title: Full Choke
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights:
• Decreases Shotgun Pellet Spread by 5%
• Reduces Precision Multiplier by 7.6% (1.1078x🠚1.0294x)

entries.title: Adaptive Munitions
entries.description:
Hits against Barrier Champion or non-matching Elemental Shields deal increasingly higher damage.

Buff is removed upon hitting a matching shield or an unshielded enemy.

Damage increase by Weapon Archetype:
• Fusion Rifles: untested
• Machine Guns, Auto/Pulse/Trace Rifles: 10% per hit, up to 50%
• Linear Fusion Rifles: 22% per hit, up to 44%
• Bows, Glaives, Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 25% per hit, up to 50%

entries.title: Wild Card
entries.description:
Kills release a varying number of Submunitions on top of where the enemy died. 6? second cooldown between activations.

The number of Submunitions spawned is tied to Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 1 Submunition
• Elites and Players: 3 Submunitions
• Minibosses and Bosses: 7 Submunitions

Submunitions:
• Identical to Telesto Bolts in behavior, exploding on proximity or contact and last up to 10.5 seconds after attaching to a surface.
• Deal up to 39.5? [PVP: ?] damage and inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling.

entries.title: MIDA Synergy
entries.description: Superb handling. Move faster with this lightweight weapon equipped. This weapon grants additional speed benefits when MIDA Multi-Tool is also equipped.

entries.title: Pyrogenesis
entries.description: Charged Laser applies 0 20 Scorch (30 with 1 Ember of Ashes) for every hit and triggers an 2 Ignition on every kill.

entries.title: The Queenbreaker Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants the Rewind Rounds trait:
Upon emptying the Magazine:
Refills 60% of the number of Hits landed (rounded up) into the Magazine from reserves.

Hits are counted from either your last reload or the last time the perk was triggered. Does not require Direct Hits.

Requires firing 28.75% of the Magazine Capacity for the refill to activate.

Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.

Hits after triggering a refill do not count while the Rewind Rounds buff is active (1? second).

Adaptive Burst Linear Fusion Rifle behavior:
• Each individual bolt in the burst counts as a Hit
• Refill amount is uniquely 14% of the number of Hits rounded up (numbers are subject to change once we get more data points)

entries.title: Cranial Spike III
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant one stack of 'Cranial Spike' for 4 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Cranial Spike's benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 3.5%|7%|10%|14%|17% increased damage against Combatants
• 1|2|3|4|5 Rounds added each reload
• 8|16|24|32|40 Range
• 2|4|6|8|10 Stability
• 4|8|12|16|20 Aim Assist
• 3%|6%|9%|11%|14% decreased Reload Animation Duration

entries.title: Cranial Spike II
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant one stack of 'Cranial Spike' for 4 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Cranial Spike's benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 3.5%|7%|10%|14%|17% increased damage against Combatants
• 1|2|3|4|5 Rounds added each reload

• 3.5%|7%|10%|14%|17% increased damage against Combatants
• 1|2|3|4|5 Rounds added each reload

• 4|8|12|16|20 Aim Assist

entries.title: Honed Edge
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to consume up to 4 ammo. Gain one stack of 'Honed Edge' per ammo consumed to create a single shot with increased damage.

Damage increase based on stacks of Honed Edge:
Honed Edge x2:
• 12% [PVP: 20%] bodyshot damage
• 79% [PVP: 91%] critical damage
Honed Edge x3:
• 25% [PVP: 45%] bodyshot damage
• 131% [PVP: 167%] critical damage
Honed Edge x4:
• 112% [PVP: 165%] bodyshot damage
• 291% [PVP: 389%] critical damage

entries.title: Solar Siphon
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a 0 Solar Weapon.

Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Embers of Light
entries.description:
Requires a 0 Solar Super to be equipped to function.

Weapon Kills grant Class Ability Energy based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 18%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 26%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 40%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites: 60%
• T4 Elites, Minibosses: 80%
• Bosses: 100%
• Players: 30%

Weapon Kills while standing in a Healing Rift grant 7 seconds (10 with 1 Ember of Solace) of 2 Radiant to you and allies within a 10 meter radius.

Weapon Kills while standing in an Empowering Rift grant 3 Cure x1 to you and allies within a 10 meter radius.

4 Daybreak Kills grant 5 Cure x2 and 10 seconds (15 with 6 Ember of Solace) of 7 Radiant to you and allies within a 10 meter radius.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Exhumation
entries.description:
While grounded, Charged Heavy Attacks grant 0 Void Invisibility for 6.3 seconds and release four tracking orbs 8? meters ahead of you. Each orb deals 507 [PVP: 363] damage in a ? meter radius with no falloff.

Void Orbs deal 30% increased damage to Minor combatants.

entries.title: Harmonic Ammo Generation
entries.description:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to Weapons matching your Super Element with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).

entries.title: Paracausal Pellets
entries.description: Landing 10 out of 12 pellets instantly 0 Freezes or 1 Ignites the target, matching on the element of the shot.

entries.title: Unflinching Stasis Aim
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights with 0 Stasis Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Arc Loader
entries.description:
Grants the following to 0 Arc Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:

entries.title: Utility Finisher

Finisher consume 3 or more Stacks of Armor Charge and grant Class Ability Energy.

Energy Gains with 3|4|5|6 Stacks Consumed:
70% | 80% | 90% | 100%

entries.title: Enhanced Athletics
entries.description:
Passively increases non-sprinting Movement Speed and non-ability Jump Height.

Grants 30|50|60 Mobility Stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Mobility as a stat is capped at 130. Warlocks and Titans inherently have 30 mobility, while Hunters have 100 [PVP: 70].

Forward (including left and right diagonally) Walk Speed with 0|1|2|3 Mods equipped by class:
• Warlocks and Titans: 5.6|6.2|6.6|6.8 m/s
• Hunters (PvP): 6.4|7|7.6|7.6 m/s
• Hunters (PvE): 7|7.6|7.6|7.6 m/s

Strafing (side-to-side and backwards movement) decreases these speeds by 15%. Strafe speed is capped at 6 m/s.

ADS decreases these speeds by 25% and cannot exceed 6 m/s. Sidearms uniquely only suffer a 15% penalty.

Crouching decreases these speeds by 45%. Crouch speed is capped at 4 m/s.

Holding a Machine Gun, Rocket Launcher, Guarding with a Sword, and certain Exotic Heavy Weapons have an additional 15% movement speed penalty.

Sprint speed is set to 8 m/s by default and is capped at 9 m/s. This cap applies to regular Forward Walk Speed as well.

entries.title: Withering Gaze
entries.description:
Aiming Down Sights (ADS) for 1.5 seconds without firing and staying ADS causes your next shot to apply 0 Weaken on a Direct Hit.

Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed.

entries.title: Edge of Action Catalyst
entries.description: Kills against 0 Void Debuffed enemies grant a 45 HP 1 Void Overshield for 8 seconds (12 with 2 Echo of Persistence).

entries.title: Beacon Rounds
entries.description:
Kills with the weapon grant a Stack of Beacon Rounds for 🡅7 seconds. Maximum of 4 Stacks.

Each Stack grants increased projectile tracking. Projectile Tracking is only in effect while the Targeted Reticle is active.

• 15 Reload Speed
• 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 45% increased Projectile Tracking Cone size

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1? second.

entries.title: Melee Kickstart
entries.description:
When a Melee Ability Charge is fully consumed and you have active Armor Charges:
Consumes active Armor Charges and grants Melee Ability Energy.

Each Mod and Stack of Armor Charge counts as one 'charge' for Melee Energy refunds.

[PVE] 16.2% | 21.7% | 28.4% | 34.4% | 38.4% | 41.3% | 43.4% | 45%
[PVP] 12.5% | 14.2% | 16.2% | 18.7% | 21.7% | 25% | 28.4% | 31.6%

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Seraph Rounds
entries.description: Combines the overpenetration from Armor-Piercing Rounds, the guaranteed ricochets from Ricochet Rounds, and the flinch increase from High-Caliber Rounds.

entries.title: Planetary Torrent
entries.description:
Increases Class Ability Regeneration Rate while 3 enemies are within 15 meters:
250%|666%|1085%|1500% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate with 3|4|5|6+ enemies

1 second after casting a Rift:
The Rift releases an 0 Arc Shockwave that deals 400 [PVP: 100] damage and knocks back enemies in a 7.5 meter radius. Additional 1 Arc Shockwaves are released every 5 seconds.

Enemies killed by Shockwaves explode, dealing up to 200 [PVP: 100?] 2 Arc damage.

While you have an 3 Arc Super equipped, Shockwaves and explosions 4 Blind nearby targets.

entries.title: Counterattack
entries.description:
Upon receiving damage within 0.5 seconds of starting to Guard:
Grants 50% increased damage for 🡅3 seconds.

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.title: Cobra Totemic
entries.description: Passively grants 10 Airborne Effectiveness, 35 Reload Speed, and 35 Handling to all weapons.

entries.title: Stylostixis
entries.description:
Grants 0 Arcane Needles 1 Shield-Piercing properties.

Scoring an 2 Arcane Needle hit on an enemy marks them with a vertical mark for 10 seconds. Marked Enemies explode on death, releasing a 3 Suspending Blast that 4 Suspends and damages targets in a 10 meter radius.

5 Suspending Blast damage by Enemy Rank:
Players: 40, Minors: 80, Elites: 120, Minibosses: 160, Bosses: 200

Landing 2 6 Arcane Needle hits on a Marked Enemy triggers 7 Suspending Blast that deals 2x damage.

Landing 5 8 Needlestorm Hits on a single enemy triggers a 9 Suspending Blast that deals 11x damage and inherits Super damage buffs.

10 Arcane Needle Kills and Killing 11 Suspended targets grant Melee Energy based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 15%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 22.2%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites, Enemy Players: 33%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 100%

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Merciless Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 40 Range and 40 Stability.

Finishing a reload within 5.3? seconds of a Kill grants 0 Cure x2 to you and 1 Cure x1 to allies within 15 meters.

entries.title: Biotic Enhancements
entries.description:
Being within 15 meters of 3+ enemies grants the 'Biotic Enhancements' buff for 5 seconds.

Biotic Enhancements benefits:
• 35 Handling and 35 Reload Speed
• 50% increased Super damage
• 165% [PVP: 100%] increased Melee damage
• 100% increased Glaive Melee damage

entries.title: Fury Conductors
entries.description:
Melee Hits grant 1 Stack of Armor Charge. (Each damage instance is counted separately)

Having active Armor Charges grants Melee Damage Resistance against Combatants. Receiving a Melee Attack consumes all Armor Charges and emits a 0 Jolting 1 Arc Burst in a ? meter radius.

Benefits with 1|2|…|6 Armor Charges:
• 2 Arc Burst Damage: 90|130|170|200|225|245
• Melee Damage Resistance against Combatants: 23.3% | 46.7% | 70% | 73.3% | 76.7% | 80%

entries.title: Horns of Doom
entries.description:
Scoring 2 to 3 0 Void Kills within 10 seconds of each grants 1 Stack of 1 Void Weapon Surge for 11 [PVP: 6] seconds. Maximum of 4 Stacks. 2 Void Kills while at 4 Stacks refresh the buff's duration.

Elemental 3 Void Melee Kills grant the following:
• 20% [PVP: 10%] Super Energy once per ability usage
• All 4 Stacks of 4 Void Weapon Surge

5 Sentinel Shield's Shield Throw Hits grant 10% Super Energy, extending the Super's Duration. 6 Sentinel Shield Light Attacks grant 100% Shield Throw energy.

entries.title: Cursed Thrall
entries.description:
After a Melee Kill, for 7.5 seconds:
Weapon Kills cause the enemy to explode, dealing up to 123.5 [PVP: ?] damage over a 4.5? meter radius.

Explosions inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling and match the element of the Weapon.

entries.title: Swashbuckler
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of 'Swashbuckler' for 🡅6.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.

(Glaive) Melee Kills grant all 5 Stacks instantly.

Damage increase at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
6.7% | 13.3% | 20% | 26.6% | 33.3%

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 2 seconds.

entries.title: Cauterizing Flame
entries.description:
Only works with a 0 Solar Super Ability equipped.

Reaching Critical Health consumes your Class Ability to spawn a 1 Sunspot under you.

Manually casting your Class Ability also spawns a 2 Sunspot under you.

The spawned 3 Sunspot grants the Sol Invictus buff even without having the Aspect equipped. (The Aspect is still required to extend the sunspot's duration)

entries.title: Imperial Allegiance
entries.description:
Grants one stack of Imperial Allegiance for each ally within 15 meters.

Benefits at 1|2|3 stacks:
• ? Charge Rate
• 3.5%|7%|10.5% increased Cooling Efficiency
• 3.5%|7%|10.5% increased damage while above 50% Weapon Heat

entries.title: Deconstruct
entries.description:
Upon scoring multiple hits within 6 seconds of each:
• Refills 10% of the Magazine (rounded up) from reserves. Can be reactivated without a cooldown. Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.
• Grants 40% increased damage against Constructs and Vehicles for 5 seconds. Additional hits refresh the buff duration.

Number of Hits Required:

• Otherwise: 2 + 50% (25% on 0 Primary Weapons) of Base Magazine Capacity rounded down

Hits against Constructs and Vehicles provide 1.5x activation progress for 1 Primary weapons and 2x progress for 2 Special weapons.

Wave Frame Grenade Launchers:
• Direct Impacts count as 2 Hits
• Doesn't receive bonus activation progress against Constructs and Vehicles

entries.title: Nano-Assault
entries.description:
Every Nanite that attaches to you grants 4.5% progress to 'Nano-Assault'. Requires 21 Nanites to reach full charge.

Hold [Reload] at full Nano-Assault charge to enter 'Assault Mode'. Assault Mode immediately grants 14 ammo, 25% increased damage, and 30% Sword Energy per second for the duration of the buff. Stowing the blade during Assault Mode ends it and refunds 50% charge.

While Nano-Assault is active, Fully-Charged Heavy Attacks launch a solar wave that travels 13 meters and creates a 'Swarm-Nado' on impact. This detonates in a 7? meter radius with no damage falloff. Swarm-Nado deals ? damage in a 5 meter radius every 0.3 seconds for 3 seconds, and constantly generates ? nanites that return back to you.

entries.title: Lasting Impression
entries.description:
Passively grants 🡅55 Blast Radius.

Rockets attach on impact and detonate after 3 seconds, dealing 35% increased Explosive Damage.

🡅 Grants 5 more Blast Radius passively.

entries.title: Outlaw
entries.description:
Precision Kills grant 70 Reload Speed with a 0.9x decreased Reload Animation Duration for 6 seconds.

Buff is removed on stow.

entries.title: Restorative Finisher
entries.description:
Finishers consume 2 Stacks of Armor Charge and grant 50% Ability Energy to your least-charged Ability.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Feeding Frenzy
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Feeding Frenzy for 3.5 seconds, increasing the Reload Speed of the weapon. Maximum of 5 Stacks.

Bonuses at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 🡅13|🡅55|🡅65|🡅85|100 Reload Speed
• 2.5%|10%|13%|16%|20% decreased Reload Animation Duration

entries.title: Sleight of Hand
entries.description:

entries.title: Thresh

Weapon Kills grant an additional 🡅1.33% Super Energy.

Kills with Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaives, and Fusion Rifles grant an additional 🡅2% instead.

🡅 Bonus Super Gains are increased by 33.3%. (e.g. 1.5%⁠🠚⁠2%)

entries.title: Worm's Hunger
entries.description:
Kills scored by abilities and other guns grant stacks of 'Worm's Hunger'. Maximum of 20 stacks.

Stacks earned based on Combatant Rank:
• Tier 1 and 2: 1 stack
• Tier 3 and 4: 4 stacks
• Minibosses, Bosses, and Players: 5 stacks

Worm's Hunger grants 10% increased damage and ?% increased Blast Radius for each stack, up to a maximum of 200% increased damage and ?% larger Blast Radius.

entries.title: Mechanized Autoloader
entries.description: Picking up a 0 Heavy Ammo brick refills the magazine.

entries.title: Spindle

Dealing damage with any 0 Threadling grants one stack of 'Spindle'. Maximum of 25 stacks.

Spindle linearly grants the following benefits per stack:
• 2% Increased Damage (up to 50%)

• ? Reload Speed

Weapon hits refresh this buff.

entries.title: Firefly
entries.description:
On Precision Kills:

entries.title: Armor of the Colossus
entries.description:

entries.title: Penance

entries.title: Saint's Fists

Hitting a target with 18 pellets in a burst grants your next Melee attack within 3 seconds 300% Additional Base Melee Damage.

Dealing Melee Damage grants 'Saint's Fury' for 8.5 seconds, providing the folllowing:
• 45% increased weapon damage
• 15% decreased Charge Time
• ? Increased Reload Speed

Saint's Fury can be refreshed by melee damage and is removed on stow.

entries.title: Class Font
entries.description:

entries.title: Closing Time

• 10-20% decreased Handling Animation Duration
• 5?% to 10?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size

0 Special weapons only receive 50% of the benefits. Stats are rounded up.

entries.title: Abundant Ammo

entries.title: Ancillary Ordinance
entries.description:
Killing Elemental-Debuffed targets or scoring 3 Elemental Kills within 4 seconds of each grants this weapon one stack of Ancillary Ordinance. Maximum of 4 stacks.

Stacks can be earned while stowed.

Kills consume a stack of Ancillary Ordinance to release a seeking Micro-Missile from the enemy's point of death, traveling up to 30 meters before dealing 330 [PVP: 100] damage in a small radius.

Killing Elemental-Debuffed Targets with this weapon instantly spawns a missile.

entries.title: Ruinous Effigy Catalyst
entries.description: Kills, or damaging Champions, Minibosses, or Bosses, with your Transmutation Sphere (inconsistently) grants 30% [PVP: 15%] increased weapon damage for 7 seconds.

entries.title: Big Frigid Glaive

Fires a large Freezing Orb that travels for 6 seconds and moves at a rate of 9.5 meters per second. The orb fires 1 Freezing projectiles every 0.5 seconds at any non-frozen target within a 10 meter radius of it. Projectiles deal 60 [PVP: 11] damage and have a 3 meter freezing radius.

Freezing Orb deals 1282 [PVP: 250] damage on impact and detonates in a 10 meter radius, applying 2 60 Slow for 4 seconds (8 with 3 Whisper of Durance).

entries.title: Tempest Cascade
