entries.title: Void Siphon
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with with a 0 Void Weapon.

Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Repulsor Force
entries.description:
Fires a powerful 0 Void Blast that knocks back enemies. Minibosses and Bosses are unaffected by knockback.

Hits apply 1 Suppression as well as a higher tier 2 Weaken that increases all damage dealt to the target by 30% for 10 seconds.

entries.title: Ascending Amplitude
entries.description:
Requires 0 Stormtrance to be equipped to function.

Casting your Super grants 1 Amplified.

While 2 Amplified, 3 Arc Ability Hits grant x1 4 Bolt Charge. 0.6 second cooldown between activations.

Hits and Kills during 5 Stormtrance grant a Stack of 'Ascending Amplitude' for 8 seconds. Maximum of 30 Stacks.

Ascending Amplitude:
• Decreases the Super Energy cost of 6 Stormtrance's Ionic Blink by 50% (6.25%🠚3.125%).
• Increases 7 Stormtrance's damage by 6.7% per Stack, up to 200% bonus damage at maximum stacks.

Refunds up to 30% of Super Energy based on the number of enemies killed with your Super.

entries.title: The Lament Catalyst
entries.description:
Direct Hits against 0 Scorched Enemies apply 20 additional 1 Scorch (30 with 2 Ember of Ashes) on a 0.5 second cooldown

Scoring 3 Direct Hits within 3? seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to 3 Scorch the target. This allows The Lament to Scorch through a singular revved attack.

Hit counter persists through stow.

4 Scorch applied by Burning Ambition to Unscorched targets counts as Weapon Damage, and thus, triggers Revved Consumption's healing, granting 7HP per tick.

entries.title: Rega's Refrain
entries.description: 0 Stasis kills refills 10 ammo into the magazine from reserves.

entries.title: Adept Mag
entries.description:
Passively grants 40 Magazine Stat (identical to Backup Mag combined with Tactical Mag).

On Swords, it grants 40 Ammo Capacity Stat (5 more than having 2 Reserves Mods or Enduring Blade) and the Handling penalty has no effect.

entries.title: All-Star
entries.description:
Picking up a 0 Special ammo brick refills the magazine and grants 100 Reload and 35% [PVP: 15%] increased damage for 6 seconds. 1 Heavy ammo bricks grants the buff for 9 seconds.

Timer only decreases while the weapon is readied, and remains paused while stowed.

entries.title: Malfeasance Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 20 Range.

Grants the Vorpal Weapon trait:
Deals increased damage against Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles, as well as Players in their Super Ability.

Damage increase by Ammo Type:
• 0 Primary Weapons: 20% [PVP: 60%]
• 1 Special Weapons: 15% [PVP: 20%]
• 2 Power Weapons: 10% [PVP: 20%]

entries.title: Together Forever
entries.description: This weapon has a well-rounded adaptive grip, reliable and sturdy. Kills with this weapon reload Sturm and overflow a bonus damage round into it.

entries.title: Sweet Business Catalyst
entries.description: Grants 25% increased Flinch Resistance while at maximum Rate of Fire.

entries.title: Coldheart Catalyst
entries.description:
Passively grants 20 Stability and 20 Reload Speed.

(Yes, these are the same stats that are set to 100 when at 100% Fusion Energy)

Refills 5% of the magazine (rounded up) every 1.5 seconds while 0 Amplified.

Activating 1 Speed Booster increases this rate to once every 0.25 seconds, and allows the perk to overfill the magazine up to double its base capacity.

entries.title: Extrovert
entries.description:
Weapon Kills while within 15 meters of 3 enemies or a Nightmare restore 60 HP after a 0.25 second delay.

Glaive Melee Kills also count.

3 second cooldown between activations.

entries.title: Grenade Font
entries.description:
Grants 20|40|50 Grenade stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.

Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.title: Bolt Thrower
entries.description:
Adopts the profile of a Balanced 'Perfect Vent' Heat Weapon.

Aiming down sights charges explosive bolts that deal high damage in a 4 meter radius. Detonation damage falls off to 50% at the edge of the radius.

entries.title: Temporal Anomaly
entries.description:
While in 0 Arc Mode with Arc Overcharge active:
Precision Hits and Kills call down a lightning strike, consuming 34% Overcharge energy and dealing 502 [PVP: ?] 1 Arc Damage in a ? meter radius

While in 2 Stasis Mode with Stasis Overcharge active:
Precision Hits and Kills trigger a Stasis Explosion, consuming 34% Overcharge energy and dealing 126 [PVP: ?] damage in a ? meter radius. The explosion creates two 3 Medium Stasis Crystals that spawn 4 meters away on either side of the target at a 45 degree angle.

entries.title: Hot Swap
entries.description:
Readying the gun within ? seconds of receiving damage grants 30 Handling for 4 seconds.

Swords receive 100 Guard Resistance, 100? Guard Endurance, and 100 Charge Rate.

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

entries.title: Unflinching Kinetic Aim
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights with Kinetic Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.title: Celerity
entries.description:
Passively grants 20 Handling and 20 Reload Speed.

While Last Guardian Standing:
• 100 Handling, 100 Reload Speed, ? Aim Assist
• Greatly increased Flinch Resistance
• Increased Accuracy
• Stronger Sight Highlight
• Enables Radar while ADS

Does not activate when playing solo.

entries.title: Pressurized Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Under Pressure trait:
Grants linearly scaling benefits as the Magazine drops from 50% of its base capacity to empty:
• 12.5% to 25% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 0 to 30? Stability

entries.title: Frenzy Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Feeding Frenzy trait:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Feeding Frenzy for 3.5 seconds, increasing the Reload Speed of the weapon. Maximum of 5 Stacks.

Bonuses at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 8|50|60|75|100 Reload Speed
• 2.5%|10%|13%|16%|20% decreased Reload Animation Duration

entries.title: 4-Timer Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Fourth Time's The Charm trait:
Scoring 4 Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each refills 2 Ammo into the Magazine from thin air.

Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity. Precision Hit counter persists through stow.

entries.title: Outlaw Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Outlaw trait:
Precision Kills grant 70 Reload Speed with a 0.9x decreased Reload Animation Duration for 6 seconds.

Buff is removed on stow.

entries.title: Creeping Attrition
entries.description:
Landing 4 Precision Hits within 4.5 seconds of each other grants 'Creeping Attrition' for 4.5 seconds. Further Precision Hits refresh the timer. Buff is removed on stow.

While Creeping Attrition is active, Precision Hits apply 0 40 [PVP: 20] Slow for 4 seconds (8 [PVP: 6] seconds with 1 Whisper of Durance).

entries.title: Be the Danger
entries.description:
Kills with Unrepentant's Burst refresh the buff and reload the magazine, granting a second burst.

Counts as a true reload, not refill, for on-reload perks.

entries.title: Cluster Bomb
entries.description:
Rocket detonations release 8 Cluster Bombs.

Each Cluster Bomb deals up to 150 [PVP: 11] damage in a 4 meter radius.

entries.title: Stunning Recovery
entries.description: Stunning a Champion refills the magazine from reserves, restores 60 HP, and grants 40 Recovery for 3 seconds.

entries.title: Adaptive Ordnance
entries.description:
Scoring 4 kills in a single volley grants 'Adaptive Ordnance' and generates one ammo out of thin air into your reserves.

Adaptive Ordnance grants 50% increased damage to your next volley.

entries.title: Spread Shot Package
entries.description: Aiming down sights decreases pellet spread by 25%.

entries.title: Harmonic Resistance
entries.description:
Reduces Incoming PVE Combatant Damage matching your Subclass Element by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.title: Subjugation
entries.description:
Perk behavior changes depending on the enemy rank of the target you're shooting.

Against Minor and Elite Combatants:
Shots explode on hit, dealing up to 6.5 (32.5 on Shotgun) additional damage in a 3? meter radius. Explosions inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling.

Trace Rifle-specific: only every 4th Hit explodes.

Against Minibosses and Bosses:
Exhausts for 5 seconds on hit.

Against Players:
Grants ?% Flinch Resistance for ? seconds.

entries.title: Deathbringer Catalyst
entries.description: The initial Orb Damage is increased by 63%, allowing maximum damage to be reached 1 second sooner.

entries.title: Dead Man's Tale Catalyst
entries.description:
While not Aiming Down Sights:
• Increases RPM to 130
• 50% Reduced Accuracy Cone Size
• 50% Reduced Accuracy Cone Growth
• 27% [PVP: 15%] increased damage at x5 Cranial Spike

Aim Assist Cone will favor precision hits in the case of overlapping regions.

entries.title: Pick Your Poison
entries.description:
Charged Burst behavior changes based on aiming method.

While Aiming Down Sights, it fires hitscan bullets which deal 100% increased critical damage to marked targets.

When Hip-Firing, it fires aggressively tracking projectiles which deal 20% increased bodyshot damage to marked targets.

entries.title: Resurgence Directive
entries.description:
Light Attack Hits grant 10% Sword Energy. Kills grant 30%. Kills or 3 Light Attack Hits spawn 3 Nanites.

Heavy Attacks with at least 10% Sword Energy consume 3 ammo and launch a Solar Wave that travels 10 meters. Aerial Heavy Attacks always spawn a wave.

Wolfsbane's damage is increased against enemies with Outbreak Perfected Nanites on them, up to a maximum increase of 25% at maximum Outbreak nanites.

Nanites restore ? HP as they attach to you.

entries.title: Harmonic Targeting
entries.description:
Grants the following to Weapons matching your Super Element 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Strand Scavenger
entries.description:
Only works in PvE game modes.

Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to 0 Strand Weapons matching the Ammo Type.

Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.

Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.

Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.title: Air-Cooled Core
entries.description:
Grants ? Handling and ?% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty while your magazine is fully loaded or weapon Heat is below 10%.

Sprinting for 0.5 seconds grants ? Reload Speed for 6 seconds.

entries.title: Cryocannon
entries.description:
Deals 25% increased damage to 0 Frozen Enemies and always destroys 1 Stasis Crystals on hit.

Charging this weapon makes your next shot create a triangular pattern of 2 Stasis Crystals on impact with the top pointed towards you.

3 Stasis Crystals spread outwards as one Small Crystal at the front, two Medium Crystals in the middle, then three Large Crystals in the back.

entries.title: Cranial Spike
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant one stack of 'Cranial Spike' for 4 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Cranial Spike's benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 3.5%|7%|10%|14%|17% increased damage against Combatants
• 1|2|3|4|5 Rounds added each reload
• 8|16|24|32|40 Range
• 2|4|6|8|10 Stability
• 4|8|12|16|20 Aim Assist
• 3%|6%|9%|11%|14% decreased Reload Animation Duration

entries.title: Bad Juju Catalyst
entries.description: String of Curses's maximum duration is increased by 2 seconds (5.5🠚7.5).

entries.title: Heir Apparent Catalyst
entries.description:
Arc Shield gains 75% [PVP: 25%] Damage Resistance.

Refills 50% of the magazine upon Arc Shield being depleted.

entries.title: Unplanned Reprieve
entries.description:
Powered Heavy Attacks spawn clusters of 'Telesto Bolts', each dealing 68 or 117 [PVP: 83] damage.

Telesto Bolt clusters vary by Sword Frame:
• Aggressive: 8 bolts in a clustered spread ahead of you
• Caster: 6 bolts on projectile point of impact
• Lightweight: 7 bolts in a forward arc ahead of you
• Vortex: 10 bolts spread around you
• Wave: 8 bolts at the end of the wave

entries.title: Starless Night
entries.description:
Weapons of Light from 0 Ward of Dawn can now persist outside the bubble for 15 seconds.

While Weapons of Light is active:
Gain stacks of 'The Saint' by dealing damage or scoring kills against enemies. Stacks granted by kill are based off Enemy Rank, with Minor Tier enemies granting 1, Elite Tier enemies granting 2, and Miniboss+ enemies granting 3. Stacks granted by hits are granted after dealing ? damage.

Maximum of 14 stacks. Stack duration is equal to the remaining duration of your currently active 1 Ward of Dawn.

Gaining a stack of 'The Saint' through 2 Kinetic or 3 Void damage triggers a 4 Suppressing Blast in a 6? meter radius around the target, applying 5 Suppression for 6 [PVP: ?] seconds.

Picking up your 6 Ward of Dawn consumes all stacks of The Saint and extends its active timer by ? seconds per stack consumed. Maximum of two extensions per super.

entries.title: Quick Access Sling
entries.description: Passively decreases Ready/Stow Animation Duration by 10%.

entries.title: Devouring Rift
entries.description:
Casting your Empowering Rift with a 0 Void Super equipped grants 1 Devour for 11 seconds (17 seconds with 2 Echo of Persistence), and kills with 3 Devour active grant you 10% Class Ability energy.

Empowering Rifts cast by you have additional behaviors:
• Standing in the Rift grants you 4 Devour for 11 seconds (17 seconds with 5 Echo of Persistence)
• Exiting and re-entering the Rift refreshes the duration of 6 Devour without needing a kill.

Legacy (Non-Functional) Perk:
Empowering Rifts you cast grant 7 Overload Shot to you and allies. Previously, this allowed non-intrinsic weapons to gain 8 Disruption, with the exception that it could not overwrite pre-existing intrinsics.

However, now that all weapons have an intrinsic Breaker-type, Secants can no longer overwrite any of them. This breaks the UI in your weapons tray and leaves this portion of the exotic non-functional.

entries.title: Wish-Dragon's Talons
entries.description:
Grants an additional 0 Frenzied Blade Ability Charge.

1 Frenzied Blade or 2 Flechette Storm Hits grant a Stack of 'Wish-Dragon's Talons' for 2.75 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

Can only grant 1 Stack per ability usage.

'Wish-Dragon's Talons' grants 25%|60%|120% increased 3 Frenzied Blade and 4 Flechette Storm damage at 1|2|3 stacks.

5 Banner of War's Pulses grant 5% 6 Frenzied Blade Ability Energy and an additional 5% for each ally within 10 meters.

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Dynamic Sway Reduction
entries.description:
Each shot while holding down the trigger grants the following benefits:
• 1 Stability
• ?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 10% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth

Reaches maximum strength after 10 shots, granting 10 Stability, ?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size, and 100% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth.

entries.title: Gutshot Straight
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights:
• Increased Body Shot damage
• 15% decreased Auto Aim Cone Size (No effect on Magnetism AKA reticle stickiness)

Body Shot damage increases:
• Auto/Scout Rifle, Bow, Hand Cannon: 20%
• Pulse/Trace Rifle, Sidearm, SMG: 10%

entries.title: Ionic Conductor
entries.description:
0 Ionic Traces move 66% faster and grant increased Ability Energy.

Total ability energy gained per 1 Ionic Trace:
Grenade: 25% | Melee: 25% | Class Ability: 30%

2 Ionic Trace pickups grant 10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability energy to allies within 15 meters.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Spinning Up
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to switch to this mode.

While holding down the trigger, RPM increases by 17%|33% after 12|24 bullets.

Kills generate ?% increased 0 Special Ammo Progress.

entries.title: Dream Work
entries.description:
Once per reload, ally kills on targets previously hit by the Weapon or Kills on targets damaged by allies grant the following benefits:
• Loads 66% of the Magazine Capacity (rounded up) into the weapon from reserves (this can overfill the Magazine)
• Grants ? Reload Speed

Bows receive ?% decreased Draw Time instead of the above benefits.

entries.title: Cerberus+1 Catalyst
entries.description:
Holding [Reload] within 7 seconds of scoring a kill grants the following benefits for 7 seconds:
• 50% [PVP: 10%] increased damage
• 30% decreased Pellet Spread

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

entries.title: Overcharge Capacitor
entries.description:
Sprinting, sliding, or firing increases the Overcharge Capacitor based on the action performed:
• Sliding grants 10% progress
• Sprinting for 0.25 seconds grants 20% progress per second
• Shooting for 0.267 seconds grants 20% progress per second

Overcharge Capacitor linearly? grants the following benefits based on progress:
• ? Range
• ? Reload Speed

At above 40% charge, kills cause enemies to explode for 95 [PVP: 76] damage and apply 0 Blind for 10 seconds in a 7 meter radius. At 100% charge, the explosions deal 189 [PVP: ?] damage and 1 Blind for 10 seconds in an 8 meter radius.

Overcharge Capacitor decays at a rate of 33% per second after 1.1 seconds of not being built. Performing a manual reload resets your charge to 0%.

entries.title: Liquid Cooling
entries.description: Freezing Shot instantly 0 Freezes targets on direct hit, and applies Freeze [PVP: Slow x50] in a 6 meter radius around the point of impact.

entries.title: Precision Slug
entries.description:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

Uniquely deals 10% more damage than Precision Frame slug shotguns and has 5% increased damage falloff distance.

entries.title: Combat Sights
entries.description:
Left-side scope. While this scope is active, gain:
• 10 Handling
• 40 Aim Assist
• Charge Time is set to 533ms

Fires a 3-round burst of Arc Bolts. Scoring 6 hits within ? seconds of each grants 'Charge Accelerant' for 5.5 seconds and decreases Charge Time by 40%.

Charge Accelerant does not decrease damage dealt.

This scope also displays the charge status of your grenade, melee, and super.

entries.title: Marksman Sights
entries.description:
Right-side scope. While this scope is active, gain:
• 15 Range
• 10 Zoom
• Charge Time is set to 633ms

Fires a single Bolt that chains up to 5 enemies within a 10 meter radius of the original target. Applies 0 Arc Blind to all enemies hit for 9 seconds. The chaining bolts deal 27% reduced damage.

This scope also displays charge status and remaining magazine ammo.

entries.title: Omega Strike
entries.description:
Dealing damage grants one stack of 'Missiles Loaded'. Maximum of 20 stacks.

Hold [Reload] to convert these stacks into an equal number of Arc Missiles that fire on next trigger pull, dealing 1138 [PVP: 237] damage each.

Missiles can be fired in groups of five or all at once.

entries.title: Stats for All
entries.description:
Upon damaging 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each, for 🡅11 seconds:
• 35 Handling and Reload Speed
• 10 Stability and Range
• 5% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier

Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.title: Cloudstrike Catalyst
entries.description:
Passively grants 25 Handling.

Grants the Triple Tap trait:
Scoring 3 Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each refills 1 Ammo into the Magazine from thin air.

Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity. Precision Hit counter persists through stow.

entries.title: Lightning Rounds
entries.description:
While holding down the trigger:
• Increases Rate of Fire by 25%|40% after 13|26 shots.
• Summons a Lightning Strike after 10 hits and grants 0 x1 Bolt Charge.

This weapon's reticle experiences less shake from continuous fire, and inherents benefits similiar to that of Dynamic Sway Reduction:

Each shot while holding down the trigger grants the following benefits:
• 1 Stability
• ?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 10% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth

Reaches maximum strength after 10 shots, granting 10 Stability, ?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size, and 100% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth.

entries.title: Blood Magic
entries.description:
While standing in a Rift or a 0 Well of Radiance:
• Grants 4 Stacks of Super-Matching Weapon Surge
• Damaging enemies marks them for 5 seconds, increasing your damage against them by 10% (stacks with everything, does not buff teammates' damage)
• Kills grant 'Blood Magic' for 5 seconds. Maximum of 15 seconds.

Blood Magic pauses the duration of Rifts for as long as it is active. Doesn't apply to Well of Radiance.

Swapping to Sanguine Alchemy in combat disables its effects for 10 seconds.

entries.title: Air Trigger
entries.description:
Passively grants 20 Ammo Generation Stat. (Equivalent of 1 Ammo Generation Armor Mod)

Being Airborne grants the following benefits:
• 30 Reload Speed
• 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier
• 15?% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 20?% decreased Auto Aim Cone Size

entries.title: Perpetual Motion
entries.description:
While moving at a minimum of 2 meters per second:
Grants a Stack of 'Perpetual Motion' after 2 seconds and a second Stack after 10 seconds.

Each Stack provides 10 Stability, 10 Handling, and 10 Reload Speed. All Stacks are removed if movement speed is below 2 m/s for 0.5 seconds.

Works and can activate while stowed.

entries.title: Myrmidon's Reach
entries.description:
Grants an additional 0 Shield Throw Melee Ability Charge.

1 Shield Throw gains 2 Shield-Piercing properties and 3 Weakens targets for 10 seconds on hit.

Stunning a 4 Barrier Champion with 5 Shield Throw grants a Melee Ability Charge.

Kills with 6 Shield Throw spawns a 7 Void Breach. This ignores the global 8 Void Breach spawning cooldown.

Collecting a 9 Void Breach grants 20%? 10 Shield Throw Ability Energy.

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Bipod
entries.description:
Increases Magazine Capacity by 1 and Total Reserve Size by 5. Decreases Firing Delay by 25%.

Decreases Blast Radius by 30, Reload Speed by 20, and damage by 25% (also applies to Wolfpack Rounds and Cluster Bombs).

entries.title: Phoenix Dive
entries.description:
Only usable while airborne.

Performs a dive to the ground in the direction of your movement input. Not inputting a movement direction results in a vertical downward dive.

Applies 0 Cure x2 to you and allies within 9 meters upon landing.

entries.title: Adamantine Brace
entries.description:
Passively grants 40 Airborne Effectiveness and 10 Draw Time Stat (equivalent of a Draw Time Masterwork) to Bows.

Full Draws grant 'Adamantine Brace':
• Allows Perfect Draws to be held indefinitely
• Grants 37.5% increased damage against PVE Combatants for every 0.5 seconds you hold a perfect draw, up to a 200% increase

PVE damage buff only affects the initial Impact damage (e.g. Wish Ender's overpenetration is unaffected) and expires after 4 seconds of Adamantine Brace being active.

Leviathan's Breath does not receive the damage increase.

entries.title: Sharp Edges
entries.description:
Throwing Knife Kills grant 2.5-5% Super Energy depending on Enemy Rank.

Landing 5? knives in a single 0 Blade Barrage volley triggers a 1 Solar Detonation after 2? seconds. Both volleys can trigger their own detonation, and hits do not have to be sourced on a single target.

2 Solar Detonation deals significant damage over a ? meter radius and releases ? 3 Scorching Shrapnel, which apply 4 ? Scorch (? with 5 Ember of Ashes).

6 Blade Barrage Hits and Kills refund Super Energy depending on Enemy Rank up the the maximum of 50%.

entries.title: Barrel Constrictor
entries.description:
Kills with the weapon reduce Pellet/Projectile Spread by 20% for 7.5 seconds.

Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.title: Depths of Duskfield
entries.description:
Increases 0 Duskfield Grenade radius by 25% and spawns a Medium 1 Stasis Crystal in its center.

Enemies inside a 2 Duskfield Grenade's Slowing Field deal 50% [PVP: 20%] decreased damage.

You and allies immediately receive 1 Stack of 3 Frost Armor upon entering the 4 Slowing Field and receive additional Stacks for every 0.5 seconds they stay in the field.

When combined with the 5 Touch of Winter aspect:
• Increases 6 Crystal size from Medium to Large
• Radius increase stacks additively for a total of 75%

entries.title: Demoralize
entries.description:
Precision Kills apply 0 Weaken to enemies within 7 meters of the target for ? seconds.

1.5? second cooldown between activations.

entries.title: Vexadecimal
entries.description:
Holding down the trigger for 16 rounds (is supposed to) make the 16th round 0 Weaken for 6 Seconds.

Due to an unresolved bug, this gun actually only 1 Weakens after 32 uninterrupted rounds.

Releasing the trigger after firing a Vexadecemial round (16 shots) refills 12 ammo from reserves on trigger release, as long as the current magazine isn't empty.

entries.title: Queen's Wrath
entries.description:
Aiming Down Sights while fully drawn grants Truesight. Truesight reaches 64 meters.

Buff disappears after 3 seconds or leaving ADS. Bow must be fully redrawn to reactivate Truesight.

entries.title: Monte Carlo Method
entries.description:
Dealing damage grants 2% Melee Ability Energy per hit.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

Kills have a 25% chance to grant 100% Melee Ability Energy.

entries.title: Explosive Pact
entries.description:
Grenade Ability usage or scoring a Grenade Kill grants 1 stack of Explosive Pact for 7.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

0 Healing Grenade orb pickups (by anyone) and Grenade Kills grant 1 stack each.

Running over a Speaker's Sight Healing Turret does not grant any stacks.

Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks of Explosive Pact:
• ? Stability
• 8|16|20|24|44 Reload Speed
• 0.98x|0.98x|0.975x|0.96x|0.945x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Jade Rabbit Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 30 Stability.

Hold [Reload] to consume all Fate of All Fools stacks and load a Micro-Missile. Missile has a blast radius of 8 meters with a maximum damage falloff of 45%, and deals increased damage based on the number of stacks consumed.

Deals 293 damage (122 impact/171 explosive) [PVP: ?] at base, becoming heavily weighted towards explosive damage as the stacks increase.

Damage is increased by 107%|157%|193%|223%|315%|345% at 2|3|4|5|10|15 Stacks, with a fully charged missile dealing 1304 (281 impact/1023 explosive) [PVP: ?] damage.

Micro-Missile deals no self damage and can be used for rocket jumping.

entries.title: Ergo Sum Catalyst
entries.description: Generates 3 [PVP: 1] ammo from thin air upon dealing damage with your Prismatic grenade.

entries.title: Strand Weapon Surge
entries.description:
Increases 0 Strand Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage

The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.

Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.title: One with the Void
entries.description:
0 Void Souls last 5 seconds longer and can be retrieved by interacting with them. Retrieving them grants 'Void Soul Ready' for 25 seconds, allowing it to be redeployed while keeping its Kill Bonuses.

1 Void Soul Kills permanently increase their damage and Damage Resistance, maxing out after 4 Kills:
• 25%|50%|75%|100% increased Void Soul damage
• 12.5%|25%|37.5%|50% increased Void Soul Damage Resistance

While tethered to targets, 2 Void Souls' damage ramps up to a 30% increase over 10 seconds. This damage bonus resets once no targets are tethered.

If multiple Void Souls tether the same enemy, they will each deal the damage of the first Soul to do so.

entries.title: Divinity Catalyst
entries.description:
Scoring 18 hits within 3 seconds of each causes the next hit to apply 0 Jolt. Being 1 Amplified decreases the number of hits required to 13.

Scoring 68 Precision Hits grants 25% increased damage for 11 seconds. Stowing or Reloading the weapon resets the Precision Hit counter.

Buff remains active while stowed.

entries.title: The Perfect Fifth
entries.description:
0 Scorch and 1 Ignitions that originate from this weapon deal 41% increased damage. While Transcendent, this increases to 78.5%.

Landing 5 Sword Hits causes a Solar Explosion dealing 237 [PVP: 64] damage and applying 40 2 Scorch (60 Scorch with 3 Ember of Ashes) in a 5 meter radius.

entries.title: Tap the Trigger
entries.description:
Firing grants 'Tap The Trigger' for 🡅0.76 seconds, providing the following benefits:
• 40 Stability
• 50% decreased Recoil
• 10% decreased Accuracy Cone Size

Fusion Rifles only receive 25% of the benefits.

Buff cannot be refreshed until Automatic Weapons stop firing, or until the next burst.

[Controller-Only] Weapon fires the instant trigger pressure is applied.

🡅 Stronger Effect. Duration is increased by 0.16 seconds.

entries.title: Taken Ambition
entries.description:
Scoring 12 hits on a single target within ? seconds of each other generates 22% Blight.

Blighted Seekers detonate on impact, each dealing 587 [PVP: 30?] damage in a 0.25 meter radius.

entries.title: Adept Counterbalance
entries.description: Passively grants 35 Recoil Direction.

entries.title: Superconductor
entries.description:
While Arc Conductor is active:
Gain 10% increased damage, 100 Handling, and each shot fired has a 33% chance to fully refill the magazine.

Scoring 2 to 3 hits within 0.2 seconds of each other causes the target to chain 'weak' lightning to the closest enemy within an 8 meter radius for 22 [PVP: ?] damage.

Enemies hit by this 'weak' lightning release multiple stronger chains of lightning around them, striking up to 4 targets in an 8 meter radius for 28 [PVP: ?] damage.

The stronger chains of lightning only target enemies that haven't been hit by them for 0.33 seconds.

entries.title: Wire Rifle
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to switch between Combat Sights and Marksman's Sights.

Review this weapon's scopes to learn their behavior.

entries.title: Land Tank
entries.description:
Kills with the weapon grant a stack of Land Tank. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Land Tank grants 10|20|30 Health stat and 5%|10%|15% Damage Resist against PvE Combatants for 5 seconds at 1|2|3 stacks.

entries.title: Sympathetic Arsenal
entries.description:
Passively grants 20 Reload Speed.

Finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of a Weapon Kill refills stowed weapons from reserves.

🡅 Allowed time before reloading is increased.

entries.title: Redirection
entries.description:
Hits against Minor Combatants grant 2 Stacks of Redirection. Maximum of 30 Stacks.

Stacks remain active while stowed.

Hits against Elite or higher-ranked Combatants consume up to 🡅2 Stacks to grant 🡅50% increased damage per Stack consumed.

🡅 Maximum number of Stacks consumed per shot is decreased by 1. Damage increase granted by each Stack is increased to 50% (from 33%).

entries.title: Vorpal Weapon
entries.description:
Deals increased damage against Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles, as well as Players in their Super Ability.

Damage increase by Ammo Type:
• 0 Primary Weapons: 20% [PVP: 60%]
• 1 Special Weapons: 15% [PVP: 20%]
• 2 Power Weapons: 10% [PVP: 20%]

entries.title: Centrifuse Catalyst
entries.description: While you are 0 Amplified, Overcharge Capacitor will continuously build at a rate of 7% charge per second and no longer passively decay.

entries.title: Shatter Shot
entries.description:
Uncharged shots destroy all 0 Stasis Crystals in a ? meter radius on hit.

1 Shattering three 2 Stasis Crystals within ? seconds of each instantly refills the magazine.

entries.title: Kinetic Tremors
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Direct Hits against a target within 3 seconds of each emits 3 damaging shockwaves from its location at the time of activation. Hit counter persists through stow.

Shockwaves appear 0.25 seconds after scoring enough Hits and have a 1 second delay between each pulse. With Bows, the initial delay is decreased to 0.167 seconds.

Each shockwave deals up to 90 [PVP: 20] damage in a 6 meter radius. Shockwaves deal 33.33% more damage when activated on Miniboss or higher tier PvE Combatants.

Shockwaves inherit Weapon Damage Buffs, the weapon's passive Kinetic Damage Bonus in PVE (10% on 0 Primary, 15% on 1 Special), and its Combatant Damage Scaling. They also count as non-direct Hits with the weapon for other interactions.

The perk cannot be retriggered by anyone on a target until 2? seconds after the last shockwave.

Hits required for Activation:
• Submachine Guns: 🡅13
• Auto Rifles: 🡅11
• Pulse Rifles: 🡅10
• Sidearms: 🡅7
• Precision Hand Cannons and Precision Scout Rifles: 🡅5
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 🡅4
• Bows, Sniper Rifles: 🡅2

🡅 Hit Requirements are decreased by 1.

entries.title: Thunderlord Catalyst
entries.description: Triggering a Lightning Strike refills 5 ammo from reserves.

entries.title: Explosive Head
entries.description:
Splits off 50% of the Bow's bodyshot damage into an Explosive Payload that detonates in a 3 meter radius on impact.

The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more.

Payload detonation time after hitting a target or surface depends on the distance.

The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.

[PvE] Total damage is increased by ~15% of the weapon's bodyshot damage. On crits, the overall increase is 10.33% for Precision Bows and 9.69% for Lightweight Bows.

[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.

🡅 Passively grants 5 Accuracy.

entries.title: Taken Resolution
entries.description:
Damaging 3 enemies within ? seconds of each generates 50% Blight.

Blighted Seekers deal 173 [PVP: 6.85] damage in a 3 meter radius each and chain two additional times to enemies within a 10 meter radius.

Seekers can re-target enemies already hit by them.

entries.title: Lead from Gold
entries.description:
0 Heavy Ammo Pickups grants 25% of your maximum 1 Special Ammo Reserves even while the weapon is stowed.

Equipping two 2 Special Weapons halves the amount of ammo granted.

entries.title: Touch of Malice Catalyst
entries.description:
Direct Weapon Hits grant a stack of Precision Instrument for 1.25 seconds. Maximum of 6 stacks. Reloading the weapon or missing removes all stacks...usually.

Precision damage increase at 1|2|3... stacks:
4.17% | 8.33% | 12.5% | 16.67% | 20.83% | 25%

entries.title: High-Caliber Rounds
entries.description:
Hits inflict increased Flinch on Enemies.

PVE: Tier 1-2 Minors can be repeatedly staggered. Higher Tier Combatants stagger quicker.

PVP: Flinch against Players varies based on damage and Weapon Archetype. Flinch increase ranges between 5-10%.

entries.title: Kinetic Dexterity
entries.description:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Kinetic Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.title: Firefly
entries.description:
On Precision Kill:
• Target explodes, dealing 436 [PVP: 80] 0 Solar damage in a 7.5 meter radius. Falloff begins at 3.75m.
• Grants 50 Reload Speed for 6 seconds

(Ace of Spade's Firefly is 272% stronger than the Legendary trait in PvE)

entries.title: Timed Payload
entries.description:
Splits off 55% of the Weapon's Bodyshot damage into a Explosive Payload that detonates after a 0.6 second delay. The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more.

The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.

[PvE] Total damage is increased by ~16.5% of the weapon's Bodyshot damage. On Crits, the overall increase is 10.9% for Adaptive/Precision Hand Cannons and 10.17% for Aggressive Hand Cannons.

[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.

🡅 Passively grants 5 Stability.

entries.title: Rewind Rounds
entries.description:
Upon emptying the Magazine:
Refills 🡅70% of the number of Hits landed (rounded up) into the Magazine from reserves.

Hits are counted from either your last reload or the last time the perk was triggered. Does not require Direct Hits.

Requires firing 28.75% of the Magazine Capacity for the refill to activate.

Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.

Hits after triggering a refill do not count while the Rewind Rounds buff is active (1? second).

Adaptive Burst Linear Fusion Rifle behavior:
• Each individual bolt in the burst counts as a Hit
• Refill amount is uniquely 🡅16.33% of the number of Hits rounded up (numbers are subject to change once we get more data points)

🡅 Refill amount is increased by 16.66% (60%⁠🠚⁠70%).

entries.title: Heating Up
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Heating Up for 5.5 seconds. Maximum of 2 Stacks.

Benefits at 1|2 Stacks of Heating Up:
• 15|30 Stability
• 20|40 Recoil Direction
• 15%|25% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 15%|25% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth

Buff remains active while stowed.

entries.title: Lead From Light
entries.description:
Collecting an Orb of Power grants 1 Stack of Lead from Light. Maximum of 5 Stacks.

Weapon Kills consume one stack to grant 25% increased 0 Special Ammo generation progress for that kill.

entries.title: Split Electron
entries.description:
Fires a even split spread of three arrows while hip-firing.

Aiming Down Sights and fully drawing the bow both greatly reduce this spread.

entries.title: Bullseye Bolster
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant the following benefits for 3 seconds. Buff is removed on miss or if a bodyshot occurs.
• 5% increased Rate of Fire
• 40 Reload Speed
• ? Stability
• ? Handling

entries.title: Counterbalance Stock
entries.description: Passively grants 15 Recoil Direction.

entries.title: Void Targeting
entries.description:
Grants the following to 0 Void Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Replenishing Aegis
entries.description:
Refills 1 round into the Magazine from reserves upon blocking damage.

1 second cooldown after activation. Does not work while the magazine is overfilled (assumed).

🡅 Refill cooldown is decreased.

entries.title: Paracausal Fluid
entries.description:
Scoring Hits with the weapon grants 2 Paracausal Fluid x2 for 3 seconds.

Buff drops to Paracausal Fluid x1 when stowed.

Paracausal Fluid x2 grants ? Handling, 50 Mobility, and 50 Charge Rate (Swords).

Note: test if it actually gives Mobility still.

entries.title: Dynamo
entries.description:
Class Ability usage while within 15 meters of an enemy grants Super Ability Energy.

Super Energy Gains with 1|2+ Mods:
2.5% [PVP: 1.25%] | 4% [PVP: 2.4%]

Energy Multipliers based on Class:
0 Hunters: 1x | 1 Titans: 1.2x | 2 Warlocks: 2x

entries.title: Häkke Breach Armaments
entries.description:
Passively increases damage dealt to...
• Vehicles and Automatons by 15%
• Turrets, Sentries, and Emplacements by 30%
• 0 Stasis Crystals by 45%

entries.title: Fragile Focus
entries.description:
Passively grants 20 Range but deactivates if you drop to 0 Shield HP (Critical Health).

Buff reactivates 0.5 seconds after your Shields HP fully regenerates.

🡅 Reactivation delay is decreased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.title: Eager Edge
entries.description:
Readying the Sword grants 🡅100% increased Grounded and 🡅80% increased Airborne Lunge Distance for 3 seconds.

Buff is removed on stow. 3 second cooldown after the buff is removed.

🡅 Lunge Distance bonus is increased by 25% (e.g. 80%⁠🠚⁠100%).

entries.title: Stacks on Stacks
entries.description: All Armor Charge sources grant an additional Stack.

entries.title: Phase Converter
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights, this gun becomes a Rapid-Fire Pulse Rifle and deals 30% increased damage to 0 Arc-Debuffed targets.

Defeating 1 Arc-Debuffed targets while ADS causes a explosion that deals 100 [PVP: ?] damage in an 8? meter radius and 2 Blinds for 10 seconds. Damage falls to 0% at the edge of the radius.

entries.title: Percussive Flames
entries.description:
Modifies 0 Burning Maul into a single-use slam that deals 650% increased damage and releases 3 tracking Waves. Waves create Cyclones on impact which also track enemies.

Waves apply 20 (60 with 1 Ember of Ashes equipped) 2 Scorch on Impact. The released Cyclones last 7.5 seconds and track enemies, dealing 19 [PVP: 16] damage every 0.2 seconds, while applying 3 (5 with Ember of Ashes) 3 Scorch every 0.56 seconds.

4 Consecration's center wave creates a weaker Cyclone that deals 7 [PVP: 3] damage and does not have tracking; though, it still retains the 5 Scorching capability.

Damage from multiple Cyclones can overlap.

6 Burning Maul no longer receives faster active super generation as a roaming-class super.

entries.title: Lancer's Vigil
entries.description:
Diamond Lance creates a 0 Stasis Crystal on impact. Hitting an Elite or higher tier Combatant creates 3 additional 1 Stasis Crystals.

With a 2 Stasis Super Ability equipped, spawn a 3 Diamond Lance next to you by performing one of three actions:
• Stand behind a Rally Barricade and score a Kill or 3 Precision Hits within ? seconds of each
OR
• Reach 100% progress by landing hits with 4 Stasis Weapons. Bodyshots grant 5% progress, and precision damage grants 12% progress
OR
• Score two 5 Stasis Weapon kills

6 Diamond Lance damage is increased by 144%|253%|333%|389%|428%|455%|475% at 1|2|3... stacks of 7 Frost Armor.

Slamming the 8 Diamond Lance gives 9 Frost Armor first, therefore always benefitting from the damage buff.

This exotic shares the cooldown of the 10 Diamond Lance Aspect, but using the Aspect is not required.

entries.title: Under Pressure
entries.description:
Grants linearly scaling benefits as the Magazine drops from 50% of its base capacity to empty:
• 12.5% to 25% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 0 to 30? Stability

entries.title: Duelist's Trance
entries.description:
Sword Kills grant 🡅65 Guard Resistance, Guard Endurance, and (Guard) Charge Rate.

Buff is removed on stow.

🡅 Grants 5 points of each Stat.

entries.title: Long March
entries.description: While held and loaded with at least 1 round, your outer Radar detection range is increased to 80 meters.

entries.title: Charge Shot
entries.description:
Fires a single tracking projectile that detonates on impact and creates a burning pool of fire.

Projectile deals 1184 [PVP: ?] impact damage and 269 [PVP: ?] explosive damage over 7 meters. This is reduced to 0% damage at the edge of the radius.

Lingering pool deals 46 [PVP: 8] damage every 0.25 seconds for 1.75 seconds.

entries.title: Ahamkara's Eye
entries.description:
0 Scorch granted by me and 1 Ignitions that started from me deal 31.6% increased damage.

▛ I see you, O Seeker of Knowledge Mine. Reading this somewhere [Real]. My Eye is a Chorus of coalesced Will and Desire...were my [Voices] not enough to [satiate] your ravenous tastes? ▟

entries.title: Transmutation
entries.description:
Intrinsically deals 40% more PvE damage than Legendary Trace Rifles.

Kills with this weapon's beam turn the target into a Transmutation Sphere.

Transmutation Spheres are considered a generic 'Void Weapon'. They benefit from Empowering and Void-Verb Buffs, but are unaffected by nor trigger Ability, Trace Rifle, or Weapon Surge effects.

entries.title: The Roadborn
entries.description:
Precision Kills or two Precision Hits grants 'Roadborn' for 10 seconds. Additional Precision Hits add 3 seconds.

While 'Roadborn' is active, gain the following benefits:
• 22% increased Precision Damage
• 42% faster Rate of Fire
• 10% increased Damage Falloff distance (stacks with Intrinsic benefit, granting a total increase of 15%)
• 20 Stability
• 40 Reload Speed
• 25% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• 44% decreased Handling Animation Duration

entries.title: Genesis
entries.description:
Energy Weapons are refunded 1 Ammo upon hitting matching PVE Combatant Elemental Shields.

Refills magazine from reserves upon breaking a PVE Combatant, Barrier Champion, or Player Shield.

🡅 Passively grants 5 Handling.

entries.title: Sunfire Furnace
entries.description:
While a 0 Solar Super is equipped and fully charged, any Ability Kill (even Unpowered Melees) grants 1 Cure x2 and one stack of 'Sunfire Furnace' for 20 seconds. Glaive melees do not count. Maximum of 10 stacks.

While Sunfire Furnace is active, kills with your 2 Shieldburst Barricade or ANY Grenade trigger an 3 Ignition (yes, even Forerunner's "The Rock").

Sunfire Furnace also grants Increased Super Damage and Additional Base Grenade and Class Ability Regneration rate at 1|2|3... stacks.
• 6.5%|13.6%|22%|32%|43%|57%|73%|93%|118%|150%| Increased Super Damage
• ?|?|?|?|?|?|?|?|?|250% Base Grenade and Class Ability Regeneration

Casting your Super freezes the amount of stacks you have. Refund 8%|20%|26%|33%|45% Super Energy upon exiting at 1|2|3|4|5+ stacks of Sunfire Furnace.

entries.title: Survival Well
entries.description:
Class Ability usage heals you and allies within 12 meters as long as they have line of sight to you.

Casting a Barricade restores 70 Health and 110 Shield HP. Using 0 Thruster restores 60 Health.

Scoring multiple Direct Hits within 3 seconds of each while behind a Barricade triggers an additional healing pulse that restores 30 HP in a 12 meter radius.

Activation progress granted by weapon type:
• Submachine Guns, Trace Rifles: 7.14%
• Auto Rifles, Machine Guns: 8.33%
• Pulse Rifles: 9.1%
• Sidearms: 12.5%
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 16.7%
• Swords: 20%
• Bows, Glaives, Grenade Launchers, Shotguns, Sniper Rifles: 34%

Additional hits provide no activation progress for 2 seconds after a Healing Pulse is triggered. 5 second cooldown between healing pulse activations. (why are these separate)

Super Abilities generate an extra Orb of Power that grants 7.14% Super Energy (regular Super Orb).

Specific Interactions:
• Roaming Supers generate an Orb with the first Kill instead of needing at least 2 Kills
• 1 Ward of Dawn generates 4 Orbs with each granting 3.57% Super Energy (up from 3 Orbs granting 2.3% each for a ~2x increase)

entries.title: Auto-Loading Link
entries.description:
Passively grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Auto Rifles and Machine Guns.

Refills 10% of readied Auto Rifles' and Machine Guns' magazines (rounded up) every 1.5 seconds.

Scoring Auto Rifle or Machine Gun kills grants stacks of Auto-Loading Link. Maximum of 10 stacks. Stacks expire one at a time.

Auto-Loading Link grants 1.5% increased damage, ? Stability, and 5 Ammo Generation per stack.

The 1st stack lasts 7 seconds, with each subsequent stack having a 0.5 second shorter duration. The 10th stack lasts 2.5 seconds.

entries.title: Void Ammo Generation
entries.description:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to 0 Void Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).

entries.title: Roar of Battle
entries.description:
Exchanging damage at most every 0.65 seconds for at least 2 seconds grants 'Roar of Battle' for 6 seconds.

'Roar of Battle' grants 10? Stability and 10? Handling.

entries.title: Harmonic Dexterity
entries.description:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to Weapons matching your Super Element with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.title: Worm Byproduct
entries.description:
Taking self-damage from the explosion grants 'Worm Byproduct', increasing other weapon's damage by 15%.

This damage buff stacks with all other Empowering buffs.

entries.title: Disruption Break
entries.description:
On Elemental, Barrier or Guardian Shield Break:
Applies Kinetic Damage Vulnerability to the enemy, increasing Kinetic damage taken by 50% for 5.5 [PVP: 5] seconds.

Stacks with all other Buffs and Debuffs (including itself).

entries.title: Prometheus Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 20 Stability and 20 Handling.

Grants the Incandescent trait:
Weapon Kills trigger a 0 Solar explosion that applies 30 1 Scorch Stacks (40 with 2 Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.

Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more 3 Scorch Stacks.

4 Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.

entries.title: En Garde
entries.description:
Readying the Sword grants 30% increased damage for 1.5 seconds.

2? second cooldown after the buff expires.

entries.title: Death at First Glance
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights, deal 32.5% increased damage for as long as you land Precision Hits or damage a Combatant Shield.

Buff reactivates after 3 seconds of not firing.

entries.title: Liquid Coils
entries.description: Increases charge time by 40ms and damage by 2%.

entries.title: EM Anomaly
entries.description:
Precision Kills with this gun trigger a 0 Void Implosion that pulls enemies within a 9 [PVP: ?] meter radius and explodes for 341 [PVP: ?] damage.

For some 'large weight' enemies, they are pushed back instead.

entries.title: Illegally Modded Holster
entries.description:
Passively grants the following benefits while a Hand Cannon is readied:
• 20 Airborne Effectiveness
• 6.25% increased Sprint Speed
• 33% increased Slide Distance

Readying a Hand Cannon grants 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 6 seconds (for the PVE-only benefits of the perk, consider this the 0th Stack).

'Illegally Modded Holster' grants the following benefits to Hand Cannons:
• 100 Ready Speed Handling
• 0.6x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier
• 30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• PVE ONLY: Direct Hits grant a Stack of 'Illegally Modded Holster'. Maximum of 10 Stacks.

'Illegally Modded Holster' grants 45% increased Direct Impact damage per Stack, maxing out at 450%. Boss-Tier Enemies take 33% decreased damage from Lucky Pants shots.

• Uncivil Discourse only recieves 30% increased damage per stack.
• Sturm's Overcharged Rounds only receive 11% increased damage per Stack (110%).
• Hawkmoon's Paracausal Shot receives 5% increased damage per stack upon being fired (50%).
• Malfeasance's Explosive Shadow is unaffected by the buff.

While at 'Illegally Modded Holster x7' or higher:
Swapping to a non-Hand Cannon weapon or the buff expiring grants you the 'Out of Luck' debuff. 'Out of Luck' prevents you from reacquiring 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 10 seconds.

entries.title: Uncanny Arrows
entries.description:
Deadfall returns Ability Energy per Enemy Tethered:
• X% Super Energy up to the maximum of 50%

Moebius Quiver can fire an additional volley per Super Activation and lasts 4 additional seconds (16🠚20 Seconds)

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website. (Super Energy is unaffected)

entries.title: Hydraulic Boosters
entries.description:
Passively grants 30% Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants while Airborne.

Increases Sprint Speed by 6.25% and Slide Distance by 33%. Greatly increases the initial momentum of all Jump Abilities.

entries.title: Big-Game Hunter
entries.description: Bolts fire with significantly increased Stagger Force.

entries.title: Harmonic Loader
entries.description:
Grants the following to Weapons matching your Super Element ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Classy Contender
entries.description:
Kills grant 5% Class Ability Energy.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Heavy Handed
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power on Elemental Melee Kills that grants 0.8%|1.1%|1.25%|1.5% Super Energy with 1|2|3|4 Mods equipped. (4 Mods is only achievable through Exotic Armor)

10|5|1|1? second cooldown between activations.

Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

entries.title: Adept Targeting
entries.description: Passively grants 7 Aim Assist.

entries.title: Delicate Tomb Catalyst
entries.description: Picking up 0 Ionic Traces refill 4 ammo from reserves.

entries.title: Voltshot
entries.description:
Finishing a reload within 5.3 seconds of a Weapon Kill grants Voltshot for 🡅8 seconds.

While Voltshot is active, your next Weapon Hit consumes the buff and applies 0 Jolt to the target.

Applied 1 Jolt's damage (generally) does not count as Weapon Damage.

🡅 Buff can be held 1 second longer.

entries.title: Edge of Concurrence Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants the following after sprinting for 1.5 seconds with the weapon readied:
• 20 Reload Speed
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
• ? Handling
• 0.95x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier

Sprinting refreshes the buff duration.

Being 0 Amplified removes the sprinting requirement and increases the Reload Speed stat bonus to 60.

entries.title: Clenched Fist
entries.description:
Passively grants 100 Guard Resistance and Guard Endurance to Swords.

While Guarding:
• Grants 50% [PVP: 10%] Damage Resistance (Stacks multiplicatively with the Damage Resistance provided by Sword Guard against blocked attacks)
• Blocking a hit grants 2 Stacks of Perfect Guard. Maximum of 100 Stacks. (Cannot gain stacks while you have the 0 Restoration buff)
• 1 Heavy Ammo Sword Energy does not decay from holding guard

All Stacks are removed if no hits have been blocked in the last 10 seconds.

Dealing Sword Damage with active Perfect Guard Stacks grants 2 Restoration x2:
4 [PVP: 3] second duration at 1 Stack, scaling up to 16 [PVP: 6] seconds at 100 Stacks. (3 Ember of Solace increases this by 50%, up to 24 [PVP: 9] seconds)

entries.title: SUROS Regime Catalyst
entries.description: Grants 50 Recoil Direction and doubles the healing chance (25%🠚50%).

entries.title: Tilting at Windmills
entries.description:
Blocking damage with this weapon increases movement speed while Blocking by 25?% for 🡅5 seconds.

Buff is removed when you stop blocking or if Glaive/Sword Energy runs out.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 1? second.

entries.title: Zen Moment
entries.description:
Weapon Hits grant 1 Stack of the perk for 1 second up to the maximum of 5? Stacks.

Benefits granted per Stack:
• Grants ?% Flinch Resistance
• Reduces Visual Weapon Shake by 15%
• Reduces Reticle Bounce by 15%

Stacks gained per Weapon Hit by weapon type:
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 2?
• Pulse Rifles, Sidearms: 1.5
• Other Weapons: 1

🡅 Passively grants 5 Stability.

entries.title: Relentless Strikes
entries.description:
Scoring 3 Powered Hits within 2? seconds of each refunds 1 ammo.

Wolfpack Round Hits do not count.

entries.title: Innervation
entries.description:
Grants 10%|13%|15% Grenade Ability Energy on Orb of Power Pickups with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Golden Munitions
entries.description:
Generates 3 Ammo upon casting Cayde's Retribution. Wearing Celestial Nighthawk generates 1 ammo.

Ammo is added into reserves if the magazine is full.

entries.title: Time Dilation
entries.description:
Extends Armor Charge decay time to 15|18|20 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Armor Charge decays at the rate of 1 Stack every 10 seconds by default with Passive Mods equipped.

entries.title: Rat King Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 20 Aim Assist and 20 Recoil Direction.

Finishing a reload within 6 seconds of a kill begins Health Regeneration.

entries.title: Melee Damage Resistance
entries.description:
Reduces Incoming Damage from PVE Combatants less than 4 meters away by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.title: Enlightened Action
entries.description:
Weapon Hits grant Stacks of Enlightened Action for 2 seconds. Maximum of 12 Stacks.

Stat bonuses at 1|2|…|12 Stacks:
2|7|12|15|20|25|30|35|38|40|45|50 Handling and Reload Speed

Stacks granted per hit by Weapon Type:
• Hand Cannons: 3 Stacks
• Bows: ? Stacks
• Automatic Weapons: 1 Stack

🡅 Maximum Stat Bonus is increased by 5. (50🠚55, breakdown by Stacks currently unknown)

entries.title: Close to Melee
entries.description:
Glaive Projectile Kills grant 60% [PVP: 30%] increased Glaive Melee damage for 10 seconds.

Dealing Projectile or Melee damage extends the buff duration by 5 seconds, up to 10 seconds.

entries.title: Crimson Catalyst
entries.description:
Passively grants 20 Range.

Every 30 points of damage taken with the weapon readied grants a Stack of 'To the Pain'. Maximum of 10 Stacks. Stowing the weapon removes all Stacks.

Each Stack grants ? Handling and 2 Aim Assist, maxing out at ? Handling and 20 Aim Assist.

Self-damage and environmental damage do not count.

entries.title: Explosive Shadow
entries.description:
Intrinsically 0 Anti-Unstoppable, but only Slug explosions stun 1 Unstoppable champions.

Hits embed Explosive Slugs into the target. Target death or embedding a fifth slug causes all slugs to explode, each dealing 203 [PVP: 45] damage in a 1? meter radius.

entries.title: Judgment
entries.description:
Deals 50% less damage than Legendary Trace Rifles.

Dealing 10 [PVP: 5] hits within 0.15 seconds of each creates a 'Vex Cage' around the target for 1.25 seconds. At maximum rate of fire, this cage forms in 0.67 seconds.

Maintaining the cage does not require continuous fire.

Targets within a Vex Cage receive 15% increased damage from all sources (30% for Divinity). For sources that can deal precision damage, any damage dealt to a Vex Cage is treated as a Precision Hit.

entries.title: Chaos Reshaped
entries.description:
Being in Combat for 🡅11.5 seconds grants a Stack of 'Chaos Reshaped' for 7 seconds. Maintaining the first Stack for 🡅11.5 seconds grants a second Stack. Buff can be activated while stowed.

For Chaos Reshaped, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last 5 seconds.

Benefits at Chaos Reshaped x1 and x2:
• x1: grants 20% increased damage
• x2: grants 35% increased damage and grants a periodic burst of healing

🡅 Each Stack is gained 0.5 seconds sooner.

Healing effect is bugged!
While Chaos Reshaped x2 is active:
Stowing the weapon or keeping it readied for 7 seconds grants a continous healing effect of 5 HP per second.

Stowing this weapon grants the effect for 1 to 7 seconds (cycling, it's complicated), while keeping it readied after activation makes the healing effectively constant.

While this healing effect is active, NO OTHER SOURCE OF HEALING CAN RESTORE THE FINAL [~35 to 5] HP OF YOUR HEALTH BAR!

This unrecoverable HP segment can only be healed by Chaos Reshaped's 5/HPs effect.

For more details, visit the perk description in the Destiny Data Compendium.

entries.title: Dichotomous Thinking
entries.description:
Deals 30% more damage than other High Impact Machine Guns.

Scoring hits with the gun grants 10% Healing Charge. (Unlike Support-Frame Auto Rifles, this is the only way to gain charge.)

Hip-fire to shoot Healing Rounds at 600 RPM that seek allies within the reticle. Healing Rounds restore 30 HP per hit and do not consume ammo, instead costing 2% Healing Charge each. Firing a healing round refills 2 rounds into the magazine from reserves.

Landing 6 healing rounds within 1 second of each spawns a 0 Threadling at the ally's location, and grants both you and them 'Support Frame Boost'. Support Frame Boost increases weapon damage by 10% for 6 seconds and stacks with everything.

Healing a Teeming Nest also grants you the Support Frame Boost.

entries.title: Subsistence
entries.description:
Weapon Kills refill 10% of the magazine (rounded up) from reserves.

Submachine Gun and Auto Rifle Kills refill 17% of the magazine.

entries.title: Slickdraw
entries.description:
Passively grants:
• 100 Handling
• 0.95x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier
• 20% decreased Auto Aim Cone Size (No effect on Magnetism AKA Reticle Stickiness)

entries.title: Noble Deeds
entries.description:
Assisting Allies by Reviving, Healing, Empowering, or granting Subclass Buffs to them grants 10 Stacks of Noble Deeds. Maximum of 10 Stacks.

Can be triggered even while the weapon is stowed.

Kills consume 1 [PVP: 2] Stacks of Noble Deeds.

Grants 30 Handling and 30 Reload Speed while you have active Stacks. Swords receive 20 Charge Rate instead.

entries.title: Sturm Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 40 Handling and 20 Range.

Kills with Overcharged Rounds grants 2 stacks of 'Helping Hands'. Maximum of 6 stacks.

Helping Hands grants 50% decreased Stow/Ready Animation Speed while active. Readying Sturm or a Together Forevever weapon consumes one stack.

entries.title: Sunshot Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 30 Range and 20 Stability.

Applying an Elemental Debuff grants the following benefits for 9 seconds:
• 50 Reload Speed and 20 Aim Assist
• 20% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty

Buff can be activated while stowed.

entries.title: Ex Diris Catalyst
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 0 Amplified for 15 seconds.

While 1 Amplified, Direct Hits charge Enrage twice as fast (25%🠚50% per hit).

entries.title: Assault Barricade
entries.description:
Replaces Towering Barricade with an Assault Barricade that allows the caster and their allies to shoot through it.

Assault Barricades take 60% increased damage from Enemy Players, effectively decreasing its HP from 500 to 312.5 in PvP.

entries.title: Inverse Relationship
entries.description:
Hits grant ? Handling, ?% Flinch Resistance, and ?% increased Movement Speed for 3 seconds. This effect stacks up to 6 times, and additional hits refresh the duration.

Gain increased damage as your Shield is depleted past 114|60|0 remaining HP.
• PvE: 10%|20%|40%
• PvP: 2%|4%|6%

entries.title: Arc Weapon Surge
entries.description:
Increases 0 Arc Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage

The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.

Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.title: Parting Gift
entries.description:
Class Ability usage drops a Parting Gift that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing 440 [PVP: 121] damage over a 7.5 meter radius.

Parting Gift applies an additional effect based on the element of your equipped Super Ability:
• 0 Arc: 1 Blind for 10 [PVP: 3] seconds
• 2 Solar: 40 3 Scorch (60 with 4 Ember of Ashes)
• 5 Stasis: 40 [PVP: 20] 6 Slow Stacks for 4 [PVP: 1.5] seconds (8 [PVP: 2] seconds with Whisper of Durance)
• 7 Void: 8 Suppression for 10 seconds [PVP: Does not apply to Guardians in their Super]
• 9 Strand: 10 Sever for 10 [PVP: 5] seconds (15 [PVP: 7] with 11 Thread of Continuity)

Detonates instantly on contact with a surface or an enemy (for instant detonations, try the 4pc Dark Age Set Bonus from Warlord's Ruin).

entries.title: Marksman Optics: High
entries.description:
Passively increases Zoom by 2.

Increasing Zoom has the following effects in ADS:
• Increased Magnification
• Increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• Decreased Absolute Recoil
• Narrowed Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones (size stays the same on-screen)

entries.title: Accelerated Assault
entries.description:
For single-shot weapons:
Scoring 3 hits with at least 1.2 seconds or at most 4 seconds between each other grants ? Reload Speed and 🡅6% [PVP: ?] increased damage for 8 seconds.

Additional hits while the buff duration is below 4 seconds refresh the timer to 4 seconds.

For multi-shot weapons:
Scoring 3 hits with at least 0.8 seconds or at most 1.2 seconds between each other refills 10% of the magazine and grants 🡅6% [PVP: ?] increased damage for 4 seconds.

🡅 Damage bonus is increased by 20% (5%🠚6%).

entries.title: Invigoration
entries.description:
Grants 10%|13%|15% Melee Ability Energy on Orb of Power Pickups with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Business Time
entries.description:
Holding down the trigger progressively grants up to 60% increased Rate of Fire and ? Range after 1.38 seconds.

As long as the trigger continues to be held, an explosive projectile is added every 18 shots, dealing 56 [PVP: 21] damage with no damage falloff.

Achieving maximum fire rate increases the frequency of these projectiles to once every 8 shots.

entries.title: Blastwave Striders
entries.description:
Passively grants 75% Damage Resistance against explosive self-damage.

The following actions charge up Blastwave Striders:
• Minor PVE Combatant Kills: 10%
• Elite or higher tier PVE Combatant Kills: 25%
• Enemy Guardians: 20%
• Collecting Alethonym's Vestiges: 10%

While at 100% charge, deal damage with 0 Shiver Strike, 1 Howl of The Storm, or explosive self-damage to propel yourself backwards in an explosive jump, releasing 8 2 Stasis Shrapnel Projectiles and granting 5 3 Frost Armor Stacks. Each Projectile deals 623 [PVP: ?] damage and spawns a 4 Stasis Crystal on impact.

This explosive jump also releases an expanding ? meter radius 5 Stasis Wave that 6 Freezes enemies on contact [PVP: Slows for ? seconds].

Shrapnel Kills do not charge Blastwave Striders.

entries.title: Mark of the Devourer
entries.description:
This is a Weapon of Sorrow.

Shots fired overpenetrate unlimited targets.

Direct hits with this weapon apply Corruption (DoT Poison), dealing 30 [PVP: 0.4] damage every 0.5 seconds for 2 seconds. Multiple instances of Corruption can be stacked on the same target.

Kills create a Remnant which tracks towards you when within a 15 meter radius. Remnants last for 8 seconds in the world before despawning.

entries.title: Hard Light Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 25 Stability.

While 0 Amplified, 1 Radiant, or 2 Devour is active:
• ? Handling
• ? Reload Speed
• ?% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• ?% decreased ADS Animation Duration

entries.title: Hip-Fire Grip
entries.description:
Grants the following benefits while hipfiring:
• 25 Stability and 15 Aim Assist
• 2.7° larger Precision Aim Cone Angle
• 30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 20% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• 20% increased Damage Falloff Distance

The Damage Falloff increase does not apply to The Last Word, Shotguns, Sniper Rifles, and Fusion Rifles.

PvP-specific note: the Precision Aim Cone Angle increase essentially just allows you to hit Crits while aimed above or slightly to the side of the head. (This is already the default behavior of Submachine Guns, Sidearms, Bows, Machine Guns, and Linear Fusion Rifles so it does not affect them)

entries.title: Bleak Domain
entries.description:
Enhances 0 Bleak Watcher:
• Targeting Range is increased to 50 meters
• Creates 4 outward-tilted Medium 1 Stasis Crystals around where it spawns (these respawn after 15 seconds)
• Releases a 2 Stasis Storm in a 3 meter radius

Standing in the 3 Stasis Storm grants a Stack of 'Icicle' every second. Maximum of 5 Stacks.

Shooting consumes a Stack of Icicle, releasing a 4 Stasis Projectile that deals 50 [PVP: ?] damage and applies 50 [PVP: 20] 5 Slow Stacks for ? seconds.

Icicle can fire every 0.2 seconds. Icicle Stacks expire if you leave the 6 Stasis Storm for more than 2 seconds.

entries.title: Collective Purpose
entries.description:
Grants a stack of 'Collective Purpose' for each ally within 15 meters. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Collective Purpose grants the following benefits while at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 5?|10?|15?|20?|25? Range
• 5?|10?|15?|20?|25? Handling
• 0.975x?|0.95x?|0.925x?|0.9x?|0.875x? Draw Time Multiplier
• 5|10|15|20?|25? Charge Time Stat (For reference, 10 Charge Time stat is the benefit of a Charge Time Masterwork)

entries.title: Arbalest Catalyst
entries.description:
Passively grants:
• 20 Handling
• Increases Magazine Size by one (5🠚6)

Refills magazine from reserves upon breaking a PVE Combatant, Barrier Champion, or Player Shield.

entries.title: Tension
entries.description: Passively grants 6 Draw Time Stat and 6 Accuracy.

entries.title: Adept Draw Time
entries.description: Passively decreases Draw Time by 40.

entries.title: Collective Pugilism
entries.description:
Collecting an Elemental Pickup enables Weapon Damage to generate Melee Ability energy per hit for 8 seconds.

0 Ionic Traces, 1 Stasis Shards, and Shot 2 Tangles extend the timer by 4 seconds. 3 Firesprites, 4 Void Breaches, and Thrown 5 Tangles extend the timer by 8 seconds.

Timer can be extended to a maximum of 16 seconds.

Melee energy granted by weapon type:
Spreadshot HC: 0.5%
Burst Sidearm: 0.78%
Fusion Rifle: 1.15%
Rocket Pulse: 1.95%
Sidearm: 2.34%
Scout: 3.34%
Rocket Launcher: 12.9%

Elemental Pickups include 6 Firesprites, 7 Ionic Traces, 8 Stasis Shards, 9 Tangles, and 10 Void Breaches.

entries.title: Suspending Blast
entries.description:
Manually detonating at least 6 rounds that are embedded into a target 0 Suspends them for 6 seconds (8 with 1 Thread of Continuity).

Suspend duration is halved against Minibosses.

entries.title: Edge of Action
entries.description:
Glaive Melee Hits grant one stack of 'Charged Edge'. Projectile Hits grant two stacks. At 6 stacks, hold [Reload] to generate 1 ammo from thin air and make the next shot fire a small protective 0 Void Dome.

Weapon Kills apply 1 Volatile to enemies in a 7 meter radius around the target and grant 2 Volatile Rounds for 3 seconds.

1.5 second cooldown between activations.

Only applies to Glaive Projectiles.

entries.title: Weapons Font
entries.description:
Grants 20|40|50 Weapons stat with 1|2|3 Mods equipped while you have active Armor Charges.

Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.title: All at Once
entries.description:
Shots dissipate after 50 meters.

Holding down the trigger for 0.5 seconds begins loading a burst of 10 shots and marks enemies within 24 meters of you. Shots load over the course of 0.9 seconds.

Grants 30 Stability during the burst. Fully charged bursts apply 0 Unravel to marked targets.

entries.title: To Excess
entries.description: Weapon kills while your Super Ability is charged grant 20 Grenade stat and 20 Melee stat for 12 seconds.

entries.title: Full Court
entries.description:
Starts linearly increasing Detonation and Burn (DoT) damage 0.2 seconds after the grenade projectile is fired.

Reaches maximum strength after 1.1 seconds at a 35% damage increase.

The damage increase is finalized at the point of detonation and any lingering effects left will not increase it further.

🡅 Passively grants 5 Blast Radius.

entries.title: Exhaustive Research
entries.description:
Aiming Down Sights at an enemy within 60 meters loads up a Micro-Rocket over 0.6 seconds.

Micro-Rocket replaces a regular bullet, firing a tracking missile that matched the weapon's element and deals up to ? Explosive Damage in a ? meter radius.

5.5 second cooldown before a new rocket can be loaded.

entries.title: Demolitionist
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 🡅11% Grenade Ability Energy.

Kills with Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaives, and Fusion Rifles grant 🡅22%.

Using your Grenade Ability refills the Magazine with a 3 second cooldown.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

🡅 Grenade Ability Energy gains are increased by 10%. (e.g. 10%⁠🠚⁠11%)

entries.title: Thermal Atomization
entries.description:
While above 50% Heat:
• Grants 8.25% [PVP: 3.5] to 14% [PVP: ?] increased weapon damage as Heat increases from 50% to 100%
• Enemies explode on direct damage kills, dealing up ? damage matching the weapon's element in a 7.5 meter radius.

Detonation damage by weapon type:
• Hand Cannons: 74 (lol) [PVP: 77?]
• Submachine Guns: 289 [PVP: ?]
• Sniper Rifles: 552 [PVP: ?]

Detonation damage falls off to 0% damage at the edge of the radius.

Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

entries.title: Built to Blast
entries.description:
Grants the following benefits while 0 Void Overshield, 1 Frost Armor, or 2 Woven Mail is active:
• 30 Stability
• ? Aim Assist
• ?% Flinch Resistance

entries.title: Overflowing Light
entries.description:
Grenade or Class Ability usage and dealing Elemental Melee damage grants the 'Empowered Abilities' buff to the other two abilities for 5 seconds (e.g.: Barricade usage 🠚 Empowered Grenade and Melee Abilities). Casting your super removes all stacks.

Buff display on the HUD is nonsensical and does not accurately represent the buff's behavior when chaining multiple abilities together.

Empowered Melee x1|x2 benefits:
• 10% | 50% increased Melee damage
• 400% [PVP: 100%] | 800% [PVP: 200%] Additional Base Melee Regeneration Rate

Empowered Grenade x1|x2 benefits:
• 20% [PVP: 10%] | 35% [PVP: 20%] increased Grenade damage
• 400% [PVP: 100%] | 800% [PVP: 200%] Additional Base Grenade Regeneration Rate

Empowered Class Ability x1|x2 benefits:
• 25%|50% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate
• Does not grant any measurable benefit to Barricade HP despite stating it does

entries.title: Grenade Kickstart
entries.description:
When a Grenade Ability Charge is fully consumed and you have active Armor Charges:
Consumes active Armor Charges and grants Grenade Ability Energy.

Each Mod and Stack of Armor Charge counts as one 'charge' for Grenade Energy refunds.

Grenade Energy gains with 2|3|etc. 'charges':
[PVE] 16.2% | 21.7% | 28.4% | 34.4% | 38.4% | 41.3% | 43.4% | 45%
[PVP] 12.5% | 14.2% | 16.2% | 18.7% | 21.7% | 25% | 28.4% | 31.6%

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Destabilizing Rounds
entries.description:
Weapon Kills apply 0 Volatile to enemies in a 7 meter radius around the target and grant 1 Volatile Rounds for 🡅4.5 seconds.

1.5 second cooldown between activations.

🡅 2 Volatile Rounds duration is increased by 1.5 seconds.

entries.title: Unplanned Reprieve
entries.description:
Fires seven bolts that deal impact damage and then explode after 5 seconds or when within 3 meters of an enemy.

Due to repeated bugs and exploits, these bolts are immune to all forms of premature destruction.

Upon detonation, each bolt deals 236 [PVP: 47] damage in a 4 meter radius, down to a minimum of 12.5% damage at the edge of the radius.

entries.title: Necrochasm Catalyst
entries.description:
Damaging 3 enemies within 3 seconds of each other grants the following benefits for 10 seconds:
• 35% increased damage
• ? Handling
• ? Range
• ? Aim Assist

Buff can be refreshed.

entries.title: Subsistence Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Subsistence trait:
Weapon Kills refill 10% of the magazine (rounded up) from reserves.

Submachine Gun and Auto Rifle Kills refill 17% of the magazine.

entries.title: Destabilizing Rounds Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Destablizing Rounds trait:
Weapon Kills apply 0 Volatile to enemies in a 7 meter radius around the target and grant 1 Volatile Rounds for 3 seconds.

1.5 second cooldown between activations.

entries.title: Onslaught Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Onslaught trait:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of 'Onslaught' for 4.5 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

Benefits at 1|2|3 Stacks of Onslaught:
• 16.7% | 28.6% | 37.5% decreased Firing Delay
• 15 | 25 | 35 Reload Speed

entries.title: Close Enough
entries.description:
Collecting 0 Ionic Traces grants 4% 1 Chaos Reach Super Energy.

While at 5 Stacks of 2 Bolt Charge or higher, after having sprinted for at least 1.5 seconds, maintaining sprint grants you a Stack of 3 Bolt Charge every 0.33 seconds.

4 Chaos Reach refunds 10% Super Energy on hit.
0.75 second cooldown between refunds. This can increase 5 Chaos Reach duration by up to ~120%.

entries.title: Rimestealer
entries.description: Killing 0 Frozen Enemies or 1 Shattering a 2 Stasis Crystal with the weapon grants a Stack of 3 Frost Armor.

entries.title: Balanced Grip
entries.description:
Scoring 3 Melee Attack kills within 5 seconds of each grants 1 ammo.

Passively grants:
• 2 Impact (~1.2% increased damage)
• 10 Charge Rate
• 40 Guard Resistance
• 40 Guard Endurance

entries.title: Wolfpack Rounds
entries.description:
Light attacks spawn 1 Wolfpack Round.

Grounded Powered Heavy Attacks grant 'Pack Hunter' to you and allies in a ? meter radius for 10 seconds.

Pack Hunter buffs all Ergo Sum and Non-Exotic Swords. Pack Hunter causes sword swings to release 3 tracking submunitions that deal 90 [PVP: 33] damage each.

Wolfpack Rounds count as sword hits, and can benefit from both sword perks and Empowering buffs.

entries.title: Panic Response IV
entries.description:
Magazine is refilled every 0.2 seconds based on currently remaining ammo while not firing the weapon.

Refill amount by currently remaining ammo:
• 1-2 Ammo: 4 shots
• 3-8 Ammo: 3 shots
• 9-16 Ammo: 2 shots
