entries.title: Battle-Hearth
entries.description:
Grants additional Super Energy on Kills (by either you or allies) while inside your 0 Well of Radiance and below 50% Super Energy.

Amount of Super Energy gained is decreased by 1.5% for each successive Kill, down to a minimum of 4% Super Energy per Kill:
10% 🠚 8.5% 🠚 7% 🠚 5.5% 🠚 4% 🠚 4% ...

entries.title: Häkke Heavy Burst Fire
entries.description: Becomes a Heavy-Burst Frame Pulse Rifle.

entries.title: Kinetic Targeting
entries.description:
Grants the following to Kinetic Weapons 1 second after readying them:

• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Shot Swap
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 2 Stacks of Shot Swap. Maximum of 6 Stacks.

Grants 100? Ready/Stow Handling and 🡅35% decreased Ready/Stow Animation duration while you have active stacks.

🡅 Stronger effect.

entries.title: Ruinscribe's Beacon
entries.description:
While a turret is deployed, Ruinscribe Turret Mode is replaced with a laser designator that marks enemies for 30 seconds.

Firing at a target marks them; firing at a surface marks all enemies within a 6 meter radius. Turret prioritizes marked targets, firing three 274 [PVP: ?] damage missiles every 1.65 seconds.

entries.title: Thunderer
entries.description:
Fires at 300 RPM.

Kills refill the magazine based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 1 ammo
• Elites: 0 ammo (???)
• Minibosses and Bosses: Full Magazine

entries.title: Unstoppable Force
entries.description:
Blocking damage with the Glaive Shield grants 20% increased projectile damage for 4 seconds.

Buff is removed if you stop blocking.

entries.title: Guidance Ring
entries.description:
Direct Hits grant one Stack of 'Guidance Ring'. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

Guidance Ring Seeker Hits do not grant Stacks.

entries.title: Kinetic Loader
entries.description:
Grants the following to Kinetic Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Storm and Stress
entries.description:
Kills with Sturm overfill the magazine of Together Forever weapons by 1 round. Maximum of 100% increased Magazine Size.

Kills with Together Forever weapons progressively grant Overcharge Rounds. Maximum of 25 rounds.

Chaining together Forever Weapon kills within 3 seconds of each grants additional stacks per kill. The second kill grants 2 rounds, and further kills in the chain grant 3 rounds.

Sturm's Overcharge Rounds deal increased damage based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors and Elites: 300%
• Minibosses and Champions: 280%
• Bosses: 260%
• Players: 75%

entries.title: Flash Counter
entries.description:
Taking damage while Guarding emits a blast in a wide, 8? meter long wide cone in front of you.

The blast disorients enemies hit by it for 5 seconds and deals weapon-matching elemental damage.

The damage scales up from 75 [PVP: 14] damage at point-blank range to the maximum of 110 [PVP: 45] damage after ? meters.

The strength of the disorientation against Players similarly also scales up with distance.

2.5 second cooldown between activations.

entries.title: Proximity Ward
entries.description: Grants a 200 HP Overshield for the duration of your Finisher Animation.

entries.title: Search Party
entries.description:
Grants the following if no allies are within 15 meters:
• 10% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
• 15% decreased ADS Animation Duration

entries.title: Aerodynamics
entries.description: Passively grants 6 Blast Radius and Velocity.

entries.title: Pyrotoxin Rounds
entries.description:
Fires high-caliber explosive rounds with a splash radius of 3 meters. Damage is split into two portions (18% Impact and 82% Explosive), with the explosion damage having no falloff.

Super Good Advice: Tap-Firing reduces Xenophage's Rate of Fire. Holding down the trigger is recommended.

entries.title: Lumina Catalyst
entries.description: Kills create an additional Remnant (1🠚2).

entries.title: Explosive Light
entries.description:
Orb of Power pickups (even while the weapon is stowed) grant 1 Stack of Explosive Light. Maximum of 🡅7 Stacks.

entries.title: Solar Weapon Surge

entries.title: Clown Cartridge
entries.description:
Reloading randomly overfills the Magazine from reserves by 10% to 50% of the base Magazine Capacity (rounded up).

entries.title: Broadhead
entries.description:
This arrow deals 3 instances of damage.

The arrow itself deals 276 [PVP: 129] damage, which is further increased by dealing Precision Damage. Broadhead deals two [PVP: one] addition hits, each dealing 444 [PVP: 28.75] damage, and is unaffected by Precision Damage.

A single arrow can deal up to 1164 [PVP: 159] damage.

entries.title: Bewildering Burst
entries.description:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a kill grants 'Bewildering Burst' for 6 seconds.

While Bewildering Burst is active, your next Direct Hit spawns a 0 Kinetic explosive above the target that detonates after a 0.85 second delay. The detonation deals 10 [PVP: 4] damage and Disorients enemies within a 10 meter radius for 3.5 [PVP: 1] seconds.

entries.title: Microcosm Catalyst
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant an additional 1% Super Energy.

Grants the following benefits against low (under 30%) Health targets. Ignores Shield HP:

• Increased Stagger Force
• 7% to 15% increased damage, scaling with remaining Health
• ? Increased Target Acquisition

entries.title: Adept Projectile Speed

entries.title: Strand Ammo Generation

entries.title: Mega Kill Clip
entries.description:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Weapon Kill grants 40% increased damage for a duration based on the number of kills achieved before reloading. Maximum of 20 seconds.

entries.title: Kinetic Ammo Generation

entries.title: Supercharged Battery
entries.description:
Collecting an Orb of Power grants 'Supercharged Magazine' for 10 seconds and refills the magazine. Additional orbs grant 10 seconds each, extending the duration up to 20 seconds. Buff can be activated while stowed.

entries.title: Harsh Truths

entries.title: Field Prep

entries.title: High Priority

entries.title: Impetus
entries.description:
Finishing a reload 6 seconds after a kill grants 50% increased damage for 4.5 seconds.

Buff can be refreshed.

entries.title: Kismet

Scoring a Weapon Kill while at Full HP or upon being out of combat for 4.5 [PVP: 15] seconds continuously generates 6.6 [PVP: 1.1] 0 Void Overshield HP per second until you re-enter combat.

entries.title: Solar Rampart
entries.description:
0 Solar Kills grant 15% Class Ability Energy. 1? second cooldown between activations.

entries.title: Vestigial Alchemy

entries.title: Wardcliff Coil Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants some tracking to the rockets I guess?

(Good luck on figuring that one out!)

entries.title: Offhand Strike

entries.title: Composite Propellant
entries.description:
Rockets embed into targets, spewing three Napalm Pools every 0.75 seconds until detonation. Napalm Pools rapidly apply 0 40 Scorch (60 with 1 Ember of Ashes) every ? seconds for 5 seconds.

entries.title: Barri-nade
entries.description:

entries.title: Killing Wind

entries.title: Amalgamation Rounds

Aiming Down Sights charges an 'Amalgamation Round' over the course of 1 second. When charged, fire an extremely dense shot that deals 290% [PVP: 18%] increased damage and marks the target for all allies for 5 seconds.

entries.title: Mad Scientist

entries.title: Prototype Trueseeker

entries.title: Resurgence Directive III

entries.title: Ensemble

entries.title: Firewalker

entries.title: Collective Action
entries.description:
Elemental Pickup Interactions grant 🡅33% [PVP: 🡅11%] increased damage for a variable duration based on the pickup. Can be activated while stowed.

0 Ionic Traces, 1 Stasis Shards, and 2 Tangle Detonations grant the buff for 4 seconds. Throwing a held 3 Tangle grants 4 additional seconds. 4 Firesprites and 5 Void Breaches grant the buff for 8 seconds.

Additional Pickups can extend the duration up to the maximum of 16 seconds.

Elemental Pickup Interactions:
• Destroying a 6 Tangle (or Elemental Orbs), either by shooting or throwing.
• Collecting 7 Firesprites, 8 Ionic Traces, 9 Stasis Shards, or 10 Void Breaches

Does not trigger with 11 Stasis Shards generated from Facet of Awakening or Facet of Command.

🡅 Damage is increased by 10%. (30%⁠🠚⁠33%)

entries.title: Compounding Force
entries.description: Instantly destroys PvE Combatant Elemental and Champion Shields on hit.

entries.title: Head Rush
entries.description:
Upon sliding, or upon standing up after having crouched for 2 seconds:
Grants 30 Handling, 30 Reload Speed, and 15% Increased Damage to Hive Combatants for 5 seconds.

entries.title: Nightsworn Sight
entries.description:
Kills or collecting a 0 Void Breach grants 'Nightsworn Sight' for 7 seconds and Truesight for 3 seconds.

Allies with Slayer's Fang within ? meters of you also receive the Nightsworn Sight when you score a kill with the gun.

Nightsworn Sight grants ? Reload speed and the following benefits:
• 15% increased Precision Damage
• 10% increased damage against Fallen and Scorn
• Automatically load 2 rounds from reserves every 4 seconds
• Submunitions apply 1 Weaken for 4 seconds
• Submunitions deal 18% decreased damage and bounce 1 additional time.

Buff can be activated while stowed.

entries.title: Atomizing Rounds
entries.description:
Fires a 3-round burst of delayed Micro-Missile projectiles that detonate after 6 seconds of being embedded into a target.

Hold [Reload] to instantly detonate all fired rounds.

entries.title: Null Factor
entries.description:
0 Withering Blade hits and bounces grant 7.5% Melee Ability Energy. Additionally, the 1st and 3rd bounces spawn a Small 1 Stasis Crystal.

Shattering a 2 Stasis Crystal or 3 Frozen Enemy with 4 Withering Blade releases a spread of 3 5 Withering Blades.

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Charged Up
entries.description: Increases the Maximum Number of Armor Charge Stacks you can hold from 3 to 4|5|6 with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Rewind Rounds
entries.description:
Upon emptying the Magazine:
Refills 60% of the number of Hits landed (rounded up) into the Magazine from reserves.

Hits are counted from either your last reload or the last time the perk was triggered. Does not require Direct Hits.

Requires firing 28.75% of the Magazine Capacity for the refill to activate.

Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.

Hits after triggering a refill do not count while the Rewind Rounds buff is active (1? second).

Adaptive Burst Linear Fusion Rifle behavior:
• Each individual bolt in the burst counts as a Hit
• Refill amount is uniquely 14% of the number of Hits rounded up (numbers are subject to change once we get more data points)

Nanite Hits count as Hits with the weapon.

entries.title: Headseeker
entries.description:
Dealing non-Precision Direct damage grants the following benefits for 0.55 seconds:
• 20% increased Precision Bonus (complicated, see specific damage increases below)
• 3% increased Aim Assist Cone size

Precision damage increases by weapon type/frame:
• Pulse Rifles: Adaptive: 7.1%, Aggressive Burst: 10%, Heavy Burst: 9.5%, High-Impact: 8.74%, Lightweight: 6.3%, Rapid-Fire: 10.3%
• Sidearms: Adaptive Burst: 8.46%, Heavy Burst: 7.36%
• Scout Rifles: Precision: 8.66%

[Bug] Heavy Burst Hand Cannons: 7% increased Weakspot damage.

The distinction between Weakspots and Critspots is complicated and we might write an explainer blog post about it eventually. For the purposes of PvP, the two are equivalent.

entries.title: Rapid Hit
entries.description:
"Buffed Hits" grant 1 Stack of Rapid Hit for 2 seconds. Maximum of 5 Stacks.

"Buffed Hits" refer to any "Yellow Number" Hits such as Precision Hits or Hits against debuffed targets.

Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 2|12|14|18|25 Stability
• 5|30|35|42|60 Reload Speed
• 0.99x|0.96x|0.95x|0.945x|0.92x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Sharp Harvest
entries.description:
Scoring 3 Powered Sword Hits within 🡅2 seconds of each grants 5% of 0 Special Ammo reserves.

Equipping two 1 Special Weapons halves the amount of ammo granted to 2.5% for each one.

🡅 Time allowed between hits is increased by 0.5? seconds.

entries.title: Traitor's Vessel
entries.description:
Fires a wide 16-bolt volley. Aiming Down Sights tightens the spread, overlapping into 8 bolts (with 2 in each group).

Hip-Fired Bolts deal 20% increased damage.

Kills spawn 0 Ionic Traces based off Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 10%
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 100%
• Players: 100%

entries.title: Timelost Magazine
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant an additional 1?% Super Energy.

Upon your Super ending:
• Refills magazine from reserves
• Grants 100% increased Base Magazine Capacity for 20 seconds
• Causes Found Verdict to reload two shells at a time for 20 seconds

Buff can be activated while stowed.

The increased Base Magazine Capacity will be considered the baseline for other perks such as Overflow.

entries.title: Tireless Blade
entries.description: Your first Powered Sword Kill after (re)spawning refunds 1 Ammo. Afterward, every other Powered Sword Kill also refunds 1 Ammo.

entries.title: Special Ammo Finder
entries.description:
Grants a 1.25x|1.4x|1.5x multiplier to all Special Ammo Meter progress with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

This works in the Crucible as well.

entries.title: Frame of Reference
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant a stack of 'Frame of Reference' for 8 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

'Frame of Reference' timer is paused while stowed. Remaining duration is rounded up to a whole number of seconds.

'Frame of Reference' benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 1.45%|2.8%|4.2%|5.6%|7% increased weapon damage
• ?|?|?|?|? Range
• ?|?|?|?|? Reload Speed

entries.title: Heart Piercer
entries.description:
Slug rounds shatter on impact into 7 semi-tracking submunitions that deal 99 [PVP: 5] damage each. Direct Slug Hits will deal damage with every submunition.

Submunitions are unaffected by damage falloff and ricochet 3 times. They deal 18% reduced damage on the first bounce, then 42.5% reduced damage on subsequent bounces.

Submunitions will attempt to steer towards enemies within 5 meters of their ricochet.

entries.title: Heavy Slug Thrower
entries.description: Can only be fired when Aiming Down Sights and fully spun up. Aiming begins a spin-up time of 1.5 seconds.

entries.title: Golden Tricorn
entries.description:
While the perk's buff isn't active, Weapon Kills grant 'Golden Tricorn x1' for 7 seconds, increasing weapon damage by 15%. Additional Kills refresh the buff duration.

While Golden Tricorn x1 or x2 is active:
Grenade or Elemental Melee Kills matching the element of the Weapon grant Golden Tricorn x2 for 10 seconds, increasing weapon damage by 50%.

Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

entries.title: Absorption Cells
entries.description:
Kills or scoring 5 hits with Weapons matching your Super Element grant Super Energy based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 1.5%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 2%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: ?%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 2.5%
• Players: 2.5?%

While your Super is charged:
Kills with Weapons matching your Super's Element grant 4 Stacks of Subclass-Matching Weapon Surge for 11 [PVP: 6] seconds.

After casting your Super Ability, gain x4 0 Arc, 1 Solar, 2 Void, 3 Stasis, and 4 Strand Weapon Surge for 10 seconds, and 'Harmonic Munitions' for 15 seconds.

Harmonic Munitions causes weapons that are the same element as your super to trigger an element-matching explosion on hit. Explosions deal 180 [PVP: ?] damage in a 6 meter radius and can trigger once per second.

entries.title: The Fundamentals
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to cycle this weapon's element between 0 Arc, 1 Solar, and 2 Void. Selected element persists through stow and death.

Grants 30% [PVP: 10%] increased damage for 10 seconds upon receiving or applying an elemental buff or debuff that matches the currently selected element.

Buff can be activated while stowed.

entries.title: Rolling Storm
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of 0 Bolt Charge.

While 1 Amplified, this is increased to 2 Stacks.

🡅 Weapon Kills with no active 2 Bolt Charge Stacks grant an additional Stack.

entries.title: Hail Barrage
entries.description:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

Kills grant one stack of 'Hail Barrage'. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Hip-firing consumes all stacks to fire 0 Stasis arrows in an evenly spread volley.

entries.title: The Whispers
entries.description:
Grants an extra Melee Ability Charge.

Acts as a copy of the Heavy Handed armor mod.

entries.title: Unrepentant
entries.description:
Finishing a reload within 3.6? seconds of a kill grants 'Unrepentant' for 10 seconds. Buff is removed on stow.

Unrepentant fires an extended 6-round burst that deals 200% [PVP: 0%] increased damage.

entries.title: Marksman Optics: Low
entries.description:
Passively decreases Zoom by 2.

Decreasing Zoom has the following effects in ADS:
• Decreased Magnification
• Decreased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• Increased Absolute Recoil
• Widened Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones (size stays the same on-screen)

entries.title: Fastball
entries.description: Increases velocity of thrown grenade abilities by ~25%.

entries.title: Snareweaver IV
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant one charge of Snareweaver. Kills grant charges based on Combatant Rank. Maximum of 6 charges. Charges can be earned simultaneously.

Charge progress from kills:
• Minors: 1
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 2
• Players: 3

At full charge, hip-fired shots spawn a 'Snareweaver Trap' on impact. Direct Hits 0 Suspend the target and deploy the trap under them.

Snareweaver traps form into 6 linked wires that last for 15 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with any wire take 341 [PVP: 5] damage and are 1 Suspended. Each wire can Suspend up to 2 targets. A maximum of 6 enemies can be Suspended at once within a trap.

5 second cooldown between 2 Suspends on the same enemy.

3 Suspension lasts 6 seconds (8 with 4 Thread of Continuity). Suspend duration is halved against Minibosses.

entries.title: Snareweaver II
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant one charge of Snareweaver. Kills grant charges based on Combatant Rank. Maximum of 6 charges. Charges can be earned simultaneously.

Charge progress from kills:
• Minors: 1
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 2
• Players: 3

At full charge, hip-fired shots spawn a 'Snareweaver Trap' on impact. Direct Hits 0 Suspend the target and deploy the trap under them.

Snareweaver traps form into 6 linked wires that last for 15 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with any wire take 341 [PVP: 5] damage and are 1 Suspended. Each wire can Suspend up to 2 targets. A maximum of 6 enemies can be Suspended at once within a trap.

5 second cooldown between 2 Suspends on the same enemy.

3 Suspension lasts 6 seconds (8 with 4 Thread of Continuity). Suspend duration is halved against Minibosses.

entries.title: Snareweaver III
entries.description:
Precision Hits grant one charge of Snareweaver. Kills grant charges based on Combatant Rank. Maximum of 6 charges. Charges can be earned simultaneously.

Charge progress from kills:
• Minors: 1
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 2
• Players: 3

At full charge, hip-fired shots spawn a 'Snareweaver Trap' on impact. Direct Hits 0 Suspend the target and deploy the trap under them.

Snareweaver traps form into 6 linked wires that last for 15 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with any wire take 341 [PVP: 5] damage and are 1 Suspended. Each wire can Suspend up to 2 targets. A maximum of 6 enemies can be Suspended at once within a trap.

5 second cooldown between 2 Suspends on the same enemy.

3 Suspension lasts 6 seconds (8 with 4 Thread of Continuity). Suspend duration is halved against Minibosses.

entries.title: Swooping Talons
entries.description:
While airborne, hits increase damage by 10% [PVP: 2%] per hit, up to a maximum of 100% [PVP: 20%]. Cooldown of 0.6 seconds between damage increases.

Buff is reset upon touching the ground.

entries.title: Surplus
entries.description:
Grants Stat Bonuses depending on the number of Charged Abilities.

Stat Bonuses with 1|2|3+ Charged Abilities:
• 5|15|25 Stability
• 5|25|60 Handling
• 10|25|60 Reload Speed

🡅 Stronger Effect.

entries.title: Archer's Gambit
entries.description:
Hip-fire Precision Hits grant the following benefits for 🡅5 seconds:
• 60% decreased Draw Time
• 100 Reload Speed
• ? Reload Duration Multiplier

Hip-fire Precision Hits extend the buff duration by 4 seconds up to the maximum of 8 seconds.

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1? second.

entries.title: Relentless Tracker
entries.description:
Dealing ability damage to unhighlighted Elite, Miniboss, Boss, or Player targets highlights them for 10 seconds and grants 4 Stacks of Weapon Surge matching the element of the used ability for 16 [PVP: 11] seconds.

Highlight duration is not refreshable.

Killing highlighted targets with weapons matching the element of the highlighting ability spawns an Elemental Pickup corresponding to the element in question.

Elemental Pickups include 0 Firesprites, 1 Ionic Traces, 2 Stasis Shards, 3 Tangles, and 4 Void Breaches.

entries.title: Hawkeye Hack
entries.description:
Modifies 0 Golden Gun to only fire a single shot that deals 650% increased damage and triggers an immediate 1 Ignition.

The triggered 2 Ignition overrides base 3 Scorch sources and solely benefits from damage increases to the 4 Golden Gun.

(A Celestial Nighthawk Precision Hit is ~85% more damage compared to 3 Precision Hits with Marksman Golden Gun. Also, please only use it with Marksman Golden Gun in PvE)

Scoring a 5 Golden Gun Kill refunds 33% Super Energy and causes the enemy to explode, dealing up to 400 [PVP: ?] damage in a ? meter radius.

Precision Kills grant 1.5-4.5% Super Energy depending on Enemy Rank.

6 Golden Gun no longer receives faster active super generation as a roaming-class super.

entries.title: Upgraded Sensor Pack
entries.description:
Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness and Radar remains active while Aiming Down Sights.

Crouching grants Enhanced Radar (6⁠🠚⁠12 sectors).

Damaging a PVE Combatant or breaking a Player's Shields marks them for 3 seconds. Marks are visible through walls.

If an Enemy is below 30% Health:
Increases all outgoing damage against them by 1% for every percentage point below 30%.
(10% Health left 🠚 20% increased damage)

PVE Combatant and Player Shields do not count as Health.

entries.title: Worldline Catalyst
entries.description: Temporal Sprint is granted 50% faster (1s🠚0.5s).

entries.title: Incandescent
entries.description:
Weapon Kills trigger a 0 Solar explosion that applies 30 1 Scorch Stacks (🡅45 with 2 Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.

Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 🡅15 more 3 Scorch Stacks.

4 Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.

🡅 Having 5 Ember of Ashes equipped or Killing higher-tier targets each increase the amount of 6 Scorch applied by 5 Stacks.

entries.title: Wellspring
entries.description:
On Weapon Kill:
Grants 🡅9% Ability Energy split equally amongst all uncharged abilities.

Abilities with multiple charges only receive one third of the ability energy normally split to them once they have a full ability charge ready.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

🡅 Ability Energy Gain is increased by 12.5%. (8%🠚9%)

entries.title: Overflow
entries.description:
Upon picking up 0 Special or 1 Heavy Ammo:
Refills and Overfills the Magazine from reserves.

Overfill amount maxes out at 🡅120% of the Magazine Capacity. Activates even while stowed.

🡅 Maximum overfill amount is increased by 20% (rounds up).

entries.title: Verglas Curve Catalyst
entries.description: Applying 0 Freeze or 1 Slow to a target decreases Draw Time by 35% (567ms🠚368ms) for ? seconds.

entries.title: The Lost Voice
entries.description:
Replaces 0 Healing Grenades' Restoration Orb with a Healing Turret. Consuming a 1 Healing Grenade will spawn a Healing Turret in front of you.

Passively highlights low-health allies with a soft, flashing, red glow.

Healing Turret information:
• Lasts 9 seconds and has 100? Construct HP
• Releases Healing Seekers every 3 seconds towards the user and allies within 30 meters
• Healing Seekers apply 2 Cure x1 and 3 Restoration x1 for 4 [PVP: 3] seconds in a 7.5 meter radius (strength of both buffs is increased to x2 with 4 Touch of Flame equipped)

Restoring health to damaged allies [PVP: 6 times] spawns an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy at their position.

10 second cooldown between activations.

entries.title: Acrobat's Dodge
entries.description:
Only usable while on the ground.

Performs a front flip in your movement input's direction and slams down the ground with a 0 Solar Knife.

Upon landing after using 1 Acrobat's Dodge:
• Grants you and allies within ? meters 2 Radiant for 10 seconds (15 with 3 Ember of Solace)
• Deals up to 40 [PVP: 20] damage to targets in a ? meter radius

entries.title: Magnificent Howl
entries.description:
Scoring a Precision Kill grants 1 Stack of 'Precision Final Blows' up to the maximum of 10 Stacks.

Reloading converts 'Precision Final Blows' Stacks into 'Magnificent Howl' Stacks. Having active 'Magnificent Howl' Stacks prevents you from gaining 'Precision Final Blows' Stacks.

Each shot consumes 1 Stack of Magnificent Howl, granting 50% increased damage and ?% increased Damage Falloff Distance.

Precision Kills with buffed shots refund a Stack of Magnificent Howl.

entries.title: Arc Siphon
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with an 0 Arc Weapon.

Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Touch of Malice
entries.description:
This is a Weapon of Sorrow.

The last round of this gun's magazine deals 132% [PVP: 30%] increased damage, drains 7 HP, and is always refunded when shot. Health drain is not lethal.

Scoring kills or activating 'Charged With Blight' restores 105 HP and begins Health Regeneration.

Healing Activation from kills is based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 33.4%
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 100%
• Players: 66.7%

entries.title: High Octane
entries.description:
0 Ignitions that occur within a 70 meter radius of you grant 2 stacks of Composite Propellant.

Reaching 5 stacks of Composite Propellant refills the magazine from reserves.

entries.title: Warlord's Sigil
entries.description:
Melee/Glaive Melee Kills grant a stack of 'Warlord's Sigil'. Maximum of 10 stacks. Finishers grant 3 stacks (as soon as their animation starts).

Warlord's Sigil stacks decay one at a time every 4.75 seconds.

Warlord's Sigil grants the following Melee Damage increases at 1|2|3|...|10 stacks:
67.5% | 122% | 166% | 202% | 228% | 249% | 265% | 278% | 289% | 300% Additional Base Melee Damage.

Reaching or refreshing the duration of the 10th stack grants 1 Melee Ability Charge and 'Warlord's Fury Ready' for 8 seconds. The 10th stack's duration cannot be refreshed by Finishers.

Using any Melee while Warlord's Fury Ready is active will grant 'Warlord's Fury' for 10 seconds, granting the following benefits:
• 400% Additional Base Melee Damage
• 0.8x Melee animation duration
• 38.4x Melee ability regeneration speed

Warlord's Sigil's stack count is reset to 0 once Warlord's Fury ends. While Warlord's Fury is active, gaining stacks of Warlord's Sigil is not possible.

Not triggering Warlord's Fury will return the buff to Warlord's Sigil x10.

entries.title: Vampire's Caress
entries.description:
Melee Kills grant 0 Cure x3 and 1 Restoration x1.

Finishers grant 2 Cure x3 and 3 Restoration x2.

4 Restoration lasts 8 seconds (12 with 5 Ember of Solace) in both cases.

entries.title: Helium Spirals
entries.description:
Only works with the 0 Solar Element Grenades named 1 Solar Grenade equipped.

2 Solar Grenades have Fastball intrinsically and last 2 seconds longer (4🠚6s normally, 6🠚8s with 3 Touch of Flame equipped).

Powered Melee Kills grant 5 seconds of Sunbracers Ready. Using your Grenade Ability while Sunbracers Ready is active grants the Sunbracers buff.

'Sunbracers' grants 20,000% Additional Base 'Solar Grenade' Regeneration Rate for 4 seconds. (Effectively recharges ~132% of a 'Solar Grenade' charge per second)

entries.title: Devil's Ruin Catalyst
entries.description:
Elemental Pickup Interactions grant 30% [PVP: 10%] increased damage for a variable duration based on the pickup. Can be activated while stowed.

0 Ionic Traces, 1 Stasis Shards, and 2 Tangle Detonations grant the buff for 4 seconds. Throwing a held 3 Tangle grants 4 additional seconds. 4 Firesprites and 5 Void Breaches grant the buff for 8 seconds.

Additional Pickups can extend the duration up to the maximum of 16 seconds.

Elemental Pickup Interactions:
• Destroying a 6 Tangle (or Elemental Orbs), either by shooting or throwing.
• Collecting 7 Firesprites, 8 Ionic Traces, 9 Stasis Shards, or 10 Void Breaches

Does not trigger with 11 Stasis Shards generated from Facet of Awakening or Facet of Command.

entries.title: Whisper Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 30 Reload Speed.

Aiming Down Sights for 1.2 seconds without shooting grants 'Whispered Breathing' until you leave ADS.

Whispered Breathing grants 35% increased precision damage, and an additional 10.77% increased damage against combatants.

entries.title: Trinary Vision
entries.description:
Fires three wave-frame grenade launcher projectiles that can [PVP: cannot] deal overlapping damage.

Each projectile deals 581 [PVP: ?] damage and travels 12 meters across the ground.

entries.title: Stasis Scavenger
entries.description:
Only works in PvE game modes.

Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to 0 Stasis Weapons matching the Ammo Type.

Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.

Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.

Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

entries.title: Slug Rifle
entries.description:
Hip-fired shots become slow traveling projectiles that deal up to 55 [PVP: ?] splash damage in a 3.5 meter radius, down to 0% at the edge of the radius, and apply 5 0 Scorch stacks (10 with 1 Ember of Ashes).

Aiming Down Sights shoots hitscan projectiles that deal splash damage in a 3 meter radius.

entries.title: M1R Distribution Matrix
entries.description:
Fires a spread of 5 bolts that alternate [+] and [x] pattern, similar to that of a Vex Wyvern.

Each bolt hit grants 8% Glaive Energy and deals 25% increased damage to Vex Combatants. Glaive Melee Hits on Vex Combatants disorient them.

While blocking with Glaive Energy, grants a 0 Void Overshield at a rate of 14 HP/s to both you and allies within a 15 meter radius. Overshield lasts for 8 seconds (12 with 1 Echo of Persistance).

In PvP, glaive shield uniquely provides 50% Damage Resistance against 2 Primary and Melee Damage from other players (compared to the standard 30%).

entries.title: Paracausal Beam
entries.description:
Deals 400% increased damage to Combatant Shields and Subjugator Bosses.

For the purposes of Microcosm, Tormentors and Subjugators are always considered shielded

entries.title: Property: Undecidable
entries.description:
The element of this [weapon | instrument | topology] will change to match your equipped grenade.

Kills grant 20% grenade energy and 2.5% additional Light and Dark Transcendence energy.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Fan Fire
entries.description:
Hip-Fired Precision Hits deal 88% [PVP: ?] increased damage.

Hip-Fired hits grant a stack of 'Fan Fire' for 4 seconds. Maximum of 4 stacks. Stacks are removed on reload or Aiming Down Sights.

Benefits at 1|2|3|4 stacks:
• 5|10|15|20 Reload Speed
• 5%|10%|15%|20% reduced Accuracy Cone Size

entries.title: Void Resistance
entries.description:
Reduces Incoming 0 Void Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.title: Absolution
entries.description:
On Orb of Power Pickups:
Grants 5%|7.5%|10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Pace Yourself

Firing semi-automatically grants the following benefits:

entries.title: The Manticore Catalyst

While airborne, any kill or 5 hits against an Elite, Miniboss, or Boss refills 12 ammo and grants a 15HP 0 Void Overshield for 6 seconds (9 seconds with 1 Echo of Persistance).

1 second cooldown when activated by hits.

entries.title: Rites of Ember
entries.description:
0 Daybreak Projectiles trigger a 1 Solar Ignition on hit. Ignitions from any source deal 100% increased damage.

entries.title: Silkbound Slayer
entries.description:
Deal 50% [PVP: 20%] increased precision damage against 0 Suspended targets. Bodyshots are granted 125% [PVP: 44%?] increased damage (although reported with yellow numbers, they are not precision hits).

1 Suspending an enemy from any source, or damaging a 2 Suspended enemy with this weapon, grants 100 Reload Speed and 30% decreased Draw Time for 6? seconds.

entries.title: Swarmers
entries.description:
Spawns 2 0 Threadlings upon destroying a Tangle.

Threadlings apply 1 Unravel for ? [PVP: 5] seconds on hit (? [PVP: 7.5] seconds with 2 Thread of Continuity).

entries.title: Regenerative Motion

entries.title: Nightmare Fuel
entries.description:
Powered Melee Kills and Finishers grant Nightmare Fuel for 7 seconds. 0 Grapple Melees do not count.

Gaining Nightmare Fuel refills the magazine of all stowed weapons from reserves.

Nightmare Fuel grants ? Handling and 50 Airborne Effectiveness while active.

Readying a different weapon after gaining Nightmare Fuel refreshes its duration and grants 35% [PVP: 20%] increased weapon damage (Empowering Buff). Swapping weapons again removes Nightmare Fuel.

Scoring a Kill with a weapon currently benefiting from the damage buff grants you a fresh instance of Nightmare Fuel (as if you scored another Powered Melee Kill).

entries.title: Strand Holster
entries.description:
After stowing 0 Strand Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.title: Arc/Strand Siphon Combo
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with an 0 Arc or 1 Strand Weapon.

Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Markov Chain
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant a stack of 'Markov Chain' for 4.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks. Stacks are removed on stow.

Melee Kills instantly refills the magazine. Melee kills while Monte Carlo is being held grant all 5 stacks of Markov Chain.

Damage increase at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• PvE: 13%|26%|39%|52%|65%
• PvP: 6.6%|13.2%|19.8%|26.4%|33%

entries.title: Monte Carlo Catalyst
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] while at maximum Markov Chain stacks to lock the bayonet.

While Monte Carlo is held, it replaces your Melee Ability with a powerful glaive-like stab that deals 2,772 [PVP: 140] melee damage. Stab can reach up to 7 meters away and grants 50% Melee Ability Energy on hit.

entries.title: Envious Arsenal
entries.description:
Dealing any damage with both of your other weapons refills the magazine from reserves upon readying the weapon.

🡅 Passively grants 10 Ammo Generation stat (equivalent of an Ammo Generation armor mod).

entries.title: Melee Momentum
entries.description:
Glaive Melee Kills grant Weapon Energy and ?% increased movement speed while Blocking for 10 seconds.

Weapon Energy granted by Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 16.7%
• Elites, Players: ?%
• Minibosses: 50%

🡅 Weapon Energy granted is increased.

entries.title: Dynamic Duo
entries.description:
Holding [Grenade] consumes your 0 Arc Grenade to make you 1 Amplified and summon a '2 Sentient Arc Soul' for 20 seconds.

Sentient 3 Arc Soul information:
• Counts as 4 Arc Grenade Ability damage
• Grants 5% Grenade Energy once per burst if it damages an enemy (this does not work if you have 5 Devour active)

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: The Fourth Horseman Catalyst
entries.description: Grants 40 Reload Speed and Increases Magazine Size by 1 (4🠚5)

entries.title: Consul's Pitch
entries.description:
0 Hellion projectiles deal up to 20% increased damage after traveling 17 meters.

1 Hellion projectiles that have been in flight for 1 second release 4 pieces of Shrapnel with tracking capabilities.

Shrapnel projectiles deal 18 [PVP: ?] 2 Solar Damage and apply 5? stacks of 3 Scorch each.

entries.title: Solar/Strand Dual Siphon
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a 0 Solar or 1 Strand Weapon.

Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Eyes of Tomorrow Catalyst
entries.description:
Dealing damage grants a stack of 'Blast Distributor' for 5 seconds, increasing your Grenade Stat by 10 per stack. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Kills grant 10% Grenade Ability Energy.

Using your Grenade Ability refills the Magazine with a 3 second cooldown.

entries.title: Cast No Shadows
entries.description: Dealing Melee Damage refills 20% of the Magazine (rounded up) and grants ? Handling for ? seconds.

entries.title: Omolon Fluid Dynamics
entries.description:
The upper 50% of the Magazine has up to 20 Stability and 30 Reload Speed.

The benefits decrease linearly as the Magazine approaches 50% capacity.

entries.title: Shoot to Loot
entries.description:
Weapon Hits against Orbs of Power collect them.

If collecting ammo is possible:
Weapon Hits against Ammo Bricks pick them up, trigger Ammo Pickup Effects, and refill all Weapons from reserves.

Does not require direct hits.

🡅 Passively grants 5 Range.

entries.title: Ice Breaker
entries.description:
Bodyshot Kills or 0 Shattering a 1 Stasis Crystal triggers a Solar Explosion, dealing 480 [PVP: 40] damage in a ? meter radius.

Precision Kills or 2 Shattering a 3 Frozen target triggers a 4 Solar Ignition.

entries.title: New Land Beyond Catalyst
entries.description: While above 20 stacks of The Master, Bullseye Bolster duration is increased by ? seconds and the magazine is refilled on each shot.

entries.title: No Distractions
entries.description:
Grants 35% Flinch Resistance after 1 second of Aiming Down Sights (ADS) without firing. Remains active until you're no longer ADS.

Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed.

entries.title: Lagrangian Sight
entries.description:
This weapon passively searches for Minor, Elite, or Player targets within 50 meters and marks them through walls [PVP: highlights them] for 45 seconds. Requires a minimum of three viable targets and prioritizes the farthest target away. Mark disappears past 80 meters. Cooldown of 7 seconds between marks.

Killing marked targets in any way spawns a 'Telemetry Pattern' at their location for 60 seconds, which can be physically collected to generate 1 ammo.

Telemetry Patterns are lost on death.

Collecting 3 Telemetry Patterns generates 6 ammo and 'Langrangian Sight' for 30 seconds, granting:
• 50% [PVP: 87.5%] increased damage
• 30 Handling
• 35 Reload Speed

Buff can be activated while stowed.

Collecting Telemetry Patterns during Langrangian Sight's timer fully refreshes the buff.

entries.title: Stats for All Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Stats For All trait:
Upon damaging 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each, for 10 seconds:
• 35 Handling and Reload Speed
• 10 Stability and Range
• 5% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier

Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.title: Cascade Point Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Cascade Point trait:
After scoring a kill or multiple Precision Hits within 5 seconds of each with a different weapon:

Readying this weapon reduces its Firing Delay for 2.5 seconds.

Firing Delay is reduced by 30% on SMGs and Machine Guns and by 40% on other archetypes.

Precision Hits requried per weapon archetype:
• Bows, Linear Fusion/Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaive Projectiles: 2 hits
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 4 hits
• Auto/Trace/Pulse Rifles, SMGs, Machine Guns, Sidearms: 6 hits

entries.title: Repulsor Brace Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Repulsor Brace trait:
Kills against 0 Void Debuffed enemies grant a 45 HP 1 Void Overshield for 8 seconds (12 with 2 Echo of Persistence).

entries.title: Loose Change Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Loose Change trait:
Applying an Elemental Debuff grants the following benefits for 9 seconds:
• 50 Reload Speed and 20 Aim Assist
• 20% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty

Buff can be activated while stowed.

entries.title: Witherhoard Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 40 Handling.

This weapon is automatically loaded from reserves after 2 seconds of being stowed.

entries.title: Adagio
entries.description:
Weapon Kills grant the following for 🡅8 seconds:
• 10 Range
• 30% increased damage
• 20% longer Firing Delay/Charge Time/Draw Time

Hand Cannons only recieve a 27% damage increase. Buff is removed on stow.

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.title: Burning Ambition
entries.description:
Direct Hits against 0 Scorched Enemies apply additional 1 Scorch on a 0.5 second cooldown:
• 2 Primary Weapons apply 10 [PVP: 4] additional 3 Scorch per Direct Hit (15 [PVP: 9?] with 4 Ember of Ashes)
• 5 Special and 6 Power Weapons apply 20 additional 7 Scorch (30 with 8 Ember of Ashes)

Scoring multiple Direct Hits within 3? seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to 9 Scorch the target. Hit counter persists through stow.

Number of Direct Hits required by weapon type:
• Bows: 2
• Swords: 3
• Other Weapons: 55% of the base magazine size

10 Scorch applied by Burning Ambition to Unscorched targets counts as Weapon Damage.

11 Ember of Ashes increases the amount of 12 Scorch applied by 50%.

entries.title: Hearts of Ice
entries.description:
Enemies frozen by 0 Winter's Wrath receive 150% increased 1 Shatter damage.

• Refunds ?% Super Energy per ally buffed. (Only works once per ally?)

• Grants 2% 10 Winter's Wrath Super Energy for each ally that received the above benefits

entries.title: Trespasser Catalyst

• 20 Aim Assist
• ? ADS Handling

entries.title: Air Assault
entries.description:
Passively grants 🡅12 Airborne Effectiveness.

Grounded Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack while airborne kills grant 2 Stacks. Buff is removed on stow.

🡅 Grants 2 more Airborne Effectiveness passively and per Stack.

entries.title: M1R Distribution Matrix IV

entries.title: Nightsworn Sight III

entries.title: Soul Devourer
entries.description:
Collecting a Remnant grants 'Soul Devourer' for 7 seconds and refills 4 ammo.

Collecting additional Remnants can overflow both the timer and magazine, extending the duration up to 11 seconds and the magazine up to 350% capacity (40 rounds).

Soul Devourer increases poison damage by 200% [PVP: 1750%?] while active.

entries.title: Dragon's Breath Catalyst
entries.description:
Doubles the rate of passive Composite Propellant generation (6🠚3 Seconds per stack).

Kills generate 0 Firesprites. These kills ignore the global 1 Firesprite spawning cooldown.

entries.title: Wrath of the Colossus
entries.description: Requires a one-second charge time before entering full-auto at the listed RPM.

entries.title: Beacons of Empowerment
entries.description:
The 0 Sol Invictus buff you receive from 1 Sunspots lasts twice as long (5⁠🠚⁠10 seconds).

2 Sunspots you create gain new visuals and now benefit allies, granting them the 3 Sol Invictus buff for 10 seconds.

entries.title: Strand Resistance
entries.description:

The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.title: Wolfpack Rounds

entries.title: Master of Arms
entries.description:
Scoring a Kill with any weapon grants Master of Arms x1, granting 15% increased damage for 🡅8 seconds.

Scoring a Kill with any weapon with Master of Arms active grants Master of Arms x2, granting 25% increased damage for 🡅5 seconds.

Master of Arms x2 expiring reverts the buff back to Master of Arms x1.

🡅 Buff duration is increased by 1 second.

entries.title: Transcendent Duelist
entries.description:
Kills grant an additional 2.5% energy to both Light and Dark Transcendence bars.

While Transcendent, gain the following benefits:
• 44% increased sword damage (Exotic Perk effects are instead granted 20% increased damage)
• Dealing sword damage increases Transcendence Grenade Regeneration by 35% for 2 seconds
• Kills extend your Transcendence duration by an additional ? seconds

entries.title: Screaming Swarm
entries.description:
This is a Weapon of Sorrow.

Deals 10% more damage than other Precision Frame SMGs.

Fires slow seeking projectiles that track targets within the reticle from up to ? meters away.

entries.title: Command Frame
entries.description:
Aiming Down Sights consumes one ammo to fire a single hit-scan projectile that can deal precision damage.

Projectile deals 243 [PVP: 40.25] bodyshot damage and 435 [PVP: 72] precision damage.

entries.title: Excavation
entries.description:
Grenades fired explode into 3 additional cluster bombs, each dealing 158 [PVP: 50] damage in a 4 meter radius.

Kills cause enemies to explode, dealing 109.2 [PVP: 72.8] damage in a 3 meter radius.

entries.title: Kintsugi
entries.description:
Kills with a Weapon matching the element of your Super Ability grant 0 Restoration x1 to you and allies within 15 meters for 3 seconds (4.5 with 1 Ember of Solace). 3 second cooldown between activations.

Reviving allies or being revived projects a 15-meter field around the wearer for 10 seconds that grants the wearer and allies inside it the Shielded buff.

Shielded grants a 100 HP Overshield that regenerates in 1 second as long as it remains active after not receiving damage for 2 seconds.

Shielded is removed if the Overshield is destroyed and you cannot regain it by leaving and reentering the field. If the wearer's Overshield is destroyed, the field granting it to allies is removed as well.

entries.title: Physic
entries.description:
Triggering 'Support Frame Boost' by healing allies with the weapon grants its element-matching effect to the user as well as the targeted ally.

Effect granted based on Weapon Element:
0 Solar: Restoration x1 for 4 seconds (6 with 1 Ember of Solace)
2 Arc: Amplified for 5 seconds
3 Stasis: x2 Frost Armor for 5 seconds
4 Strand: Releases 4 Unraveling Threads
5 Void: Grants a ?HP Void Overshield for ? Seconds

entries.title: Fafnir Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 35% Flinch Resistance after 1 second of Aiming Down Sights (ADS) without firing. Remains active until you're no longer ADS.

Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed.

entries.title: Power Preservation
entries.description:
Super Kills spawn an Orb of Power for allies.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.75%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

1.5? second cooldown between Orb spawns.

entries.title: Eriana's Vow Catalyst
entries.description:
Increases the magazine size by 3 (6🠚9).

Refills stowed weapon from reserves after 3.5 seconds of it being stowed.

entries.title: Full Stop
entries.description:
Deals 181% increased Precision Damage to PvE Combatants.

Aim well.

entries.title: Alacrity
entries.description:
While 1 teammate is currently dead:
Grants 10 Range, 10 Stability, 25 Reload Speed, and 5 Aim Assist.

While Solo or 2+ teammates are currently dead:
Grants 20 Range, 20 Stability, 50 Reload Speed, and 10 Aim Assist.

Only activates when the weapon has been readied for 1 second.

Does not work in the Rumble Crucible Game Mode.

entries.title: Still Hunt Catalyst
entries.description:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Precision Kill grants 'Lucky Shot Ready'.

Scoring a Precision Hit while you have Lucky Shot Ready refills the magazine by 1 from reserves and begins a 7 second timer. Additional precision hits during this timer continue to refill the magazine from reserves.

entries.title: Elemental Charge
entries.description:
Collecting Elemental Pickups or destroying 0 Tangles grants 1 Stack of Armor Charge upon reaching 100% Activation Progress.

Activation Progress with 1|2|3 Mods equipped:
• 1 Firesprites, 2 Void Breaches, 3 Tangles: 50%|50%|100%
• 4 Ionic Traces: 34%|50%|50%
• 5 Stasis Shards: 25%|34%|50%

entries.title: Strand Targeting

Grants the following to 0 Strand Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Frenzy
entries.description:
After being in Combat for 12 seconds:
Grants 15% increased damage, 100 Handling, and 100 Reload Speed for 7.2 seconds.

Works and can activate while stowed. Dealing and receiving damage refreshes the buff duration.

For Frenzy, being in Combat is defined as having either dealt or received damage within the last 🡅5.5 seconds.

Self-damage and environmental damage do not count.

🡅 Allowed time between damage exchanges extended by 0.5 seconds.

entries.title: Heal Clip
entries.description: Finishing a reload within 5.3? seconds of a Kill grants 0 Cure x2 to you and 1 Cure x1 to allies within 15 meters.

entries.title: Invisible Hand
entries.description:
Consecutively missing multiple times within 2.5 seconds of each grants 25? Stability for 2.5 seconds.

Buff is removed 1? second after scoring a Hit. Missing again refreshes the buff duration.

Misses in a row required:
• Auto Rifles, Submachine Guns: 10
• Pulse Rifles: 9
• Hand Cannons: 4
• Linear Fusion Rifles: 2

entries.title: Webcatcher
entries.description:
0 Threaded Spike can now target and bounce to 1 Tangles, detonating them on impact and immediately returning to the user.

Catching the 2 Threaded Spike after it detonates a 3 Tangle equips you with a second throwable 4 Tangle. Alternatively, failing to catch the 5 Threaded Spike triggers an 8 meter 6 Strand Detonation around you, dealing 727 [PVP: ?] damage with no falloff.

This detonation counts as Powered Melee damage, scaling with the Melee stat and triggering melee-effects.

Catching a 7 Threaded Spike that didn't detonate a 8 Tangle refunds an additional fixed 25% Melee Ability Energy.

entries.title: Stunloader
entries.description: Stunning a Champion refills 50% of the Magazine from reserves.

entries.title: Edge of Intent
entries.description:
Glaive Melee Hits grant one stack of 'Charged Edge'. Projectile Hits grant two stacks. At 6 stacks, hold [Reload] to generate 1 ammo from thin air and make the next shot fire a sentient 0 Healing Turret.

Weapon Kills trigger a 1 Solar explosion that applies 30 2 Scorch Stacks (40 with 3 Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.

Killing Elite or higher tier Combatants and Players increases the radius to 8 meters and applies 10 more 4 Scorch Stacks.

5 Scorch damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs.

Only applies to Glaive Projectiles.

entries.title: Sacred Flame
entries.description:
Heavy Attacks apply 'Sacred Flame' to your target.

Light Attacks on Sacred-Flame marked targets, or on target death, trigger an explosion dealing 136 [PVP: ?] damage in a 5 meter radius.

Sacred Flame does not recieve the Ergo Sum Transcendence damage buff.

entries.title: Primeval's Torment
entries.description:
Fires a Taken projectile that creates a Blighted Pool in a 4.5 meter radius for 4.5 seconds upon impact with the ground.

Enemies within the pool take damage every 0.3 seconds.

entries.title: Benevolent Finisher
entries.description: Finishers consume 3 Stacks of Armor Charge and spawn an Orb of Power for your allies that grants 7.15% Super Energy.

entries.title: Heartshadow Catalyst
entries.description:
Increases reserves by 6 (57🠚63).

Grants 50% increased movement speed while under the effects of 0 Void Invisibility.

entries.title: Bait and Switch
entries.description:
Dealing damage with a weapon starts a 7 second timer. Dealing additional weapon damage resets the timer to 7 seconds.

Dealing damage with all 3 of your weapons without letting the timer run out grants you 'Bait and Switch' for 10 seconds, granting 30% increased damage.

Timer is disabled while Bait and Switch is active, requiring a full activation sequence once the buff expires.

entries.title: The Fundamentals
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to cycle this weapon's element between 0 Arc, 1 Solar, and 2 Void. Selected element persists through stow and death.

Grants 30% [PVP: 10%] increased damage for 10 seconds upon receiving or applying an elemental buff or debuff that matches the currently selected element.

Buff can be activated while stowed.

entries.title: MIDA Software Package
entries.description:
Kills with this or other MIDA-Synergy weapons grants progress towards the 4-stage 'Software Update' counter. Each stage requires an equal number of kills in order to advance. Dying resets progress to the start of the previous stage.

Progress to the next stage is granted by ammo type:
• 0 Primary: 15% [PVP: 100%] Stage Progress
• 1 Special: 10% [PVP: 50%] Stage Progress

Benefits at each stage of Software Update:
• Chip: 25% decreased Handling Animation Speed
• Barrel: 15 Range and 15 Stability
• Optics: 15% increased Aim Assist Falloff distance and 5% increased Auto Aim cone angle
• Ammo: Shots explode on impact, dealing 19 [PVP: 7] damage in a 3 meter radius

Software Update also grants 4.8%|9.6%|14.4%|14.4% increased damage against PvE Combatants at Stages 1|2|3|4.

entries.title: Khvostov Catalyst
entries.description:
Scoring 25 Hits against enemies within 5 seconds of each spawns an Orb of Power that grants 🡅0.8% Super Energy.

Does not require Direct Hits. Hit counter persists through stow.

entries.title: The Navigator Catalyst
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to activate Grapple Tangle mode.

Fires a floating 0 Grapple Point to where the reticle previews at approximately 23.5 meters away. Identical to those made by the 1 Widow's Silk aspect.

30 second cooldown, starting only once grounded.

entries.title: Stormbringer
entries.description:
On 3 Precision Hits within 6 seconds of each:
• Grants x1 0 Bolt Charge
• Summons a lightning strike after 1.1 seconds, dealing 1 973 [PVP: 300] damage in a 7 meter radius
• Summons a lightning storm 0.5 seconds later, dealing 2 584 [PVP: 180] damage in a spread-X pattern in a 5 meter radius.

Lightning storm staggers enemies and deals 25% damage at the edge of its radius. Enemies can only take damage from the storm once.

Precision Hit progress is removed on stow.

entries.title: Grenade Chaser
entries.description:
Scoring hits with Tracking Missiles grant one stack of 'Grenades Prepped'. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Hold [Reload] to switch the gun to Grenade Launcher mode, loading a grenade for each stack gained.

Grenades deal 1,308 [PVP: 134] damage on impact in a 5 meter radius with up to 30% fall off at the edges. Grenades deal no self-damage.

entries.title: Robber Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Grave Robber trait:
Powered Melee Hits and (Glaive) Melee Kills refill the magazine from reserves.

3 second cooldown between activations.

entries.title: Immovable Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Immovable Object trait:
While blocking and stationary:
Glaive Projectiles Hits grant 90% increased Weapon Energy.

entries.title: Feedback Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Replenishing Aegis trait:
Refills 1 round into the Magazine from reserves upon blocking damage.

1 second cooldown after activation. Does not work while the magazine is overfilled (assumed).

entries.title: Wavesplitter Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 10 Range and 30 Ammo Generation.

Scoring 25 Hits within ? seconds of each triggers an explosion around the target, dealing up to 250 [PVP: ?] weapon element-matching damage in an 8 meter radius.

Scoring 69 Hits against enemies within 5 seconds of each spawns an Orb of Power that grants 0.8% Super Energy. Hit counter persists through stow.

entries.title: Anti-Flinch
entries.description: Passively grants 15% Flinch Resistance.

entries.title: Ager's Call
entries.description:
Intrinsically deals 30% more PvE damage than Legendary Trace Rifles.

Weapon Kills trigger a burst of 100 [PVP: 50] 0 Stasis Slow in a 10 meter radius around the target.

entries.title: Protective Weave
entries.description:
Scoring 8 hits on an ally within 1 second of each triggers the following actions:
• Grants you 5 ammo and 10 seconds of 0 Woven Mail
• Grants the ally 60HP and 10 seconds of 1 Woven Mail
• Triggers regeneration for their health, or shields if health is full. Does not heal shields if health is missing

While 2 Woven Mail is active, deal 25% [PVP: 5%] increased damage and gain 40 Ammo Generation.

entries.title: Looks Can Kill
entries.description:
Fires single high-caliber rounds that deal 1078 [PVP: 123] precision damage at base.

Deals 67% increased damage to 0 Barrier Champions.

Breaking a 1 Solar Elemental Shield or 2 Stunning a Barrier Champion instantly triggers a 3 Solar Ignition.

This 4 Ignition benefits from Eriana's damage increase against 5 Barrier Champions if it is triggered by breaking their shield.

entries.title: Dimensional Shift
entries.description:
Collecting a 0 Void Breach grants 'Dimensional Breach' until your next Weapon Kill.

Scoring a Weapon Kill while Dimensional Breach is active grants a 22.5 HP 1 Void Overshield for 8 seconds (12 with 2 Echo of Persistence) and begins a 5 second timer.

Additional weapon kills extend the timer back to 5 seconds.

entries.title: Corrupted Nucleosynthesis
entries.description:
Each Direct Hit grants 25% progress to your 'Enrage'. Enrage linearly increases your rate of fire up to 126 RPM (40% increase) at maximum level.

Entering Critical Health instantly grants max Enrage.

Enrage's progress constantly decays at a rate of ?% per second over 9.5 seconds. While you are at Critical Health, Enrage does not decay.

entries.title: Harmonic Resonance
entries.description:
Equipping multiple 2|3 Root of Nightmares weapons grants the following benefits:
• 3.33% | 10% increased damage against The Dread, Lucent Hive, and Nezarec
• 10 | 20 Handling
• 0 | 20 Reload Speed
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Turnabout
entries.description:
Grants the Turnabout trait:
Upon breaking a Combatant's Elemental Shield or the Shield of a Guardian in their Super:
Grants a 30 HP Overshield for 10 seconds.

entries.title: Aggregate Charge
entries.description:
Damage against Elemental-Debuffed Targets is increased per unique debuff applied to the target.

Damage increased is 🡅11%|22%|33% at 1|2|3 Debuffs.

🡅 Damage buff is increased by 10% (e.g. 10%🠚11%).

entries.title: Solar Resistance
entries.description:
Reduces Incoming 0 Solar Damage from PVE Combatants by 15%|25%|30% with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

The effects of different Resistance Mods stack multiplicatively with each other.

entries.title: Keep Away
entries.description:
While no enemies are within 15 meters:
Grants 10 Range, 🡅35 Reload Speed, and decreases Accuracy Cone Growth by 🡅7.5?%.

🡅 Grants an additional 5 Reload Speed and further decreases Accuracy Cone Growth by 2.5?%. (5?⁠%🠚7.5?⁠%)

entries.title: Coronal Culmination
entries.description:
Counts as a 0 Strand Weapon for most armor mods. 1 Solar Explosion will only be buffed by Solar Surge mods.

Hold down the trigger to charge this weapon's rocket through three stages. At base, it takes 4.85 seconds to fully charge Whirling Ovation.

Upon reaching the first stage, a high damage delayed 2 Solar Explosive is added to the rocket, which detonates after 1? second and deals damage in a 10 meter radius.

Holding down the trigger for 0.4 seconds after reaching maximum charge automatically fires the rocket.

Benefits at 33%-66%|66%-99%|100% Charge Level:
• 55%|109%|212% increased impact damage
• [N/A] |35%|52% increased explosion damage
• 207%|315%|525% overall damage increase

entries.title: Adept Impact
entries.description: Passively grants 5 Impact.

entries.title: Four-Headed Dog
entries.description:
Fires 3 evenly spread pellets around the center pellet in an alternating triangle pattern for each shot. The central pellet always stays within the accuracy cone around your reticle.

Pellets experience 'reverse range falloff' at close-mid range and deal less damage the closer you are to the target: Deal 16.67% decreased damage at point-blank, scaling up to base damage at 14 meters (22.4 when ADS).

Beyond ~30 meters (~53 when ADS), damage starts experiencing regular falloff.

entries.title: Paracausal Affinity
entries.description:
Scoring a Kill from any source matching the elemental alignment of the weapon grants 20% increased damage for 6 seconds.

Buff can activate while stowed.

Light Alignment: 0 Arc, 1 Solar, 2 Void
Darkness Alignment: 3 Stasis, 4 Strand

entries.title: Subatomic Distortion
entries.description:
Hits with this weapon deal three additional damage instances after 0.75 seconds, lacerating enemies for 1032 [PVP: ?] bonus damage.

Activating Quantum Nova triggers a 10 meter radius detonation around you, applying a 0 Strong Weaken (30%) for 5 seconds and dealing 1420 [PVP: ?] damage.

entries.title: Void Loader
entries.description:
Grants the following to 0 Void Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

entries.title: Targeting Adjuster
entries.description: Passively grants 5 Aim Assist.

entries.title: Temporal Manipulation II
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to refill 3 ammo and switch between firing modes:
• 0 Arc Mode fires at 150 RPM
• 1 Stasis Mode fires at 95 RPM and deals explosive splash damage in a 3 meter radius.

Scoring 3 Kills or Precision Hits within 7 seconds of each grants 'Arc|Stasis Overcharge' when in Stasis|Arc firing mode. Overcharge drains at a rate of 4.5% per second once earned.

Buff is removed if you swap off the mode matching its element.

entries.title: Temporal Manipulation III
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to refill 3 ammo and switch between firing modes:
• 0 Arc Mode fires at 150 RPM
• 1 Stasis Mode fires at 95 RPM and deals explosive splash damage in a 3 meter radius.

Scoring 3 Kills or Precision Hits within 7 seconds of each grants 'Arc|Stasis Overcharge' when in Stasis|Arc firing mode. Overcharge drains at a rate of 4.5% per second once earned.

Buff is removed if you swap off the mode matching its element.

entries.title: Temporal Manipulation IV
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to refill 3 ammo and switch between firing modes:
• 0 Arc Mode fires at 150 RPM
• 1 Stasis Mode fires at 95 RPM and deals explosive splash damage in a 3 meter radius.

Scoring 3 Kills or Precision Hits within 7 seconds of each grants 'Arc|Stasis Overcharge' when in Stasis|Arc firing mode. Overcharge drains at a rate of 4.5% per second once earned.

Buff is removed if you swap off the mode matching its element.

entries.title: Sacred Flame
entries.description:
Drawing from the hip marks up to 3 enemies near the reticle. Releasing the trigger fires lock-on arrows that apply 'Sacred Flame' to each marked target for [10] [PVP: 5] seconds.

Enemies marked by Sacred Flame explode on death, dealing 295 [PVP: 137] damage in a 5.5 meter radius. If a Sacred Flame explosion hits other marked enemies, they too explode.

Sacred Flame explosions are reduced by 50% damage at the edge of their radius.

entries.title: Jump Jets
entries.description:
Enables hipfiring and aim down sights while in Lift and passively grants 50 Airborne Effectiveness.

Increases Lift Duration to 4 seconds:
• High Lift: 2.6🠚4 (54% increase)
• Strafe Lift: 2.2🠚4 (82% increase)
• Catapult Lift: 1🠚4 (300% increase)

Grants the following benefits while a 0 Primary Weapon is readied and not Aiming Down Sights:
• 5 Range and 30? Stability
• 70% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 2 degrees increased Precision Aim Cone Angle
• 20% increased Aim Assist and Damage Falloff Distance

DMT, Last Word, and Tommy's Matchbook are uniquely tuned and do not receive as significant of a benefit.

entries.title: Mecha Holster
entries.description:
Passively grants 40 Airborne Effectiveness, 50 Handling, and a 0.8x Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier to Submachine Guns (SMGs).

Grants the following while holding an SMG:
• 30 Mobility
• 6.25% increased Sprint Speed
• 33% increased Slide Distance
• 33% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty (25%⁠🠚⁠16.75%)

Refills the Magazine of SMGs 1 second after they are stowed, even if the SMG is re-equipped within this window.

Scoring SMG Hits on PVE Combatants grants a Stack of 'Damage Buff' for 1 second. Maximum of 20 stacks. Damage Buff grants 5% increased SMG damage per stack, capping out at 100%.

Boss-Tier Enemies take 33% decreased damage from Peacekeeper-buffed shots.

entries.title: Linear Actuators
entries.description:
Passively increases Sprint Speed by 6.25% and Slide Distance by 33%.

Sprinting for 1.5 seconds grants 'Linear Actuators' for 7 seconds. Melee or Glaive Hits with Linear Actuators active apply the 'Shocked' debuff to the target.

Shocked enemies chain 220 [PVP: 50] 0 Arc Damage to targets within 12 meters and spread the 'Shocked' debuff. Each chain grants two stacks of 1 Bolt Charge per instance.

Shocked lasts 2 seconds and its duration is refreshed when it chains to other targets. Shocked Players are immune to further chains for 2 seconds.

entries.title: Parasitism
entries.description:
Deal increased damage to targets with SIVA Nanites attached to them.

Damage at 1|2|3|4|5 Nanites:
• PvE: 30%|60%|90%|120%|150%
• PvP: 15%|30%|45%|60%|75%

For each additional Nanite beyond five, the target takes 2.1% additional damage, up to a maximum of 300% increased damage at 100 Nanites.

entries.title: Bolstering Detonation
entries.description:
Grants Class Ability Energy upon dealing Grenade Ability Damage. 7 second cooldown after activation.

Class Ability Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods:
12% [PVP: 6%] | 17% [PVP: 8.5%] | 20% [PVP: 10%]

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Sect of Force
entries.description:
Scoring 4 Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each grants the following for 10 seconds:
• 40? Handling
• 30 Reload Speed
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

Activating the buff on an Elite or Miniboss or stunning a Champion marks them for 30 seconds. Mark duration cannot be refreshed.

Marked enemies are highlighted for allies and take 20% increased damage from them. Damage increase stacks with everything.

Upon marking a target for the first time, Aeon Allies not using Sect of Force receive 33.33% Grenade and Melee Ability Energy per second for 3 seconds.

entries.title: The Last Word Catalyst
entries.description:
Upon readying the weapon after scoring kills with your other Weapons:
Refills and/or overfills the Magazine from reserves based on the amount of Weapon Kills scored.

Loads 1 Ammo per kill achieved with other weapons.

Maximum total overfill amount is 200% of the Magazine Capacity. Each activation can only load up to 100% of the Magazine Capacity into the magazine.

On Weapon Kill, for 5 seconds:
• 50 Mobility
• 40 Handling and 20 Range
• 5% increased Damage Falloff Distance

Additional Kills extend the duration by 5 seconds, up to 8 seconds. Buff is removed on stow.

entries.title: Shield Disorient
entries.description:
On Matching Elemental Shield Break:
Explosion disorients enemies within 7 meters for 5 seconds.

entries.title: Kinetic Holster
entries.description:
After stowing Kinetic Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.title: Strand Siphon
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with with a 0 Strand Weapon.

Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Stasis Ammo Generation
entries.description:
Grants 20|40|50 Ammo Generation stat to 0 Stasis Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Swords receive 20|30|35 Ammo Capacity Stat instead (these values are the equivalent of having Hungry Edge, Backup Mag, or Enduring Blade equipped respectively).

entries.title: Defensive Grip
entries.description:
Blocking ? attacks within ? seconds of each other grants 1 ammo.

1 second cooldown between activations.

Passively grants:
• 80 Guard Resistance
• 80 Guard Endurance

entries.title: Move to Survive
entries.description:
Passive grants the following benefits:
• 30 Airborne Effectiveness
• 25% increased Blink distance
• 20% decreased Blink cooldown (3.55s⁠🠚⁠2.85s)
• 30% decreased Blink activation delay (1.65s⁠🠚⁠1.15s)
• Removes Super Energy cost of 0 Nova Warp's Dark Blink

While Blink is equipped, gain a horizontal 'Dark Blink' bound to your [Air Move]. Movement is identical to Nova Warp's Dark Blink, which spawns 4 [PVP: 2] 1 Weakening Seekers that scale with the Super stat. Incurs a 6 [PVP: 8] second cooldown on use.

Blinking or casting Dark Blink grants 100 Handling for 2 seconds, 2 Volatile Rounds for 9 [PVP: 5] seconds, and the Radar remains active during the animation.

Enemies within 10? meters become 3 Volatile when initiating Blink.

entries.title: Causality Arrows
entries.description:
Aiming Down Sights causes your arrows to instantly detonate Sacred Flame marks on enemies.

Precision Hits that are fired within the Perfect Draw window increase this explosion's damage by 100%.

entries.title: Auto-Loading Holster
entries.description: Refills stowed weapon from reserves after 3.5 seconds of it being stowed.

entries.title: Spike Grenades
entries.description:
Increases Grenade Impact damage:
• 12.12% increase on 0 Special Grenade Launchers
• 12.5% increase on 1 Power Grenade Launchers

Due to the ratio of Detonation and Impact damage being tied to the Blast Radius stat on Grenade Launchers, a lower stat will provide a slightly higher overall damage increase.

entries.title: CQC Optics: Low
entries.description:
Passively decreases Zoom by 1.

Decreasing Zoom has the following effects in ADS:
• Decreased Magnification
• Decreased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• Increased Absolute Recoil
• Widened Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones (size stays the same on-screen)

entries.title: Strand Dexterity
entries.description:
Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to 0 Strand Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

entries.title: Insulation
entries.description: Grants 4%|5%|6% Class Ability Energy on Orb of Power Pickups with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Insectoid Robot Grenades
entries.description: Kills spawn a seeking Insectoid Robot that hunts enemies. Detonates for 284 [PVP: ?] damage on impact in a 3 meter radius.

entries.title: Dark Descent
entries.description:
Void Orbs linearly increase in damage as they fall, dealing up to 182.5% [PVP: 47.7%] bonus damage after 3 seconds of being airborne.

Maximum damage is indicated by critical numbers.

entries.title: Backup Mag
entries.description:
Passively grants 30 Magazine stat (identical to Extended Mag).

On Swords, it grants 30 Ammo Capacity Stat (identical to 2 Reserves Mods and 5 less than having Enduring Blade).

entries.title: Mulligan
entries.description:
Missing has a chance to refund 1 ammo into the magazine based on the ammo type:
• 0 Primary Weapons: 35%
• 1 Special and 2 Power Weapons: 20%

entries.title: Alchemical Etchings
entries.description:
Rifts and 0 Wells of Radiance you cast grant 100 Reload Speed and a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier to all weapons for you and allies inside them. Effect is tied to the rift, even if the exotic is removed.

Empowering Rifts and 1 Wells of Radiance you cast also grant 50% increased Damage Falloff Distance to Weapons.

2 Primary Weapons receive the following bonuses while hipfiring:
• 5 Range and 30? Stability
• 70% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 2 degrees increased Precision Aim Cone Angle
• 20% increased Aim Assist and Damage Falloff Distance

DMT, Last Word, and Tommy's Matchbook are uniquely tuned and do not receive as significant of a benefit.

entries.title: Strange Protractor
entries.description:
Refills held weapon from reserves after sprinting for 1.5 seconds.

Increases Sprint Speed by 6.25% and Slide Distance by 33%.

Prevents Crouch Speed from being decreased below 4 meters per second.

entries.title: Bottomless Appetite
entries.description:
Dealing damage extends Ravenous Beast's duration by 0.05 [PVP: 0.06] seconds per hit (grants 1.75 seconds from a full magazine of damage).

Hits against Minor and Elite Combatants increase buff duration by 0.3 seconds when it's below 3 seconds.

entries.title: Outbreak Perfected Catalyst
entries.description:
Nanite Damage is increased by 25%.

Enemies that die with Nanites attached to them release four Nanites around them, each dealing 13 [PVP: 4] damage.

entries.title: Souldrinker
entries.description:
Finishing a Reload restores health based on the number of hits scored with the weapon before reloading.

Scoring 100% of the Magazine as hits restores 50 HP. No known upper limit to the total amount.

Glaive Melee Hits don't count. Grenade Launcher hits each count as 50% of the Magazine.

entries.title: Sticky Grenades
entries.description:
Grenades stick to impacted surfaces for up to ? seconds and detonate once an enemy gets within ? meters.

Increases Detonation damage by 30% and decreases Impact damage by 85%.

Due to the ratio of Detonation and Impact damage being tied to the Blast Radius stat on Grenade Launchers, a higher stat will be more beneficial:
• 20 Blast Radius: 6% decreased total damage
• 48 Blast Radius: unchanged total damage
• 100 Blast Radius: 11% increased total damage

entries.title: Tenacious Handle
entries.description: Grants 25% Damage Resistance for 5 seconds upon scoring 4 Light Attacks within 3 seconds of each. Buff can be refreshed.

entries.title: Splicer Surge
entries.description:
Finishing a reload after having dealt damage with the weapon grants a Stack of Splicer Surge. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

Splicer Surge grants the following at 1|2|3 Stacks:
• 10? | 20? | 45? Handling
• 10 | 20 | 45 Reload Speed
• 0.967x | 0.934x | 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

entries.title: To the Pain
entries.description:
Every 30 points of damage taken with the weapon readied grants a Stack of 'To the Pain'. Maximum of 10 Stacks. Stowing the weapon removes all Stacks.

Each Stack grants ? Handling and 2 Aim Assist, maxing out at ? Handling and 20 Aim Assist.

Self-damage and environmental damage do not count.

🡅 Stat bonuses are increased.

entries.title: Ballistics
entries.description: Passively grants 6 Range and 6 Stability.

entries.title: Unflinching Void Aim
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights with 0 Void Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.title: Void Leech
entries.description:
Dealing damage charges 'Void Leech Mode'.

Scoring 27 Weapon Hits:
• Charges one currently uncharged 0 Void Debuff
• Uncharged debuffs are granted in the following order: 1 Volatile 🠚 2 Weaken 🠚 3 Suppression

Scoring 6 Weapon Hits on a 4 Void debuffed target, or having a 5 Void debuff applied to you by an enemy, instantly leeches that debuff into your gun.

Both hit counters can progress simultaneously (E.g.: Leeching 6 Weaken off a target also counts as 6 hits toward charging 7 Volatile).

Leeching any 8 Void Debuff off a target, or having all three 9 Void Debuffs charged, enables you to hold [Reload] and activate 'Void Leech' for 15 [PVP: 10] seconds.

Void Leech mode grants 20% increased damage and appplies all stored 10 Void Debuffs on hit.

entries.title: Spheromatik Trigger
entries.description:
Powered Melee Kills and Finishers trigger a Kinetic Explosion at the target's location, knocking nearby enemies into the air and Disorienting them. 1 second cooldown between activations.

Explosion Damage and radius based on Enemy Rank:
• Minors: 439 Damage, 15m Radius
• Elites: 598 Damage, 15m Radius
• Minibosses and higher: 717 Damage, 20m Radius
• Players: ?

Explosions have up to 20% decreased damage at the edge of the radius. Finishers upgrade the explosion to the one triggered by a Powered Melee on a one rank higher target.

Explosions triggered can chain on Kills and will trigger weaker explosions that deal up to 242 [PVP: ?] damage in a 8? meter radius. Chain Explosions don't have a cooldown.

entries.title: Problem Solver
entries.description:
Upon scoring multiple Direct Hits within 5 seconds of each against a Champion, Miniboss, or Boss Combatant:
• Exhausts the combatant for 5 seconds
• Grants 50? Reload Speed and 50? Handling for 10 seconds

Hit requirements by weapon type:
• Fusion Rifles: 12
• Rocket Pulses: 11
• Bows and Grenade Launchers: 3

entries.title: Trinity Ghoul Catalyst
entries.description:
Decreases Draw Time by 15% (756ms🠚633ms).

Lightning Rod is now granted after scoring any 0 Arc kill. Trinity Ghoul must be held in order to receive Lightning Rod.

entries.title: Wish-Ender Catalyst
entries.description:
Scoring Weapon Hits against 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each grants 35% increased damage for 10 seconds. Does not require Direct Hits.

Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.title: Forge Master
entries.description:
