Collecting a 0 Firesprite or scoring 3 1 Solar Kills within 3? seconds of each grants 'Forge Master' for 12 seconds. Buff timer starts once 2 Throwing Hammer is used.

Upon initially gaining Forge Master, generate ~11.7% Melee Ability Energy per second for 8 seconds.

While Forge Master is active, 3 Throwing Hammer is granted improved tracking and can be recalled by pressing your melee input. Recalling your Throwing Hammer guarantees a full refund of the ability, regardless of your Melee Stat.

Recalling after ~2? seconds of scoring a 4 Throwing Hammer hit performs a Perfect Recall. Perfect Recall triggers an explosion at the Hammer's location that deals up to 290 [PVP: ?] Damage in a ~5 meter radius.

Performing Perfect Recalls and picking up additional 5 Firesprites extends the buff duration by 3 seconds, up to 12 seconds.

entries.title: Huckleberry Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants the Kinetic Tremors trait:

Scoring multiple Direct Hits against a target within 3 seconds of each emits 3 damaging shockwaves from its location at the time of activation. Shockwaves appear 0.25 seconds after scoring enough Hits and have a 1 second delay between each pulse. Shockwaves inherit Weapon Damage Buffs.

The perk cannot be retriggered by anyone on a target until 2? seconds after the last shockwave.

For The Huckleberry, these shockwaves activate after 14 hits. Each shockwave deals 215 [PVP: 20] damage in a 6 meter radius and scales with its improved version of Rampage.

entries.title: MIDA Multi-Tool Catalyst
entries.description:
While within 15 meters of an enemy, grants an Enhanced Radar, 20 Reload Speed, and 15% decreased Reload Animation Duration.

Buff lingers for 4 seconds once the condition is no longer met.

entries.title: New Malpais Catalyst
entries.description: Embedded projectiles 0 Unravel targets for 8 seconds upon detonation.

entries.title: Void Weapon Surge
entries.description:
Increases 0 Void Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage

The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.

Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

entries.title: Flame Refraction
entries.description: Kills refill 75 rounds into the magazine from reserves.

entries.title: Double Down
entries.description:
Decreases Class Ability Regeneration Speed by 50% for 19 seconds upon Class Ability usage.

Grants the following to 0 Threaded Specters:
• 50% [PVP: 25%] Damage Resistance (bypassed by damage from you)
• 34% increased duration
• 2 Perched 1 Threadlings

Perched 2 Threadlings are released when the 3 Specter takes 40 damage. Destroying the Specter releases both 4 Threadlings.

Being within 15 meters of your own 5 Specter grants the 'Hidden' buff which removes you from enemy radar.

entries.title: Restorative Turret
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] at full Charged Edge stacks to fire a sentient 0 Healing Turret.

Restorative Turret Properties:
• Lasts 15 seconds
• Targets you and allies within a 30 meters radius once every 3 seconds with healing orbs
• Healing orbs grant x1 1 Cure and x1 2 Restoration for 4 seconds (7 seconds with 3 Ember of Solace) in a 7.5 meter radius

If 4 Touch of Flame is equipped, the turret grants 5 Cure x2 and 6 Restoration x2 for 6 seconds (7 9 with Ember of Solace)

entries.title: Danger Close
entries.description:
Scoring a Precision Kill, 4 Weapon Kills, or scoring multiple Precision Hits grants a Stack of 'Exodus Rockets'. Maximum of 6 Stacks.

Class Ability usage consumes all Stacks to launch a homing rocket per Stack consumed. Rockets deal up to 540 [PVP: 28] Kinetic Damage in a ? meter radius.

Hits with each rocket grant a Stack of 'Enhanced Rockets' for 10 seconds, increasing "rocket-type" damage (Empowering Buff).

Damage increase at 1|2|…|6 Stacks:
10% | 17% | 24% | 30% | 33% | 35%

Rocket-type damage includes: Rocket Launchers, Wolfpack Rounds (both Sword and Rocket versions), Rocket-Assisted Sidearms, Nanotech Tracer Rockets, Grand Overture's Missile Volley, Quicksilver Storm's Tracer Rocket

'Exodus Rockets' Stack acquisition progress on Precision Hits by weapon type:
• Trace Rifles and Vex Mythoclast: 10%
• Auto Rifles and Machine Guns: 15%
• Pulse Rifles, Sidearms, and Crimson: 20%
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles, and Shotguns: 40%
• Bows, Linear Fusion Rifles, Rocket Sidearms, and Sniper Rifles: 67%

Stack acquisition progress doesn't reset upon gaining a Stack, all progress is kept until reaching 600% (max Stacks).

entries.title: Anticipation
entries.description:
Anticipation passively charges over 160 seconds. Dealing damage with other weapons drastically reduces the charge rate based on damage dealt, which at its fastest reaches 100% charge in 3 seconds.

Firing (not holding down the trigger, despite what the UI shows) consumes the meter.

The time required to fully charge Whirling Ovation's rocket is reduced to 4.25|3.75|3.15|2.5|2 seconds at 20%|40%|60%|80|100% Anticipation.

entries.title: Unforeseen Repercussions
entries.description:
My beam fires for 0.6 seconds, marking 9 spots that detonate in a 7 meter radius after my 0.7 second delay.

Each of my detonations applies 0 10 Scorch (15 with the 1 Ember of Ashes) to all enemies struck.

▛ These insights grant us such a feast, O Researcher Mine. You stand [rich] with Desire to [grow] your knowledge. Do you not Wish to [understand] me more...? ▟

entries.title: Starlight Beam
entries.description: While firing from the hip, this gun become an Adaptive Trace Rifle that deals approximately 85% the damage of Legendary Trace Rifles.

entries.title: Balanced Tang
entries.description:
Deal 10% increased damage against Minor combatants.

Scoring 3 Melee Kills within 5 seconds of each restores 65 HP and begins Health Regeneration.

entries.title: Gathering Light
entries.description:
Sword Kills grants 1 stack of 'Gathering Light'. Maximum of 10 stacks.

Gathering Light benefits at 1|2|3|...|10 Stacks:

• ? Guard Resistance
• ? Guard Endurance
• 10%|20%|30%|...|100% increased lunge distance

Stowing the sword consumes all stacks, granting 10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability energy per stack.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Rampage
entries.description:
This gun has a unique version of Rampage that deals more damage in PvE.

Kills grant one stack each. Maximum of 3 Stacks. Stacks expire one at a time every 4.5 seconds.

Bonus damage granted at 1|2|3 stacks:
PvE: 20%|41%|66%
PvP: 10%|21%|33.1%

entries.title: Edge of Concurrence
entries.description:
Glaive Melee Hits grant one stack of 'Charged Edge'. Projectile Hits grant two stacks. At 6 stacks, hold [Reload] to generate 1 ammo from thin air and make the next shot fire a seeking 0 Arc Wave.

Scoring 4 Glaive Projectile Hits within 3 seconds of each causes the next Projectile to apply 1 Jolt.

Being 2 Amplified decreases the number of Hits required by 1.

entries.title: Rampager's Handle
entries.description: Grants 20% Damage Resistance for 5 seconds upon scoring 3 Light Attacks within 3 seconds of each. Buff can be refreshed.

entries.title: Recycled Energy
entries.description:
Finishing a reload within ? seconds after scoring 1|2|3|4|5 Weapon Kills grants 5.7%|8%|9.7%|13.3%|20% Ability Energy to the least-charged Ability.

🡅 Grants ?% more Ability Energy.

entries.title: Voltaic Mirror
entries.description:
While in 0 Arc Staff Super:
• Blocking doesn't consume Super Energy
• Reflected projectiles deal 400% increased damage
• Reflecting projectiles refunds Super Energy

1 Arc Staff can be deactivated at any time to preserve a portion of unspent Super Energy: 75% refund at 100% Super Energy and linearly scaling down to a 50% refund at 0% Super Energy.

On 2 Arc Staff deactivation:
• Triggers a 3 Blinding explosion in a 10 meter radius around you that deals 675 to 2700 [PVP: ? to ?] damage with no falloff based the the number of projectiles reflected
• Grants 4 Stacks of 4 Arc Weapon Surge for 21 [PVP: 16] seconds

entries.title: Time-Slip
entries.description:
Each Precision Hit or Hit against a 0 Stasis-Debuffed target grants 1 stack of 'Rewind Again'. Maximum of 10 stacks.

At 10 stacks, summon a 'Time-Slip Portal' that hovers next to you and fires a three-round burst every 1.25 seconds, each bullet dealing 49.1 [PVP: 10.2] damage.

Time-Slip Portal has a range of 50 meters, experiences no damage falloff, and inherits the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling.

Stowing the weapon removes your Time-Slip Portal.

entries.title: Full Auto Retrofit
entries.description: Weapon Fires Full Auto. Identical to the Gameplay Setting.

entries.title: Duality Catalyst
entries.description: Grants 20 Range and increases Magazine Size by 2 (6🠚8)

entries.title: Unflinching Strand Aim
entries.description:
While Aiming Down Sights with 0 Strand Weapons:
Grants 25%|30%|35% Flinch Resistance with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Stacks multiplicatively with other Flinch Resistance sources.

entries.title: Missile Tracers
entries.description:
Scoring 13 Hits loads a Tracking Missile which fires on the next shot. Missiles are removed on reload.

Tracking Missiles aggressively seek targets to a maximum range of 50 meters and deal 160 [PVP: 22.7] damage on impact.

entries.title: Iron Gaze
entries.description:
Passively increases Aim Assist by 20 but decreases Range by 🡅15.

🡅 Range penalty is decreased by 5.

entries.title: Timeless Mythoclast
entries.description:
This Fusion Rifle fires its bolts one at a time, behaving like a High-Impact Auto Rifle.

Emptying the magazine refills 80% of the number of Hits landed (rounded up) into the magazine from reserves. Requires at least 9 hits to activate.

Unlike traditional Rewind Rounds, this refill has no cooldown.

entries.title: Volatile Light
entries.description:
Damage Falloff for this weapon ends at a 30% penalty (instead of the usual 50% for Auto Rifles).

Bullets ricochet up to two times, dealing 100% [PVP: 35%] increased damage after at least one ricochet.

entries.title: Conditional Finality Catalyst
entries.description:
Finishing a reload within 5.3? seconds of a Kill grants 0 Cure x2 to you and 1 Cure x1 to allies within 15 meters.

Killing 2 Frozen Enemies or 3 Shattering a 4 Stasis Crystal with the weapon grants a Stack of 5 Frost Armor.

entries.title: Redemption
entries.description:
Uses Auto Rifle recoil patterns.

Kills grant 120 HP (0 Cure x2), 100 Reload Speed, and 20% decreased Reload Animation Duration for ? seconds.

Finishing a reload within 5.3? seconds of a kill grants 60 HP (1 Cure x1) to allies within a 15? meter radius of you.

entries.title: Deterministic Chaos Catalyst
entries.description:
Successive Hits within 0.2 seconds of each grant a ramping Damage Buff after scoring 12.5% of the Magazine Capacity as hits. Missing deactivates the buff.

Stacks displayed on-screen are only visual aides, the buff ramps up with each shot once active. Reaches maximum strength at 5 Stacks.

% of the Magazine Capacity as Hits required for each Visual Stack: 12.5%|35.5%|54.5%|74.5%|110.33%

Damage Buff ramps up from 16.73% [PVP: 10.46%] to 40% [PVP: 25%] upon reaching maximum strength.

Assuming no missed shots, it provides roughly a 25% [PVP: 15.85%] Damage Buff on average after firing 100% of the Magazine Capacity.

entries.title: The Corruption Spreads II
entries.description:
Scoring 12 Hits within 1 second of each spawns 2 to 3 SIVA Nanites that attach to the target. Precision Kills spawn 9 Nanites that seek enemies within a ? meter radius. Nanites deal 77 [PVP: 13] damage each.

Nanites last for 3 seconds while airborne, and 9 seconds when attached to a target. Attaching any new nanites refreshes their duration.

entries.title: The Corruption Spreads III
entries.description:
Scoring 12 Hits within 1 second of each spawns 2 to 3 SIVA Nanites that attach to the target. Precision Kills spawn 9 Nanites that seek enemies within a ? meter radius. Nanites deal 77 [PVP: 13] damage each.

Nanites last for 3 seconds while airborne, and 9 seconds when attached to a target. Attaching any new nanites refreshes their duration.

entries.title: The Corruption Spreads IV
entries.description:
Scoring 12 Hits within 1 second of each spawns 2 to 3 SIVA Nanites that attach to the target. Precision Kills spawn 9 Nanites that seek enemies within a ? meter radius. Nanites deal 77 [PVP: 13] damage each.

Nanites last for 3 seconds while airborne, and 9 seconds when attached to a target. Attaching any new nanites refreshes their duration.

entries.title: Tesseract
entries.description:
While at full Sword Energy, sprinting for 1 second grants 'Temporal Sprint' until you are no longer sprinting.

Performing a Grounded Heavy Attack with Temporal Sprint launches a teleporting Blink Attack, draining 50% Sword Energy and teleporting you 10 meters forward.

The Blink Attack consumes 3 ammo and deals up to 530 [PVP: 353] damage 7 times to all enemies within 2 meters of the teleportation path.

Scoring a kill with this attack grants Temporal Sprint again for 2 seconds, and allows you to perform an additional Blink Attack that only costs 1 ammo and 10% sword energy.

entries.title: Twintails
entries.description:
Fires two rockets in a burst pattern.

Each rocket only benefits from armor mods matching its element. The benefits of Loader Mods are based on the last element fired.

entries.title: Sect of Insight
entries.description:
Scoring 2 Precision Multikills generates an Orb of Power at the target's location for allies that grants 3.57% Super Energy.

Finishers spawn Ammo Bricks for allies based on Enemy Rank:
• Elites: 0 Special Ammo Brick
• Miniboss or Boss: 1 Heavy Ammo Brick

Spawned Ammo Bricks grant 60% of a Regular Ammo Brick's pickup amount but retain full variability.

Finishing an Elite, Miniboss, or Boss grants ?% Super Energy to Aeon Allies not using Sect of Insight.

entries.title: Focusing Strike
entries.description:
Grants Class Ability Energy upon dealing Elemental Melee Damage. 7 second cooldown between activations.

Class Ability Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods:
12% [PVP: 6%] | 17% [PVP: 8.5%] | 20% [PVP: 10%]

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

entries.title: Dreaded Visage
entries.description:
Taking damage from enemies grants 5% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy. 1 second cooldown between activations.

If a 0 Void Super Ability is equipped:
Scoring a Kill at Critical Health or 3 Kills within 5 seconds of each grants you 1 Devour for 5 seconds (7.5 seconds with 2 Echo of Persistance).

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.
entries.extraInfo: Item: Mask of the Quiet One

entries.title: Transfusion Matrix
entries.description:
Powered 0 Arc Melee kills refund a Melee Ability Charge and start Health Regeneration.

Melee Hits grant Melee ability energy:
• 50%: Powered Melee Hits
• 15%: Melee Hits with 1 Knockout active
• 5%: Unpowered Melee and Glaive Melee Hits

entries.title: Skittering Stinger
entries.description:
Requires 0 Weighted Throwing Knife to be equipped in order to function.

Grants 1 Weighted Throwing Knifes a second bounce with greatly increased tracking and velocity.

Scoring 3 Precision Hits within 2.5 seconds of each grants the 'Strengthened Throwing Knife' buff for 10 seconds. Precision Hits extend the buff duration by 5 seconds up to the maximum of 30 seconds.

Strengthened Throwing Knife:
• Grants 50 Strength while the buff is active
• Deals 300% [PVP: 100%] Increased Damage
• Stuns 2 Unstoppable Champions
• Buff is consumed on Knife Hit

entries.title: Scissor Fingers
entries.description:
Grants an extra 0 Solar Melee Ability charge.

All Melee charges are recharged simultaneously.
(e.g.: both are recharged on Gambler's Dodge)

1 Throwing Knife Kills increase 2 Throwing Knife damage by 30%|60%|200% after 1|2|3 Kills for 5 seconds. Casting Gambler's Dodge refreshes the buff's duration.

Interaction with the 3 Knock 'Em Down Aspect while 4 Radiant:
• Knife Kills restore 1 charge
• 5 Knife Trick Precision Kills and Direct 6 Ignition Kills in which Knife Trick applied the initial 7 Scorch restore both charges

entries.title: The Fate of All Fools
entries.description:
Scoring a Precision Kill or 3 Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each refills the magazine and grants 1 stack of 'Fate of All Fools'. Maximum of 15 stacks.

Fate of All Fools grants 100% increased damage to Firefly explosions while active.

Non-precision Direct Hits consume one stack of Fate of All Fools and make the shot deal precision damage.

entries.title: Immovable Object
entries.description:
While blocking and stationary:
Glaive Projectiles Hits grant 🡅100% increased Weapon Energy.

🡅 Energy Bonus is increased by 11.11% (90%⁠🠚⁠100%).

entries.title: Solar Holster
entries.description:
After stowing 0 Solar Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.title: Sect of Vigor
entries.description:
Ally Deaths grant 40% Damage Resistance in PVE for 15 seconds and 25% Class Ability Energy.

Reviving Allies grants 40% Damage Resistance in PVE for 10 seconds and 100% Class Ability Energy.

Allies at Critical Health within 10 meters receive 25% Damage Resistance in PVE. Aeon Allies who are not using Sect of Vigor additionally receive 15% Class Ability Energy per second. Buff lingers for 1 second once no longer at Critical Health.

entries.title: Euphony Catalyst
entries.description:
Weapon Hits grant Stacks of Enlightened Action for 2 seconds. Maximum of 12 Stacks.

Stat bonuses at 1|2|…|12 Stacks:
2|7|12|15|20|25|30|35|38|40|45|50 Handling and Reload Speed

Stacks granted per hit by Weapon Type:
• Hand Cannons: 3 Stacks
• Bows: ? Stacks
• Automatic Weapons: 1 Stack

entries.title: Ace of Spades Catalyst
entries.description: Firefly's explosion damage is increased by 50% while Memento Mori is active.

entries.title: Swap Mag
entries.description: Decreases Ready/Stow Animation Duration by 10%.

entries.title: Burning Souls
entries.description:
Casting your Class Ability grants 0 Cure x2.

Upon scoring multiple 1 Solar kills within 3 seconds of each, grants one stack of 'Burning Souls' for 10 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.

Progress is granted based on Enemy Rank:
Minor Enemies: 34%
Elites, Players, and higher: 50%

Burning Souls grants the following benefits while active:
• 15% Increased 2 Solar Ability Damage
• Class Ability Healing is enhanced and granted to allies within 15 meters of cast.

Healing granted at 1|2|3 stacks of Burning Souls:
• 3 Cure x3
• 4 Cure x1 + 5 Restoration x1 for 3 seconds
• 6 Cure x2 + 7 Restoration x1 for 5 seconds

Restoration duration is increased by 50% with 8 Ember of Solace.

entries.title: Whispered Breathing
entries.description:
Grants 30 Reload Speed.

Aiming Down Sights for 1.2 seconds without firing grants 'Whispered Breathing' until you leave ADS.

Whispered Breathing grants 35% increased precision damage, and an additional 10.77% increased damage against PvE Combatants.

entries.title: Payday
entries.description:
Collecting an Ammo Brick refills the magazine.

At maximum rate of fire, Hipfire Accuracy Cone Size is reduced by 15%.

entries.title: Tarrabah Catalyst
entries.description:
Reloading after scoring kills with Tarrabah overfills the magazine from reserves based on the number of Kills scored.

Tarrabah overfills the next magazine by 20% per kill scored, up to a maximum of 150% Base Magazine Capacity. Always rounds up.

Kill counter persists through stow.

entries.title: Heat Sink
entries.description: HP Drain is reduced by 50% (15 HP🠚7.5 HP) while not Aiming Down Sights.

entries.title: Tithing Harvest
entries.description:
Collecting a 0 Stasis Shard refills the magazine.

While Creeping Attrition is active, Precision Kills or 1 Shattering a 2 Stasis Crystal spawns a Small 3 Stasis Shard which tracks back to you.

2 second cooldown between generating additional 4 Stasis Shards.

entries.title: Radar Booster
entries.description: Passively increases maximum Radar Range by 8 meters (48⁠🠚⁠56 meters).

entries.title: Split Decision
entries.description:
Counts for and benefits from the 'Harmonic Resonance' origin trait.

While the 0 Stasis shot is loaded:
• Benefits from Stasis Armor Mods
• Fires pellets in a triangular spread

While the 1 Solar shot is loaded, or the magazine is empty.
• Benefits from Solar Armor Mods
• Fires pellets in a circular spread

entries.title: Adept Icarus Grip
entries.description: Passively grants 15 Airborne Effectiveness and 5 Handling.

entries.title: Fencing Tang
entries.description: Deal 15% increased damage to Bosses and Vehicles.

entries.title: Impact Casing
entries.description:
Increases Impact damage by 10%, resulting in a 2.2% total damage increase (not accounting for other damage perks).

High-Impact Rocket Launchers only receive a 1.03% total damage increase.

entries.title: Arc Holster
entries.description:
After stowing 0 Arc Weapons:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.title: See Me, Feel Me
entries.description:
Grants 0 Volatile Rounds for 9 [PVP: 3] seconds upon exiting 1 Void Invisibility, making hits with Void Weapons apply 2 Volatile.

On Finishers while affected by 3 Void Invisibility:
• Grants a 35% Weapon Damage Buff for 6 seconds
• Grants you and allies within 24 meters the Reserve Overshield buff

Reserve Overshield:
• Grants 500% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate
• Consumed on Class Ability usage, granting the user a 40 HP 4 Void Overshield for 10 seconds

(Letting the timer run out with Echo of Persistence equipped will not grant you 5 Volatile Rounds. 6 Volatile explosions do not count as damage originating from your weapon.)

entries.title: Black Talon Catalyst
entries.description:
Due to an unresolved bug, this catalyst does not function.

The intended behavior was that damage against 0 Void-Debuffed enemies is increased per unique 1 Void-Debuff applied to the target, at a rate of 10% per debuff.

entries.title: Synergy
entries.description:
Scoring 12 [PVP: 6] Weapon Kills spawns an Elemental Pickup matching the weapon's element. Kill counter persists through stow.

Kinetic Weapons spawn an Orb of Power that grants ?% Super Energy instead.

Synergy ignores the global spawning cooldowns of the Elemental Pickups but each spawn will still start the global cooldown. A Kill can trigger Synergy's Pickup spawn and that of a different Pickup Spawner simultaneously.

Synergy has its own Pickup spawning cooldowns separately from the global ones:
• 0 Ionic Traces: 0 seconds
• 1 Firesprites, 2 Void Breaches, 3 Stasis Shards: 5 seconds
• 4 Tangles: 12 seconds

Kills during Synergy's Pickup spawning cooldown do not contribute any activation progress.

entries.title: Grasp of the Devourer
entries.description:
Passively grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Weapons of Sorrow: Thorn, Osteo Striga, Touch of Malice, Cull's Shadow, and Necrochasm.

Melee Hits apply Potent Corruption, which deals Kinetic damage. Defeated enemies spread Potent Corruption on death in a 5 meter radius.

Kills with the following also spread the Potent Corruption:
• Thorn's Bullets
• Osteo Striga's Corruption Effect
• Touch of Malice's Blight's Corruption Effect
• Necrochasm's Corruption and Cursed Thrall Explosions
• Cull's Shadow Corruption Effect

Potent Corruption ticks every 0.52 [PVP: 0.7] seconds for a total of 19 [PVP: ?] ticks over 10 [PVP: ?] seconds. Deals a total of 1366 [PVP: ?] damage over the entire duration.

Corruption's first tick deals 32.35 [PVP: 5?] damage.

Exclusive to 'Potent Corruption': DoT ramps up every tick, with the damage increases compounding together. For the first 14 ticks, each tick deals 11% more damage than the last. For the last 5 ticks, the damage increases by an average of 41% per tick.

entries.title: Harmonic Siphon
entries.description:
Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a Weapon matching your Super Element.

Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.

Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Hunter's Trace
entries.description:
Deals 100% increased damage against Champions at all times.

Scoring 12 Precision Hits grants a charge of 'Targeting Data'. Maximum of 4 charges.

Hold [Reload] to convert each fully charged stack of Targeting Data into a precision sniper round. Sniper rounds fire at 72RPM, have perfect accuracy (even from the hip), and deal 1833 [PVP: 474] precision damage.

Hits with sniper rounds trigger a 322 [PVP: 20] damage Kinetic Shockwave that applies Exhaust for 5 seconds in a 6 meter radius.

entries.title: Rewind Again
entries.description: Precision Hits and Hits against 0 Stasis-Debuffed targets refill 1 ammo into the magazine.

entries.title: Vanguard Determination
entries.description:
Scoring a Weapon Kill within 20 seconds of using you Class Ability grants a stack of 'Vanguard's Determination' for 10 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.

'Vanguard's Determination' grants 2%|4%|6% Damage Resist at 1|2|3 stacks.

Stacks are shared across different weapons with the Vanguard's Determination origin trait.

entries.title: Relentless Strikes Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Relentless Strikes trait:
Scoring 3 Powered Hits within 2? seconds of each refunds 1 ammo.

Wolfpack Round Hits do not count.

entries.title: Attrition Orbs Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Attrition Orbs trait:
Scoring multiple Hits against enemies within 5 seconds of each spawns an Orb of Power that grants 0.8% Super Energy.

Does not require Direct Hits. Hit counter persists through stow.

Hit requirements for activation:
• Rocket Launchers: 2 hits
• Heavy Grenade Launchers: 3 Hits
• Wave-Frame Grenade Launchers: 4 hits
• Bows: 4 Hits
• Swords: 5 Hits
• Area-Denial Grenade Launchers: 26 Hits
• Others: 55% of Magazine Size rounded down + 1

Support Frame Auto Rifle healing round Hits on damaged allies count as 2 Hits.

entries.title: SUBROUTINE: ~RECURSION
entries.description:
Nanites restore an additional ? HP based on Nano-Assault meter progress.

Taking damage while Nano-Assault is active spawns ? additional nanites around you, with a 2 second cooldown between activations.

entries.title: Burning Ambition Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Burning Ambition trait:
Direct Hits against 0 Scorched Enemies apply additional 1 Scorch on a 0.5 second cooldown:
• 2 Primary Weapons apply 10 [PVP: 4] additional 3 Scorch per Direct Hit (15 [PVP: 9?] with 4 Ember of Ashes)
• 5 Special and 6 Power Weapons apply 20 additional 7 Scorch (30 with 8 Ember of Ashes)

Scoring multiple Direct Hits within 3? seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to 9 Scorch the target. Hit counter persists through stow.

Number of Direct Hits required by weapon type:
• Bows: 2
• Swords: 3
• Other Weapons: 55% of the base magazine size

10 Scorch applied by Burning Ambition to Unscorched targets counts as Weapon Damage.

11 Ember of Ashes increases the amount of 12 Scorch applied by 50%.

entries.title: Pack Hunter
entries.description:
While within 15 meters of an ally, grants the following benefits:
• 50 Handling
• 50 Reload Speed
• 10% decreased Reload Animation Duration

Firing within 15 meters of an ally grants them 'Pack Hunter' for 15 seconds.

Pack Hunter buffs all non-exotic Rocket Launchers and causes them to spawn Wolfpack Rounds on detonation. Wolfpack Rounds deal damage matching the element of the rocket that fired them, and in most cases benefit from weapon perks and Empowering buffs.

On average, Wolfpack Rounds are a 26% buff to base Rocket Launcher damage.

entries.title: Dornröschen
entries.description:
Intrinsically lower Crit Multipler (more forgiving due to reduced difference between bodyshot and precision damage).

Fires a massive overpenetrating laser that ricochets into five sub-lasers on impact with the environment, each dealing 369 [PVP: 145] damage.

Bosses take 95% decreased damage from sub-lasers.

entries.title: Unwound
entries.description:
Precision Kills spawn one 0 Threadling.

Landing 6 hits within 3? seconds of each other spawns three 1 Threadlings at the target's location. Hit progress persists through stow.

entries.title: Black Hole
entries.description:
Damage is split between the two shots of the burst:
• First shot deals 15% reduced damage with no recoil
• Second shot deals 35.25% increased damage with increased recoil, and has no damage falloff

Total damage stays equal to the Heavy Burst archetype.

entries.title: New Tricks
entries.description:
Grants an extra 0 Skip Grenade Charge. Skip Grenade drones chase enemies much more aggressively.

Drone Hits grant 4.2% [PVP: 1.4%] Grenade Ability Energy and 1 x1 Bolt Charge. Each drone can hit enemies 2-3 times.

Gaining 2 Bolt Charge gives ?% grenade energy per stack.

Upon reaching x10 3 Bolt Charge:
• Gain 40?% Grenade Ability Energy
• Heal allies within ? meters for ?HP
• Grants 'New Tricks', which enhances the next thrown 4 Skip Grenade by adding 2 additional seekers on the first bounce.

Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Right Hook
entries.description:
Dealing Melee damage grants 10 Aim Assist and 10 Range for 10 seconds.

Dealing additional Melee damage while the Buff is active extends the duration by 10 seconds, up to the maximum of 20 seconds.

entries.title: Tenacity
entries.description:
Weapon Kills while within 15 meters of an enemy grant a stack of 'Tenacity'. Maximum of 20 stacks.

Stacks persist until death.

'Tenacity' grants 0.5% increased damage (additively), 2? Handling and 2? Reload Speed per stack.

entries.title: Insectoid Robot Grenades
entries.description:
Fires seeking robotic droids that can crawl over surfaces and detonate near enemies or after 2.5 seconds.

Kills spawn more droids based on Combatant Rank:
• Minors: 2
• Elites: 3
• Minibosses and Bosses: 6
• Players: 1

entries.title: Cerebral Uplink
entries.description:
Passively grants 15 Airborne Effectiveness and 45% Additional Base Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Regeneration Rate.

Highlights enemies below 50% HP in a red outline, and Enemy Players with fully-charged Supers in a yellow outline. Highlighting bypasses invisibility.

entries.title: Abyssal Extractors
entries.description:
0 Void Kills grant 'Abyssal Extractors' for 2.5 seconds. While active, kills with Soul Siphon and 1 Void Kills on 2 Suppressed enemies grant 4 seconds. Duration can be extended up to 20 seconds.

3 Soul Siphon hits inflict 4 Suppression for 10 [PVP: ?] seconds.

Abyssal Extractor grants the following benefits:
• 300% additional Base Grenade and Melee Ability Recharge Rate
• 200% additional Base Super and Class Ability Recharge Rate

entries.title: Actual Grandeur
entries.description:
Scoring weapon Kills while 0 Devour is active grants additional Super Energy, ranging between 1% to 4.5% depending on Enemy Rank. Works with any Super.

Massively increases Damage Resist during 1 Nova Bomb cast: starts at 99.5% and drops down to 75% near the end.

Casting 2 Nova Bomb grants the ability to cast 3 'Nova Bomb: Lance' for 5 seconds. Destroying a 4 Nova Bomb: Cataclysm with the Lance triggers a 5 Nova Vortex alongside the original 6 Nova Bomb, effectively granting the effects of both 7 Nova Bombs. Requires a minimum distance of 20 meters to trigger.

8 Nova Bomb returns ~5% Super Energy per kill, up to 50% Super Energy.

entries.title: Conduction Tines
entries.description:
While you have at least 1 0 Arc Ability equipped:
1 Arc Ability and 2 Jolt Kills grant a Stack of Conduction Tines for 10 [PVP: 4] seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

There is a very short cooldown for acquiring Stacks.

Conduction Tines 1|2|3 grant the following:
• 167.5%|335%|502.5% additional Base Grenade, Melee, and Super Regeneration Rate
• 22%|44%|66% decreased Passive 3 Stormtrance Super Drain
• Casting Ionic Sentry spawns a 4 Storm Grenade on its point of impact

entries.title: On Black Wings
entries.description:
Scoring a pellet kill or landing 10 pellets grants one stack of 'On Black Wings' for 10 seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks.

On Black Wings grants the following at 1|2|3| stacks:
• 15.6%|39%|54.7% increased Slug Precision damage
• 3.5%|8.8%|12.4% increased Pellet Precision Damage
• ? Reload Speed
• ? Reload Speed Animation Duration

Precision Hits with slug rounds refresh buff duration.

entries.title: Alethonym Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants the One For All trait:
Scoring Weapon Hits against 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each grants 35% increased damage for 10 seconds. Does not require Direct Hits.

Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.title: Arc Conductor
entries.description:
Powered Heavy Attacks grant 'Arc Conductor' for 6 seconds.

While Arc Conductor is active, gain 50% [PVP: 15%] Damage Resistance to 0 Arc Damage and emit chain lightning around you in a 12 meter radius every 0.25 seconds, dealing 171 [PVP: 26] damage per tick. On single targets, a bonus second tick triggers every 1.5 seconds.

Lightning is treated as sword damage.

Buff is removed on stow.

entries.title: Traveler's Chosen Catalyst
entries.description:
Increases Magazine Size by 2 (15🠚17)

Grants the Surplus trait:
Grants Stat Bonuses depending on the number of Charged Abilities.

Stat Bonuses with 1|2|3+ Charged Abilities:
• 5|15|25 Stability
• 5|25|60 Handling
• 10|25|60 Reload Speed

Also grants the Osmosis trait:
Grenade Ability usage refills 50% of your Magazine (rounded up) from reserves and changes the weapon's element to match your equipped Grenade Ability until stowed.

Magazine Refill cannot be triggered again without stowing the weapon first.

Kinetic weapons lose their Passive Damage Bonus against non-Boss PVE Combatants (10% on 0 Primary, 15% on 1 Special).

Perks that replace your Grenade Ability (such as 2 Gunpowder Gamble or Transcendence Grenades) will also trigger Osmosis.

entries.title: Harmonic Holster
entries.description:
After stowing a Weapon matching your Super Element:
Begins to refill 10%|10%|15% of the stowed weapon's magazine (rounded up) from reserves every 2.5|2|2 seconds with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

entries.title: Harbinger's Pulse
entries.description:
Scoring 3 0 Void Kills from any source within 4.5 seconds of each refills the magazine.

Kills with Telesto count as 2.

entries.title: Dragon's Vengeance
entries.description:
Grants the following benefits for 11 seconds upon reaching Critical Health, or on Ally Death:
• Refills magazine from reserves
• 5 Range and 10 Handling
• Decreases Charge/Draw Time by 2.5%

entries.title: Ticuu's Divination Catalyst
entries.description:
Triggering Sacred Flame explosions grants one stack of 'Causality Quiver' for 5.5 seconds. Marking enemies with Sacred Flame refreshes the buff. Maximum of 6 stacks.

Causality Quiver increases the impact damage of your arrows (not the explosion) at 1|2|3|4|5|6 stacks:
• PvE: 16%|31%|49%|67.5%|87%|87%
• PvP: 3.6%|11%|12%|16%|23%|23%

entries.title: Veist Stinger
entries.description:
Hits have a chance to trigger 'Veist Stinger' for 7 seconds, granting the following bonuses:
• 10% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
• 15% decreased Draw Time to Bows
• ? Charge Rate to Swords
• Refills 25% of Magazine from reserves on activation. Rounds up. Cannot load the Magazine beyond its base capacity.

4 second cooldown between activations.

Activation Chance on hits:
• Auto Rifle, Submachine Gun: 2%
• Sidearm: 4%
• Bow, Linear Fusion Rifle, Sniper Rifle: 10%

entries.title: Skulking Wolf
entries.description:
Weapon Kills while at or below 90 HP grant the following benefits for 10 seconds:
• Enhanced Radar (6⁠🠚⁠12 sectors)
• Removes you from passively pinging enemy radars
• PvE Combatants become less accurate when targeting you

Firing weapons will still ping enemy radars for 2 seconds. (Radar Blip indicates that it's only visible for 0.75 seconds; this is inaccurate)

entries.title: Tommy's Matchbook Catalyst
entries.description: While Ignition Trigger is active, kills grant 60 HP (0 Cure x1) and every 5th shot applies 15 [PVP: 10] 1 Scorch. 2 Ember of Ashes increases this to 3 20 for both PvE and PvP.

entries.title: Adept Stability
entries.description: Passively grants 10 Stability.

entries.title: Special Finisher
entries.description: Finishers consume 3 Stacks of Armor Charge and generate a Special Ammo Brick for you and allies.

entries.title: One-Two Finisher
entries.description:
Finishers consume 3 or more Stacks of Armor Charge and grant Melee Ability Energy.

Energy Gains with 3|4|5|6 Stacks Consumed:
70% | 80% | 90% | 100%

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Bulwark Finisher
entries.description:
Finishers consume 3 or more Stacks of Armor Charge and grant a 45 HP 0 Void Overshield.

Overshield lasts 8|10|12|14 seconds with 3|4|5|6 Stacks of Armor Charge consumed.

entries.title: Healthy Finisher
entries.description: Finishers consume 1 Stack of Armor Charge to fully restore Health and Shields.

entries.title: Snapload Finisher
entries.description: Finishers consume 1 Stack of Armor Charge and refill all your weapons from reserves.

entries.title: Explosive Finisher
entries.description:
Finisher consume 3 or more Stacks of Armor Charge and grant Grenade Ability Energy.

Energy Gains with 3|4|5|6 Stacks Consumed:
70% | 80% | 90% | 100%

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: String of Curses
entries.description:
Weapon Kills instantly refill the magazine and grant one stack of 'String of Curses' for 5.5 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

String of Curses Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• Increased Super Energy per kill: 0.8%|1.1%|1.4%|1.7%|2%
• Increased damage (PvE): 20%|40%|60%|80%|100%
• Increased damage (PvP): 10%|20%|30%|40%|50%

Scoring three kills within 7.5 seconds of each other triggers a Cursed Explosion at the enemy's location, dealing 305 [PVP: ?] damage in a ? meter radius. Kills must be achived without performing a manual reload or stowing the gun.

Cursed Explosion kills count towards triggering the next explosion and benefit from String of Curses.

entries.title: Suros Synergy
entries.description:
Finishing a reload grants 40 Handling and 20% Flinch Resistance for 6 seconds.

Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.title: Dual Speed Receiver
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to switch to this mode.

While Aiming Down Sights, RPM and Damage Profile are set to the High Impact Auto Rifle Archetype.

Grants 30 Range, increases Zoom by 3, and kills generate ?% increased 0 Heavy Ammo Progress.

entries.title: Toxic Overload
entries.description:
Landing 14 Hits or 7 Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each other, or scoring a kill, triggers a burst of Potent Corruption (Poison) at the target's location in a 5 meter radius.

Potent Corruption deals 32.35 [PVP: 5?] damage on the first tick, then increases in damage every 0.52 [PVP: 0.7] seconds for a total of 19 [PVP: ?] ticks over 10 [PVP: ?] seconds.

Potent Corruption damage increases by 11% per tick for the first 14 ticks, then by an average of 41% per tick for the last 5 ticks, dealing 1366 [PVP: ?] damage over the entire duration.

Targets that die to the corruption trigger another burst of poison around them. Cooldown of 2 seconds.

Osteo Striga's poison counts as weapon damage and benefits from all related buffs. Reapplying the poison resets it back to the first stack.

entries.title: Collective Demolition
entries.description:
Collecting an Elemental Pickup enables Weapon Damage to generate Grenade Ability energy per hit for 8 seconds.

0 Ionic Traces, 1 Stasis Shards, and Shot 2 Tangles extend the timer by 4 seconds. 3 Firesprites, 4 Void Breaches, and Thrown 5 Tangles extend the timer by 8 seconds.

Timer can be extended to a maximum of 16 seconds.

Grenade energy granted by weapon type:
Spreadshot HC: 0.5%
Burst Sidearm: 0.78%
Fusion Rifle: 1.15%
Rocket Pulse: 1.95%
Sidearm: 2.34%
Scout: 3.34%
Rocket Launcher: 12.9%

Elemental Pickups include 6 Firesprites, 7 Ionic Traces, 8 Stasis Shards, 9 Tangles, and 10 Void Breaches.

entries.title: Misdirection
entries.description:
Class Ability usage applies Misdirection to enemies within 10 [PVP: 22] meters.

Misdirection:
• Deals ~0 damage but counts as a Hit
• PVE: Disorients Minors and Elites for 5 seconds
• PVP: briefly distorts audio, Disorients, and disables Radar for 5 seconds

entries.title: Deflection Tang
entries.description: Blocking damage within 1 second of starting your guard grants 20% increased damage for 2 seconds.

entries.title: Distribution
entries.description:
Class Ability usage while within 15 meters of an enemy grants Grenade, Melee, Class Ability, and Super Energy.

Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods Equipped:
• Ability Energy: 4% [PVP: 2%] | 6% [PVP: 3%] | 7% [PVP: 3.5%]
• Super Energy: 2% [PVP: 1%] | 3% [PVP: 1.5%] | 4% [PVP: 2%]

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website. (Super Energy gains are unaffected)

entries.title: Sunburn
entries.description:
Fires explosive payloads that highlight targets for 1 second on direct impact.

In PvE, the explosive portion deals 14% more damage than the impact damage. In PvP, the split is equalized.

entries.title: Feast of Light
entries.description:
Orbs of Power grant an additional 2% Super Energy.
This is decreased to 0.5% if 0 Golden Gun: Marksman is the selected Super Ability.

Picking up an Orb of Power with a charged Super Ability grants a Stack of 'Feast of Light'. Maximum of 6 Stacks.

Casting your Super while at 1|2|3|4|5|6 Stacks consumes all Stacks and grants the following benefits:
• 18.2%|36.4%|54.6%|59.7%|64.8%|70% increased Super damage for 14 seconds
• Restores ?|?|?|?|?|200 HP
• 100 HP Overshield for 16 seconds if cast at 6 Stacks

entries.title: Polaris Lance Catalyst
entries.description: Precision Kills cause targets to explode, dealing up to 123.89 [PVP: 95.3] weapon-matching elemental damage in a 4.5-meter radius.

entries.title: Crow's Wings
entries.description:
Intrinsically deals 30% increased damage to Minor combatants.

Charged Heavy Attacks consume 50% Sword Energy to launch a 0 Suppressing Void projectile.

Projectile hits on 1 Suppressed targets 2 Suppresses nearby enemies in an 8 meter radius.

entries.title: Recuperation
entries.description: Orb of Power Pickups immediately restore 15|21|21 HP with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

entries.title: Thorn Catalyst
entries.description:
Passively grants 15 Range, 5 Stability, and 5 Airborne Effectiveness.

Kills or collecting Remnants grants 'Refined Soul' for 7 seconds. Additional kills or Remnants can extend this timer up to 11 seconds.

Refined Soul grants 10 Range, 15 Handling, and 50 Mobility.

entries.title: One Quiet Moment
entries.description:
After not having exchanged damage for 1 second:
Grants 20 Handling, 40 Reload Speed, and a 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier. Swords receive up to a 12.5% increase to Movement Speed instead.

After not having exchanged damage for 2 seconds:
Grants 20 Handling, 40 Reload Speed, and a 5% decresed Reload Duration. Swords receive up to a 25% increase to Movement Speed instead.

Can activate while stowed.

Exchanging damage refers to either dealing or receiving damage. Self-damage and environmental damage do not count.

entries.title: Winged Eclipse
entries.description:
Kills charge up 'Winged Eclipse', with progress granted based on Enemy Rank.
• Minor Enemies: 1
• Elite Enemies: 2
• Miniboss+ and Guardians: 3

At six charges, replaces your grenade abilty with two charges of Loyal Moths. Incurs a six second cooldown upon spending both charges before progress can be gained.

Moth Grenades explode on impact, releasing 2 Loyal Moths that fly to their nearest target. Moths that spawn closer to allies turn into 0 Void Moths, while Moths that spawn closer to enemies turn into 1 Arc Moths. When both allies and enemies are close, one of each moth spawns.

Loyal Moth variants:
• 2 Arc Moths: slower-flying, offensive role. They seek out targets and detonate on contact, dealing up to 526 [PVP: 31 to Players, 201 to Objects] damage in a 4 meter radius and 3 Blinding targets. Counts as 4 Arc Grenade Damage.
• 5 Void Moths: faster-flying, support role. They seek out allies and grant them a 22.5 HP 6 Void Overshield on contact.

entries.title: Touch of Venom
entries.description:
Requires a 0 Void Melee to be equipped in order to function.

Killing 1 Weakened enemies grants 30% 2 Smoke Bomb Melee Energy and releases a 3 Weakening puff of 4 Void Smoke at their location.

5 Void Smoke is functionally identical to 6 Smoke Bomb and triggers melee-associated effects.

entries.title: Sun Blast
entries.description:
Kills cause targets to explode, dealing 432 [PVP: 160] damage and applying 0 10 Scorch (15 with 1 Ember of Ashes) in a 6 meter radius.

Explosion damage falls to 40% at the edge of its radius.

Explosion kills can chain into additional explosions.

entries.title: Acrobat's Focus
entries.description:
Using a 0 Grapple grants 1 Woven Mail for 10 seconds and restores 7 HP.

2 Woven Mail grants %? Flinch Resistance and kills with it active restore 17 HP.

entries.title: Panic Response
entries.description:
Magazine is refilled every 0.2 seconds based on currently remaining ammo while not firing the weapon.

Refill amount by currently remaining ammo:
• 1-2 Ammo: 4 shots
• 3-8 Ammo: 3 shots
• 9-16 Ammo: 2 shots
• 17 Ammo: 1 shot

Generates 2% Blight per hit. Not firing for 1.3 seconds drains 3.33% Blight every 1.2 seconds.

Performing a manual reload creates Blighted Seekers for 7 seconds, granting 1 Seeker for every 16.7% Blight converted. Maximum of 6 Seekers. Blight always rounds up to the next full Seeker.

Grants ? Reload Speed based on the amount of Blighted Seekers prepared.

Blighted Seekers are fired at 720 RPM while aiming down sights or 450 RPM if fired from the hip.

entries.title: Crossing Over
entries.description:
As the Magazine drops from full to 50% capacity:
Linearly scales down from granting 10 Range and ? Handling to 50% strength.

As the Magazine drops from 50% capacity to empty:
Linearly grants 1.5% to 3% increased damage, reaching maximum strength with the second to last bullet.

entries.title: Trinary Vision
entries.description:
Fires three wave-frame grenade launcher projectiles that can [PVP: cannot] deal overlapping damage.

Each projectile deals 581 [PVP: ?] damage and travels 12 meters across the ground.

entries.title: Drop Mag
entries.description:
Passively grants 30 Reload Speed with a 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier.

Decreases Magazine Size Stat by 30. (Equivalent to the "inverse" of Extended Mag)

entries.title: Disease Vector
entries.description:
Nanite Damage is increased by 25%.

Enemies that die with Nanites attached to them release four Nanites around them, each dealing 13 [PVP: 4] damage.

entries.title: Bray Legacy
entries.description:
Hits with the weapon grant ability energy to the most charged ability. Does not require Direct Hits.

Does not grant any energy to abilities that you already have a full charge of.

Ability energy gains by weapon:
• VS Pyroelectric Propellant: 0.2%
• VS Velocity Baton: 0.365%
• VS Gravitic Arrest: 0.425%
• VS Chill Inhibitor: 3.5%

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Last Stand
entries.description: While Solo, or Last Guardian Standing, gain 100 Health Stat, ? Handling, and 30 Reload Speed.

entries.title: Reign Havoc
entries.description: Kills spawn a Lightning Strike, dealing 232 [PVP: 65] damage in a 5 meter radius and grant 0 x1 Bolt Charge.

entries.title: Häkke Light Burst Fire
entries.description: Becomes an Aggressive-Burst Frame Pulse Rifle.

entries.title: Bitterspite
entries.description:
Taking 20 damage grants a Stack of Bitterspite. Maximum of 5 Stacks.

Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 10 | 20 | 30 | 40 | 50 Reload Speed
• 0.97x | 0.96x | 0.95x | 0.92x | 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier

Reloading the weapon consumes all Stacks.

entries.title: Outreach
entries.description:
Class Ability usage grants Melee Energy.

Melee Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods:
12% [PVP: 6%] | 17% [PVP: 8.5%] | 20% [PVP: 10%]

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Turncoat Catalyst
entries.description:
Upon exiting Void Empowerment, gain a 0 Void Overshield for 10 seconds (15 with Echo of Persistence).

The amount of Void Overshield granted is determined by how long you were empowered. 3 HP is granted for for each second that Empowerment lasted, capping at 40 HP for 13 seconds of Empowerment.

entries.title: Insatiable
entries.description:
Super Ability activation fully restores Health, Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy for you and allies within ? meters.

Grants 66% Grenade and Melee Ability Energy per second for 8 seconds after your Super ends.

entries.title: Cursebringer
entries.description:
This is a Weapon of Sorrow.

Precision Kills, Cursed Thrall Explosion Kills, or killing a Poisoned enemy grants 70 Reload Speed, 10% decreased Reload Animation Duration, and trigger a Cursed Thrall Explosion at the target's location.

Cursed Thrall Explosions deal up to 630 [PVP: 130] 0 Arc damage and inflict Corruption (Poison) over an 8 meter radius. Corruption lasts for 3.5 seconds and deals 18 [PVP: 0.4] damage every 0.5 seconds.

Kills with Cursed Thrall Explosions refill the magazine.

Cursed Thrall Explosion and Corruption inherit the weapon's Combatant Damage Scaling.

entries.title: Revolution
entries.description:
Hold [Reload] to activate Arc Seeker mode.

Arc Seeker Mode reduces Fire Rate to 100 RPM and shoots tracking bolts that deal 76 [PVP: 50] damage in a 3 meter radius.

Special Note:
0 Bolt Charge that is discharged through 1 Arc Seeker hits counts as 'Scout Rifle Weapon Damage' and benefits from all increases that apply to this damage type. This allows the 2 Bolt Charge detonations to scale both with traditional weapon damage buffs (like 3 Radiant and Surges) and with Combatant Scalars.

Furthermore, hits that would discharge 4 Bolt Charge anyway (such as hits behind a 5 Storm's Keep barricade or hits as the caster of a 6 Well of Radiance) cause 7 Bolt Charge to discharge twice, with one buffed as weapon damage and the other being a regular discharge.

This damage increase to 8 Bolt Charge can be further compounded by the Flashover Artifact Mod from the Tablet of Ruin, which adds a multiplicative 50%.

entries.title: Bomber
entries.description:
Class Ability usage grants Grenade Energy.

Grenade Energy Gains with 1|2|3 Mods:
12% [PVP: 6%] | 17% [PVP: 8.5%] | 20% [PVP: 10%]

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in our explainer blog post on the Clarity website.

entries.title: Ursine Guard
entries.description:
Increases movement speed by 15% while guarding with 0 Unbreakable or 1 Sentinel Shield.

Blocking damage with 2 Sentinel Shield refunds Super Energy after it ends. Maximum of a 50% refund.

Damage Blocked with an active Overshield does not count towards the Super Energy Refund.

Blocking damage 3 Unbreakable refunds 15% [PVP: ?%] Grenade energy after recieving ? [PVP: ?] damage. Blocking additional damage can refund up to 60% [PVP: ?%] Grenade energy.

entries.title: Breakthrough
entries.description:
Fires a three-burst volley with 7 pellets in each burst.

Shots intrinsically stun 0 Unstoppable champions.

entries.title: Whirling Ovation Catalyst
entries.description:
Fully charged rockets overpenetrate through Minor and Elite combatants, leaving a Solar Grenade behind at each combatant's death location for 2? seconds.

Solar Grenade can benefit from the 0 Touch of Flame Aspect, but not from Sunbracers.

entries.title: Target Lock Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Target Lock trait:
Successive Hits within 0.2 seconds of each grant a ramping Damage Buff after scoring 12.5% of the Magazine Capacity as hits. Missing deactivates the buff.

Stacks displayed on-screen are only visual aides, the buff ramps up with each shot once active. Reaches maximum strength at 5 Stacks.

% of the Magazine Capacity as Hits required for each Visual Stack: 12.5%|35.5%|54.5%|74.5%|110.33%

Damage Buff ramps up from 16.73% [PVP: 10.46%] to 40% [PVP: 25%] upon reaching maximum strength.

Assuming no missed shots, it provides roughly a 25% [PVP: 15.85%] Damage Buff on average after firing 100% of the Magazine Capacity.

entries.title: One for All Refit
entries.description:
Grants the One For All trait:
Scoring Weapon Hits against 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each grants 35% increased damage for 10 seconds. Does not require Direct Hits.

Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

entries.title: Hatchling Refit
entries.description:
Grants the Hatchling trait:
Scoring a Precision Kill or 3 kills within 3 seconds of each other spawns a 0 Threadling at the target's location.

entries.title: High-Impact Reserves Refit
entries.description:
Grants the High-Impact Reserves trait:
Increases damage by 12.1% [PVP: 3%] to 25.6% [PVP: 6%] as the Magazine drops from 50% of its base capacity to empty.

The buff in PVE ranges between 10.3% and 22.9% instead on Fusion Rifles and Aggressive Frame Linear Fusion Rifles.

Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.

entries.title: The Corruption Spreads
entries.description:
Scoring 12 Hits within 1 second of each spawns 2 to 3 SIVA Nanites that attach to the target. Precision Kills spawn 9 Nanites that seek enemies within a ? meter radius. Nanites deal 77 [PVP: 13] damage each.

Nanites last for 3 seconds while airborne, and 9 seconds when attached to a target. Attaching any new nanites refreshes their duration.

entries.title: Symmetry Catalyst
entries.description:
Grants 10 Reload Speed and 10 Handling.

Dynamic Charge's maximum stack count is is increased by 5 (15🠚20), allowing for up to 600% increased damage and 100% increased radius.

Grants the Eddy Current trait:
Grants the following after sprinting for 1.5 seconds with the weapon readied:
• 20 Reload Speed
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
• ? Handling
• 0.95x Handling Animation Duration Multiplier

Sprinting refreshes the buff duration.

Being 0 Amplified removes the sprinting requirement and increases the Reload Speed stat bonus to 60.

entries.title: Soaring Fusilier
entries.description:
Passively grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Fusion Rifles and Linear Fusion Rifles.

Fusion Rifle and Linear Fusion Rifle Kills grant 0 Radiant for 7.5 seconds (11.25 with 1 Ember of Solace).

Air Dodges refill all equipped weapons from reserves. Air Dodges include both 2 Icarus Dash and 3 Weavewalk.

entries.title: The Gift of Certainty
entries.description:
Casting 0 Ascension or 1 Tempest Strike releases 3 tracking 2 Arc Projectiles that each deal up to 200 [PVP: 40] 3 Arc damage and apply 4 Jolt on Hit.

Applying 5 Jolt to enemies within 15? meters grants you a Damage Resist buff for 10 seconds that can stack 3 times.

Damage Resist granted with 1|2|3 6 Jolt applications (Resist x2|x3|x4):
25% [PVP: 5%] | 40% [PVP: 7.5%] | 50% [PVP: 10%]

Applying 7 Jolt to multiple targets with a single activation of a 8 Jolt source still only counts as a single application.

entries.title: Glorious Charge
entries.description:
Melee Kills while 0 Amplified grant additional Super Energy:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 2.5?%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 2.5%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: ?%

1 Thundercrash deals 55% increased damage.

2 Thundercrash deactivation grants 50% [PVP: 10%] Damage Resistance for ? seconds.

entries.description:
Upon casting 0 Gathering Storm:
• Releases lightning at enemies within ? meters of you, dealing 650 [PVP: ?] damage and 1 Jolting them
• You and allies within ? meters become 2 Amplified

Lightning strikes (inconsistently) refund up to 50% Super Energy on 3 Arc-Debuffed enemy Hits or Kills based on Enemy Rank:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: ?% on Hits | ? on Kills

entries.title: Bottomless Grief
entries.description:
Passively grants 30 Magazine stat. (Identical to Extended Mag)

Kills refill the magazine while Last Guardian Standing. Does not activate when playing solo.

entries.title: Parasite Catalyst
entries.description: Dealing any damage with both of your other weapons refills the magazine from reserves upon readying the weapon.

entries.title: Dawning Surprise
entries.description:
Scoring multiple Kills with the weapon spawns a Dawning Gift for you and allies. Dawning Gifts remain on the ground for 10 seconds.

Picking up Dawning Gifts grants 10% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy, restores 22 HP, and starts Health Regeneration.

Activation progress on Kills by Enemy Rank:
• Minors and Guardians: 16.66%
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 50%

entries.title: Bastion Catalyst
entries.description: Dealing Melee Damage refills 20% of the Magazine (rounded up) and grants ? Handling for ? seconds.

entries.title: Valiant Charge
entries.description:
Taking any damage while Guarding increases Lunge Distance by 80% for the next swing within 🡅1.5 seconds.

Guarding while receiving Healing Effects (including healing over time from 0 Restoration) from allies also activates the perk.

🡅 Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

entries.title: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
entries.description:
While the perk's buff isn't active, Weapon Kills grant 'Golden Tricorn x1' for 7 seconds, increasing weapon damage by 15%. Additional Kills refresh the buff duration to 🡅8 seconds.

While Golden Tricorn x1 or x2 is active:
Grenade or Elemental Melee Kills matching the element of the Weapon grant Golden Tricorn x2 for 10 seconds, increasing weapon damage by 50%.

Clarity tooltip editor's note: We're replacing the previous Powered Melee term with Elemental Melee. The former is now exclusively used for perks that require the consumption of a Melee Ability Charge. This note is temporary and will be removed in the future.

🡅 Golden Tricorn x1's duration is refreshed to 8 seconds.
